Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: As per MCI prevailing norms

Salary/ Stipend

  • Rs. 2.5 lacs / month (Specialist working in South Andaman)
  • Rs. 2.75 lacs / month (Specialist working in North & Middle Andaman)
  • Rs. 3.00 lacs / month (Specialist working in Nicobar District)

Age Limit (as on 20-01-2026)

  • 65 years

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application through online 20 January 2026 till 4.00 P.M.
List of eligible candidates will be published in DHS website 27 January 2026
Tentative dates and time of online interview through Google meet 29 January 2026 to 30 January 2026 (Time 10.00 A.M to 6.00 P.M)

Selection Process

  • Online interview

General Information / Instructions

The appointment is purely on contract basis for a period of one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier, with effect from the date of joining. Thereafter, the contract will lapse automatically. The appointment can also be terminated at any time, on either side, by giving one month's notice or by paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason or failure to complete three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority.
1. The appointee shall perform the duties assigned to him/her. The competent authority reserves the right to assign any duty as and when required. No extra/additional allowance will be admissible in case of such assignment.
2. The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the Government servants, appointed on regular basis.
3. Non-practicing allowance will not be admissible.
4. The appointee will not be granted any claim or right for regular appointment to any post under Central Health Service.
5. Only consolidated salary will be admissible. No Dearness Allowance and other allowances as are admissible to the Central Government servants shall be admissible.
6. The appointee shall be on the whole time appointment of the Medical Institution and shall not accept any other appointment, paid or otherwise and shall not engage himself in a private practice of any kind during the period of contract.
7. The appointment to the said post will be subject to the Medical Fitness from the competent Medical Board for which he/she will be sent to the designated Medical Authority by the concerned Institute/Hospital before joining the post.
8. The appointee is not entitled to any TA for joining the appointment.
9. Other conditions of service will be governed by relevant rules and orders issued from time to time.
10. They will have to work in any part of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.
11. If any declaration given or information furnished by him/her proves to be false or if he/she is found to have wilfully suppressed any material, information, he/she will be liable for removal from service and also such other action as the Government may deem necessary.
The above mentioned schedule is tentative and subject to change at any stage depending upon the availability of the selection committee. Any change made will be uploaded at DHS website. The Director of Health Services, Port Blair reserves the right to reschedule the above dates & time at any stage of the "online interview".

How to Apply

  • Interested eligible candidates should submit their application in the prescribed format available at DHS website https://dhs.andamannicobar.gov.in along with the soft copy of the relevant documents (self-attested) to DHS email ([email protected]).
  • The complete application should have the following documents along with the application (1) Proof of age (2) UG Degree Certificate (3) PG Degree Certificate (4) Registration Certificate (5) experience certificate (6) Aadhar Card (7) Pan Card.
  • The original documents of the selected candidates will be physically verified upon reporting for duty on appointment.

5) Persons engaged on full time basis under the Scheme will not be allowed to take up any other assignment during the contractual period. The individual shall not engage in other activities that conflict with the interest of the employer.

GENERAL CONDITIONS:

2) The candidates who are applying for more than one post have to submit separate applications for each post.

3) The candidates who are applying for the posts should have completed overall 15 years of service out of which they should have minimum relevant experience as mentioned in the table above.

7) Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

8) Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification of candidature.

9) At the sole discretion of GSL Management the number of posts notified may be increased or reduced.

10) Management further reserves the right to decide the criteria for screening of applications and internal rules and regulations and / or the procedures as per the past practice will be followed.

11) Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application. The candidate is also liable to be terminated on the basis of false information even after his/her selection.

12) Corrigendum, if any, will be uploaded on our website only. Candidates are requested to check our website regularly under the heading “Notice Board Careers Advertisement”.

13) Interview call letters will be sent only through E-mail to shortlisted candidates’ registered Email ID. The candidates are requested to login to their E-mail Id and check regularly.

14) Interview may be conducted either through Video Conferencing or in person. No TA / DA will be paid to candidates called for personal Interview.

15) Information regarding names of eligible candidates, date of interview, names/roll number of selected candidates etc. will be hosted on the website under the heading “Notice Board Careers Advertisement” for which the candidates are requested to visit our website regularly.

16) Upper age limit and experience will be considered as on 31.12.2025.

17) In the event of finding difficulty you may contact us through email:[email protected]

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

For ST Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Bachelors of Business Administration (BBA) OR Graduate in any discipline with Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management/Materials management/Logistics management/other relevant qualification equivalent to 01-year Diploma in Material Management from a recognized University/Institute.
  • Structural Fitter: ITI & NCTVT (National Apprenticeship Certificate) in Structural Fitter/Fitter/Fitter General/Sheet Metal Worker trade.
  • Welder: ITI in the trade of Welder.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 03 years full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized Institute/University.
  • Shipwright Fitter: SSC with Training Certificate from Deck/Engine department.

For OBC Category Posts:

  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Graduate having passed Intermediate examination from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or Institute of Cost Accountants of India OR MBA Finance.
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Minimum 03 years' full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering and one-year full time Diploma in Industrial Safety awarded by Board of Technical Education of any State Government/Union territory or CLI, RLI (Ministry of Labour).

Essential Qualifications

  • For Technical Assistant (Mechanical) and Junior Supervisor (Mechanical-safety), diploma in Mechanical engineering is essential requirement. Candidates who have done B.E./B.Tech and do not possess Diploma will not be considered.
  • All qualifications must be from recognized Universities/Institutes/Boards as per UGC/AICTE/Government norms.

Desirable

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): 2 years Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Commercial/Supply Chain Management from a recognized University/Institute. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Structural Fitter: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Welder: Preference will be given to those candidates who have undergone National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in Shipbuilding Industry or have relevant work experience in Public Sector/Private Shipyards/Naval Workshops. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Ability to work on Auto CAD. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in Finance recognized by Govt of India. Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Adequate working knowledge of Konkani/Marathi along with Hindi & English.

Experience

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Minimum 2 Years Post qualification relevant work experience.
  • Structural Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Welder: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line.
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Minimum 02 years of experience in the line.
  • Shipwright Fitter: Minimum 02 years' experience in the line/trade from Shipbuilding Industry.
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience in Finance function.
  • Junior Supervisor (Safety - Mechanical): Minimum 2 years post qualification relevant work experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Assistant Superintendent (Finance): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Junior Supervisor (Mechanical - Safety): Pay scale of Rs.21,000-3%-70,000 (S-1 Grade)
  • Technical Assistant (Mechanical): Pay scale of Rs.16,600-3%-63,500 (W-8 Grade)
  • Structural Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Welder: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • Shipwright Fitter: Pay scale of Rs.15,100-3%-53,000 (W-5 Grade)
  • All positions are on regular basis with benefits as per company rules.

Age Limit

  • For ST Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 38 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)
  • For OBC Category Posts: Maximum upper age limit is 36 years as on 30.11.2025 (Including Age Relaxation)
  • Relaxation in age will be granted to Ex-Servicemen/Agniveer and PwBD candidates as per existing Government guidelines and as amended from time to time.
  • Internal candidates will get age relaxation as per GSL rules.
  • As on cut-off date, the maximum age after all age relaxations should not be more than 56 years.
  • For the candidates who has completed advance training from GSL, the period of training will be considered as experience for the relevant posts and weightage will be awarded as per the Advance Training Scheme.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC Candidates: Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) to be paid online through SBI e-pay (by Debit card/Credit card/Net Banking, etc.)
  • ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen Candidates: Exempted from payment of application fee, as per Government of India rules
  • Internal Candidates: No fee is required to be paid by internal candidates who apply for the said posts
  • Application without prescribed fees shall be liable for rejection.
  • Application fee is non-refundable; therefore, candidates are requested to verify their eligibility thoroughly before making any payment.
  • The candidature of applicants submitting fee of lesser amount or depositing fee through any other mode other than the prescribed method, will be rejected.
  • After submitting payment information in the online application form, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button in order to avoid double charges.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Candidates have to download and take print of fee receipt.
  • Non-generation of 'Fee Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. In case of failure of payment, candidates are advised to login again and repeat the process payment.

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Date 30/12/2025
Online Application Opens 05/01/2026 (00:00 hrs)
Online Application Closes 04/02/2026 (17:00 hrs)
Upper Age Limit & Experience Considered As On 30/11/2025

Selection Process

  • The selection process shall consist of Written test, Document Verification and Skill/Trade test.
  • The written test may be conducted through Computer based Test (CBT) or Pen Paper based Test (PBT) internally/externally.
  • Written Test will normally consist of 25% General Aptitude and 75% subject/trade related questions.
  • Outstation candidates who clear the written test and qualify for the Skill/Trade Test after Document verification only will be paid to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to Goa Shipyard Limited only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • ST candidates on being eligible and appearing for written test will be reimbursed to and fro sleeper class rail fare by shortest route from their nearest railway station to GSL/exam venue only on production of proof of journey (Hard copy of Tickets) as per rules of the Company.
  • Payment of TA shall be made through ECS mode after completion of the selection process only.
  • Candidates having "Wait Listed" tickets for Rail journey are NOT entitled for TA Reimbursement.
  • Merely calling of the candidates for the written test/skill test does not confer any right that the candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria mentioned in the Advertisement.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates have to submit caste certificate, in the Prescribed Proforma meant for "Appointment to posts under the Government of India" from the designated authority indicating clearly the candidate's caste.
  • The OBC (NCL) certificate should not be more than 06 months old at the time of joining.
  • The candidates under PwBD category belonging to the reserved category will have to submit the disability certificate from the designated authority as stipulated in Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 indicating clearly the percentage of disability.
  • If the ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD certificate has been issued in a language other than English/Hindi, the candidates will be required to submit a self-certified translated copy of the same either in English or Hindi.
  • Ex-Servicemen/Ex-Agniveer belonging to the reserved category can also apply against the advertised posts subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria.
  • Concessions & relaxations will be granted to PwBD candidates applying against the said posts as per Government guidelines in vogue.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to ST category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Stores/Commercial) and Welder posts.
  • PwBD candidates belonging to OBC category are eligible to apply against Assistant Superintendent (Finance) post.
  • The posting shall be at GSL/any other GSL units/project sites as desired by GSL. However, depending upon project requirements, the candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of GSL.
  • The appointment to the post carries with it the obligation to serve in any department of GSL or on-board ships or in any of the units/work sites/projects undertaken in any part of India or abroad as the case may be.
  • The candidates may note that the applications are to be made only through online application system as per the instructions given. Applications made in any other manner shall not be considered and shall be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates have to clearly declare the complete experience while filling the online application from initial appointment to the cutoff date.
  • Management reserves the right to fill or not to fill the posts and also to fill up future vacancies, if any from the valid panel of selected candidates as per the rules of the company.
  • At the sole discretion of GSL Management the number of vacancies notified may be increased or reduced.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualifications and other requirements as laid down does not entitle a candidate to be called for selection process.
  • Candidates working in Government/Quasi Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or produce "No Objection Certificate" at the time of selection process.
  • Management reserves the right to transfer any selected candidate in any position as per requirement of Company, irrespective of position he has been originally selected for.
  • The candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post.
  • The Government directives on reservation will be strictly followed.
  • Interim enquiries will not be entertained.
  • Canvassing in any form may lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Management reserves the right to call for any additional documentary evidence in support of qualification, experience, etc. of the applicants.
  • In case, at any time, it is found that the candidate is not meeting the eligibility criteria, the candidature will summarily be rejected forthwith.
  • Management reserves the right to raise the eligibility criteria for short listing the applications.
  • Management reserves the right to reject the candidature if it is found that false or fabricated information is furnished in the application.
  • Applications received without following the online process will not be entertained. Only ONLINE applications received through GSL recruitment portal will be considered.
  • Management reserves the right to cancel the advertisement and/or the selection process there under without assigning any reason.
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be uploaded on our website only. Candidates are requested to check our website regularly under the heading "Notice Board - Careers - Advertisement".
  • Call letters for selection process will be sent only through E-mail to shortlisted candidates' registered Email ID.
  • Information regarding names of shortlisted candidates, date of written test, names/roll number of selected candidates etc. will be hosted on the website.
  • Management will not be responsible for non-receipt of email and loss of their E-mail ID and password.
  • In the event of finding difficulty to apply online you may contact us through Email: [email protected]
  • Applications received contrary to instructions given shall be rejected.
  • For any dispute, the Jurisdiction shall be Goa only.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official website www.goashipyard.in
  • Under the link Notice Board - 'careers' click the link 'GSL Careers'.
  • Click on 'Apply Now' button and select the post you wish to apply for.
  • Go through the eligibility criteria and the Terms and Conditions of the advertisement before applying online.
  • Keep scanned copies ready before proceeding to fill up the Online Application:
    • Passport size color Photograph with light background (preferably white) - Size below 450 kb
    • Candidate's signature on plain white paper with black ink - Size below 450 kb
    • SSC certificate as proof of date of Birth - Not more than 500 kb
    • Educational qualification mark sheet & degree - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Caste/Disability certificate/Ex-Serviceman certificate - Not more than 500 kb
    • Experience certificates - Not more than 1 Mb
    • Aadhar Card - Not more than 500 kb
  • After completion of Personal information in online application form, fill the Payment details and make the online payment of application fees.
  • Pay application fee of Rs.200/- (Non-Refundable) online through SBI e-pay (by debit card/credit card/net banking etc.). ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from payment.
  • After submitting payment information, please wait for the intimation from the server. Do not press back or refresh button.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, "Fee receipt" would be generated. Download and take print of fee receipt.
  • After completing the Online application, SUBMIT the application form without which the form will be considered as incomplete.
  • Take print out of auto generated filled in Application Form as the same is required to be produced for subsequent Selection Process.
  • After completing the Online application, the candidate will not be allowed to edit his application details.
  • Candidates should ensure all uploaded documents are clear, legible and in the prescribed format and size.
  • Online Application opens from 00:00 hrs. on 05.01.2026 and closes at 17:00 hrs. on 04.02.2026.

  • Qualifications (Dresser): 10th (Matric) pass AND one year training course for Dresser post from a Government recognized institution.

Selection Process

  • Selection is based on the "Jharkhand State Jails Para Medical Workers Recruitment Combined Competitive Examination-2025", which will be a Computer-Based Test (CBT).
  • The exam consists of two papers (Paper I and Paper II), except for the Dresser post which only has Paper I.
  • Paper I is a qualifying general subject paper (General Knowledge, Hindi, English). Candidates must secure a minimum of 30% marks in Paper I to be considered in the merit list.
  • The final merit list will be prepared by adding marks of both Paper I and Paper II (where applicable).
  • A minimum qualifying mark in the total score is also defined for different categories (UR: 40%, SC/ST/Female: 32%, EBC-I: 34%, BC-II: 36.5%).

  • Candidates must upload their scanned photo and full signature during the online application process.
  • Admit Cards will be uploaded on the website; no physical admit cards will be sent via post.

How To Apply

  • Visit the JSSC official website: `www.jssc.jharkhand.gov.in`.

Opening date for submission of Online application 06/01/2026 (Tuesday)

Selection Process

  • The mode of selection is Personal Interview; however, the mode may be changed at the discretion of Management if required.
  • List of candidates called for Personal Interview, along with date, time and venue, will be uploaded on MECON’s official website and also communicated via registered e-mail IDs provided in the online application.
  • Candidature is subject to verification of details and documents at the time of interview or any stage of the recruitment/appointment process.
  • Final list of selected candidates will be uploaded on MECON’s website and selected candidates will be intimated about Document Verification and Medical Examination through website and registered e-mail.
  • Outstation candidates appearing for interview will be reimbursed TA in the form of III Tier A/C (3A) / CC rail fare or Rs. 7 per km by road, whichever is less, subject to submission of original tickets/receipts as per rules.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals can apply; candidates in Central/State Government/PSUs/Autonomous bodies must apply online and either forward their application through proper channel or produce NOC at the time of interview.
  • Candidates must produce all original certificates and documents at interview, including proof of age, educational qualifications, experience, caste/category and other relevant certificates, failing which they will not be interviewed or eligible for TA.
  • Educational qualifications must be from Government-recognized universities/institutes; candidates must upload final or provisional degree certificates and all semester/year mark sheets or consolidated mark sheets showing required qualification.
  • Candidates must upload self-attested scanned documents in prescribed formats and ensure they are legible, not encrypted or password-protected; multiple documents must be merged into a single PDF within specified size.
  • Furnishing wrong/false information or uploading illegible or overwritten documents will lead to disqualification, and if detected later, cancellation of appointment without notice.
  • Mere submission of application and fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not confer any right to employment; MECON reserves the right to alter eligibility standards, fill or not fill the vacancy and modify or cancel the recruitment process.
  • All communication regarding recruitment, including interview call letters and updates, will be through MECON website and candidates’ registered e-mail IDs; candidates must keep their e-mail and mobile number active for at least one year.
  • No hard copies are required to be sent; however, candidates must submit the hard copy of the online application at the time of interview, if called.
  • Applications that are incomplete, not in prescribed format, illegible, without required documents or without requisite fee will be summarily rejected without correspondence.
  • Any dispute related to this recruitment will fall under the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only, and the decision of Chairman & Managing Director, MECON Limited, will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Candidates satisfying the eligibility criteria must apply online through MECON website under Careers > Career Opportunities > “Click here to apply Online” during the application period.
  • No other mode of application is allowed; candidates should carefully read the instructions on the website before filling the online application form.
  • Applicants must upload scanned passport size colour photograph and signature in jpg/jpeg format within specified size limits.
  • Candidates must upload self-attested scanned copies of age proof, educational qualifications, experience certificates, PAN, Aadhaar, caste/category certificates, PwD/EWS/Ex-servicemen certificates, and other applicable documents in PDF format as prescribed.
  • Aadhaar Card is mandatory for online application and must match the Aadhaar number filled in the application; mismatch will lead to rejection.

The total number of vacancies for CSIR-CIMFR Security Officer Recruitment 2026 is 01 post.

Post Name Total Posts
Security Officer 01

Note: CSIR-CIMFR strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

Candidates must possess the following essential qualification and experience for the Security Officer post:

  • Ex-Servicemen JCO (Subedar or higher rank) OR equivalent rank in other Para-military forces with minimum of 10 years’ experience in security.
  • For Short Service Commissioned Officers and incumbents holding the position of Assistant Commandant in CRPF/BSF/ITBP etc. in pay scale Rs. 8000–13500 (Pre-revised) – minimum 05 years’ experience in security.
  • For Inspector from Para-Military Forces – minimum 10 years’ experience in security.

2. Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 02-02-2026 (last date of receipt of application).
  • The date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is 02-02-2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy are not eligible for age relaxation.
  • Relaxation in age limit is available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.
  • Not applicable to serving Armed Forces personnel (except those being released after earning pension) and Paramilitary Forces personnel.

3. Nationality

The applicant must be a citizen of India. All applicants must fulfill the essential requirements and conditions as on 02-02-2026.

Job Description

The Security Officer will be responsible for overall security management of CSIR-CIMFR campus and its units, including supervision of security measures, record maintenance, and handling security-related emergencies.

  • Supervising security measures for safety of CSIR-CIMFR properties and units.
  • Maintaining records related to movement of men and materials, deployment of security personnel in all shifts, handling visitors, security cameras, and enforcement of security rules and procedures.
  • Working round the clock (24x7) as required and attending in person to security-related emergencies.
  • Conducting investigations into theft, pilferage, accidents, sabotage or subversive activities and coordinating with local law and order authorities; knowledge of local language is an added advantage.
  • Use and maintenance of firearms.
  • Firefighting and combating fire in emergencies.
  • Any other duty assigned by the competent authority.

Age Limit

  • Upper age limit not exceeding 35 years as on the last date of submission of application (02-02-2026 at 5:30 PM).
  • Date for determining age limit, experience and qualifications is the closing date for receipt of applications.
  • No age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against UR vacancy.
  • Age relaxation available only for eligible Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules under Ex-Servicemen (Re-employment in Central Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979 as amended.

Application Fee

  • Candidates are required to pay a non-refundable Application Fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only).
  • Payment must be made through SBI payment gateway available at CSIR-CIMFR website (www.cimfr.nic.in) via SBI Collect.
  • Web generated e-receipt of SBI payment must be enclosed with the application form.
  • No other mode of payment is accepted.
  • SC/ST/Women candidates are exempted from payment of application fee (as mentioned in the “How to apply” section).

Selection Process

Candidates will be selected through the following stages:

  • Physical and Personality Assessment Test (qualifying in nature).
  • Written Test (for candidates who qualify the physical and personality assessment test).
  • Final merit list based on performance in competitive written examination (primarily Paper-II as per syllabus).
  • Tie cases will be resolved as per CSIR Letter No. 5-1(211)/2014-PD dated 30.05.2023 and any subsequent amendments.

Written Test Pattern

Candidates who qualify the physical test will be allowed to appear for the written test, consisting of two papers:

  • Paper-I: OMR-based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Test.
  • Paper-II: Subjective type.
  • Paper-I (Mental Ability and Personality Assessment Test): 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes, no negative marking.
  • Threshold marks for Paper-I: 30%. Only candidates securing at least 30% in Paper-I will have Paper-II evaluated.
  • Paper-II: Total 100 marks, 2 hours duration – Comprehension (25), Report Writing (25), Security Regulations & Firefighting (25), General Awareness (25).
  • Minimum threshold marks for Paper-II shall not be less than 35% (to be notified before test).
  • Final merit list based on Paper-II marks only for candidates who secure more than minimum threshold marks.
  • Medium of exam: English and Hindi (bilingual question papers; exam can be taken in either language).
  • Standard of exam: Graduation level.

Salary / Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: Level-7 as per 7th CPC, Rs. 44,900–1,42,400.
  • Approximate total emoluments: Rs. 78,000/- per month at minimum of scale, including House Rent Allowance as admissible in Dhanbad.
  • Benefits include DA, HRA (if accommodation not provided), Transport Allowance and other allowances as per CSIR/GoI norms.
  • New entrants governed by New Pension Scheme (NPS) 2004 as adopted by CSIR; those from Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs with Govt. pattern pension continue under CCS (Pension) Rules 1972 (now 2021), as applicable.

How To Apply

Candidates must submit applications only in offline mode using the prescribed format.

  1. Visit CSIR-CIMFR website: www.cimfr.nic.in.
  2. Go to “Vacancies” section (http://cimfr.nic.in/vacancies.html) and download the prescribed Application Form (A4 size).
  3. Read the advertisement completely before filling the form. All columns are mandatory; write “Not Applicable (NA)” where not relevant.
  4. Fill the application form in English/Hindi, affix recent self-attested passport size colour photograph and sign the form.
  5. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- (if applicable) through SBI Collect via SBI payment gateway available at CIMFR website and take a print-out of the e-receipt.
  6. Attach self-attested copies of required documents (age proof, educational qualifications, experience, discharge certificate, caste certificate, NOC if applicable, etc.) along with web generated SBI e-receipt.
  7. Place the application and enclosures in an envelope superscribed:
    “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF __________ (Post Code: _______), Advt. No. _______”
  8. Send the envelope by Registered/Speed Post only to:
    The Controller of Administration, Central Institute of Mining & Fuel Research, Barwa Road, Dhanbad – 826001 (JHARKHAND)
  9. Ensure that the application reaches on or before 02-02-2026 by 5:30 PM. Applications received after the closing date/time will not be entertained.
  10. Applications without photograph, signature, application fee (if applicable), or required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Assistant Professor – Curriculum & Pedagogic Course (Manipuri, Chemistry, Economics)
    • Postgraduate degree in the concerned Pedagogy Subject (Manipuri / Chemistry / Economics) with 55% marks (or equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) from a recognized University/Institution.
    • M.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution.
    • Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC or CSIR or similar test accredited by UGC or SLET/SET for North East Region, OR have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and amendments.
    • For candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to 11 July 2009, exemption from NET/SLET/SET is allowed subject to conditions: regular mode Ph.D., thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, open viva voce conducted, at least two research papers from Ph.D. work (one in refereed journal), and at least two conference/seminar presentations sponsored/funded by UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or similar, duly certified by Registrar/Dean (Academic Affairs).
    • NET/SLET/SET qualification shall be either in the respective pedagogic subject (Manipuri/Chemistry/Economics) or in Education; Ph.D. qualification shall be in the concerned pedagogic subject or in Education/Teacher Education.
  • Assistant Professor – Perspective in Education or Foundation Course
    • Option 1:
      • Postgraduate degree in Social Science (Economics / Geography / History / Political Science) with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/Institution, and
      • M.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution.
    • OR Option 2:
      • Postgraduate (M.A.) degree in Education with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University/Institution, and
      • B.Ed./B.El.Ed. degree with 55% from NCTE recognized institution (Desirable: B.Ed. degree shall be of Secondary Education).
    • Besides the above, candidate must have cleared NET conducted by UGC or similar test accredited by UGC like SLET/SET for North East Region, OR have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC Ph.D. Regulations 2009/2016 and amendments, with the same Ph.D. exemption conditions as above.
    • For faculty in Perspectives in Education or Foundation Courses, NET/SLET/SET qualification shall be in Education; Ph.D. qualification shall be in Education or Teacher Education.
  • Relaxation Clauses (Common)
    • 5% relaxation at Bachelor’s and Master’s level for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-creamy layer)/Differently Abled (blindness and low vision; deaf and hard of hearing; locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims, muscular dystrophy; autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness; multiple disabilities including deaf-blindness) for eligibility and assessing good academic record.
    • 5% relaxation (from 55% to 50%) in Master’s degree marks for Ph.D. degree holders who obtained their Master’s prior to 19 September 1991.
    • A relevant grade regarded as equivalent of 55% at Master’s level wherever grading system is followed by recognized University shall be considered valid.
    • Time taken to acquire M.Phil./Ph.D. degree shall not be counted as teaching/research experience; active service with simultaneous research without leave may be counted as teaching experience.
  • General Eligibility Conditions
    • Candidate must be a citizen of India.
    • Must be able to speak Manipuri, Meitei/Meetei lon or any of the Tribal dialects of Manipur.
    • Must be a permanent resident of Manipur; candidates whose parent/ancestor in direct lineage are/were permanent residents (with documentary proof such as electoral roll enrolment and birth certificate) are also eligible.
    • There will be no upper age limit.

Salary/Stipend

  • Scale of Pay: PB-3 Rs. 15,600–39,100/- plus Academic Grade Pay (AGP) Rs. 6,000/- (pre-revised).
  • Posts are classified as Class I, Group A under Government Colleges in Manipur; other allowances and benefits are as per State Government norms.

Application Fee

Category Application / Examination Fee
General & OBC Rs. 600/-
SC & ST Rs. 400/-
DAPs (Differently Abled Persons) No fee
  • Fee to be paid only through online mode (net banking, VISA/MASTER Card, Debit Card) via https://empsconline.gov.in.
  • Applications without prescribed fee/mode will be summarily rejected.
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded nor kept in reserve for any other examination/selection.
  • Applicants whose payment details are not received from the bank will be treated as fictitious; list will be published, and only on receipt of documentary proof will genuine payment cases be revived.

Important Dates

Notification Date 24 December 2025 (Imphal)
Start Date for Online Application 29 December 2025
Last Date for Online Application Submission 26 January 2026 (up to 11:59 PM)
Last Date for Submission of Hard Copies (Research Publications, Awards, Annexure-A, Application Printout) On or before 26 January 2026 (to Secretary, MPSC)
Date & Venue of Interview To be notified in due course by the Commission

Selection Process

  • Selection procedure governed by Appendix-1 Table-3 / Appendix II Table-3B of UGC Regulations 2018 as adopted by Government of Manipur Order No. 10/187/2018-HE dated 3 July 2021 (Annexure-A).
  • Academic score as per Appendix-1 Table-3 (graduation, post-graduation, M.Phil., Ph.D., NET/JRF/SET, research publications, teaching/post-doctoral experience, awards) will be used only for short-listing candidates for interview.
  • Final selections shall be based solely on performance in the interview.
  • Academic score sheets (Annexure-A) must be duly filled, self-scored and authenticated by candidate, and uploaded in the online application (Table-3 section) and also submitted offline along with supporting documents.
  • All research publications (peer-reviewed / UGC listed) and awards claimed for eligibility and scoring must be submitted as hard copies to the Secretary, MPSC along with Annexure-A and application printout by hand/Speed Post/Courier on or before 26 January 2026.
  • The academic scores will be examined by a Committee of Experts under supervision of the Commission.
  • The decision of the Commission regarding eligibility or otherwise of a candidate shall be final; candidature may be cancelled at any stage if conditions are not fulfilled.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited on prescribed online forms for direct recruitment to 7 posts of Assistant Professors of D.M. College Teacher Education under Higher Education Department, Manipur.
  • Teaching/research experience: format of Experience Certificate is provided as Annexure-B; candidates must upload signed experience certificates and supporting documents in the Experience section during online application.
  • All candidates in service/Ad hoc/Contract/Guest Faculty/Part-time must submit/upload “No Objection Certificate” (NOC) issued by concerned Department/Authority.
  • No queries or representations regarding correction of candidate-entered details will be entertained; candidates must exercise due diligence while filling the online form as timely completion of examination process is of paramount importance.
  • All research publications and awards must match categories specified in Annexure-A; Commission will not be responsible for non-receipt of requisite documents by the last date.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or after appointment it is found that candidate does not fulfil eligibility conditions, his/her candidature/appointment will be cancelled.

How to Apply

  • Apply online at www.empsconline.gov.in from 29 December 2025 to 26 January 2026 up to 11:59 PM; no other mode of application is entertained.
  • Fill all personal, educational, experience and eligibility details carefully in the online application form.
  • Upload required documents including experience certificates (Annexure-B format) and academic score sheet (Annexure-A – Appendix-1 Table-3) in the specified sections.
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online using net banking, VISA/MASTER Card or Debit Card through the EMPSC online portal.
  • Download and print the duly filled application generated by the system after successful submission and fee payment.
  • Submit offline to the Secretary, MPSC: hard copies of research publications (peer-reviewed/UGC listed), awards, duly filled Annexure-A (academic score sheet), and printout of online application by hand or Speed Post/Courier on or before 26 January 2026.
  • Retain copies of all submitted documents and payment proof for future reference; regularly check MPSC website for interview date and further updates.

  • Stage I: Written test carrying 60 marks of 60 minutes duration in the subject wherein the candidate has applied for. The question paper will consist of 60 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).

  • Final Selection: Final result will be declared based on total marks obtained in Stage-I and Stage-II Examination.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Passing Intermediate (10+2) or equivalent from a recognized board/institute is mandatory.
  • Note: For the post of Stenographer, Maulvi Certificate, I.T.I. (two-year course certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT) and Polytechnic (three-year engineering diploma) will be considered equivalent to Intermediate.
  • Technical Qualification: Knowledge of shorthand in Hindi and English and computer typing/computer basics/word processing is mandatory.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Level–4 (25500 – 81100/-)

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2025)

  • Minimum 18 years and maximum unreserved (male)– 37 years, backward class/extremely backward class (male and female) and unreserved female– 40 years and scheduled caste/ scheduled tribe (male and female)– 42 years.

Application Fee

  • Each candidate has to deposit an examination fee of only 100/- (one hundred rupees).
  • Note: Those candidates who do not enter Aadhaar No. as identity card in the online application will have to pay an additional 200/- (two hundred) rupees as Biometric fee.

Important Dates

Online Application Start Date 12 January 2026
Last Date for Filling Online Application 2 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Written Examination and Practical Test.
  • A. Written Examination- The written examination will be objective in nature. This examination will have one paper on General Knowledge, which will include the following subjects:-
  • (a) General Studies - Number of questions-50
  • (b) General Science and Mathematics - Number of questions-50
  • (c) Mental Ability Test (Comprehension/Logic/Reasoning/Mental Ability) - Number of questions-50
  • The questions will be objective and multiple choice. Total number of questions-150. 4 marks are fixed for each correct answer and 1 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. The duration of the examination will be 2 hours 15 minutes. The question papers in the written examination will be in Hindi/English language. If there is any difference in the Hindi and English question papers, then the English questions will be valid.
  • Note: In the light of resolution memo no. 2374 dated 16.07.2007 of Personnel and Administrative Reforms Department, Bihar and resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, 40 (forty) percent for general category, 36.5 (thirty-six and a half) percent for backward class, 34 (thirty-four) percent for extremely backward class and 32 (thirty-two) percent minimum qualifying marks for scheduled caste/scheduled tribe/women and disabled candidates is mandatory.
  • Through the written examination, candidates equal to 05 times the number of vacancies available category-wise will be selected for the Practical Test (Skill Test).
  • B. Practical Test Examination:-
  • (i) In the shorthand test examination, 80 (eighty) words per minute speed for Hindi and English dictation total 320 (three hundred twenty) words have to be written in sign script in the provided notebook in 04 (four) minutes {(1 minute additional time at the beginning for dictation writing)} duration. After the prescribed dictation, 02 minutes additional time will be given for correction. Total 20 (twenty) minutes will be given for typing the shorthand passage.
  • (ii) Typing test examination (Hindi and English) will be taken on computer.
  • (iii) In Hindi typing test examination, Mangal font in Remington Gail Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (iv) In Hindi typing test examination, candidates have to type total 300 (three hundred) words at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute in 10 (ten) minutes.
  • (v) In English typing test examination, “UTF-8” Under English (US) Keyboard Layout will be used.
  • (vi) In English typing test examination, total 300 (three hundred) words have to be typed in 10 (ten) minutes at a speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute.
  • (vii) Candidates should select the appropriate Keyboard Layout at the beginning of Typing, changing Keyboard Layout during Typing may erase the content typed by the candidate.
  • (viii) Compensatory time will be given to benchmark disabled (visually impaired) candidates as per rules.
  • (ix) More than 10 percent error in shorthand speed and 1.5 percent in typing will not be acceptable for success in the practical test examination.
  • (x) Candidates will ensure to follow the instructions displayed on the Computer Screen from time to time during the examination.
  • Note: Detailed information for the practical examination will be published after the written examination and the practical examination will be conducted in the light of the published information.
  • Candidates who have been debarred from examination for specified period by Union Public Service Commission/Bihar Public Service Commission/Bihar Staff Selection Commission/other selection commission in cases of malpractice will not be entitled to appear in the competition examination. The decision of the Commission on the point of eligibility or ineligibility of the candidates to sit in the examination will be final.
  • C. In the light of memo no. 1003 dated 22.01.2021 and letter no. 12897 dated 28.07.2022 of General Administration Department, Bihar, Patna, preference will be given in regular appointment to contractually appointed employees on similar posts.

General Information / Instructions

  • In the light of resolution memo no. 22218 dated 12.12.2022 of General Administration Department, 05 (five) years relaxation in the maximum age limit prescribed for participation in competitive examinations is permissible for government servants regularly appointed by the Bihar Government, but the relaxation in the said age limit will be allowed only when they have not availed more than 05 (five) opportunities till then.
  • In the light of resolution memo no. 962 dated 22.01.2021 of General Administration Department, Bihar, 10 years relaxation in maximum age limit is permissible for disabled persons.
  • In the light of the letter of General Administration Department, ex-servicemen will be given concession equivalent to 03 (three) years plus the period spent in defense service in the age limit, provided that their actual age does not exceed 57 years on the date of application.
  • Syllabus:- The syllabus of the written examination is as follows:-
  • Section (a):- General Studies:- The objective of the questions will be to test the candidate's general knowledge of the surrounding environment and its application in society. Questions related to current events and subtle observation of day-to-day events and scientific approach towards them will also be included, about which an educated person is expected to have knowledge. Questions may be asked especially about Bihar, India and its neighboring countries.
  • (i) Contemporary Issues:- Scientific progress, National/International Awards, Indian Languages, Book, Script, Capital, Currency, Sports-Players, Important Events.
  • (ii) India and its Neighboring Countries:- History of Neighboring Countries, History of India, Culture, Geography, Economic Scenario, Freedom Movement, Main Features of Indian Agriculture and Natural Resources and Constitution and Polity of India, Political System of the Country, Panchayati Raj, Community Development, Five-Year Plan and Contribution of Bihar in the National Movement.
  • Section (b):- General Science and Mathematics:- Questions may generally be asked from the following subjects at the Matric level-
  • (i) General Science:- Basic questions related to Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Geography and knowledge of computer basics/word processing.
  • (ii) Mathematics:- Questions related to number system, computation of whole numbers, decimals and fractions, interrelationship between numbers, basic arithmetical operations, percentage, ratio and proportion, average, interest and profit and loss.
  • Section (c):- Mental Ability Test:- Both verbal and non-verbal types of questions may be asked such as- analogy, similarity and difference, space visualization, problem solving, analysis, visual memory, discrimination, observation, relationship concept, arithmetical reasoning, arithmetical number series, code writing and code interpretation, series, classification, mirror image, hidden figure, picture matrix, paper cutting, group images, shape construction and dice, analogy, analytical reasoning, water image, pattern completion, paper folding, rule detection, dot situation, picture formation and analysis.
  • 7. Merit List:-After passing the practical test examination, the merit list will be prepared by the Commission by adding the marks obtained in the written examination and the preference marks obtained on the basis of contract. In case of equal marks in the written examination, the merit list will be determined on the basis of marks obtained in General Studies subject. In case of equal marks in General Studies subject also, priority will be given to the marks obtained in General Science and Mathematics subject. If the marks in General Science and Mathematics subject are equal, the candidate with higher age will be placed higher in the merit order on the basis of date of birth and if the date of birth is the same, the candidate whose name comes first according to the alphabet in Devanagari script will be placed higher in the merit order. In this way the final merit list will be prepared.

How to Apply

  • (i) Candidates are not required to send hard copy of application form and related documents to the Commission office. If any supplementary documents or hard copy application is given by the candidate himself, then that hard copy application/documents and any claim made on its basis will not be admissible.
  • (ii) The examination will be conducted considering the educational qualification, technical qualification and reservation related claims filled in the online application by the candidates as true. The preliminary check of the certificates uploaded in the online application and matching with the original certificates will be done only at the time of document verification. Generally it will not be checked before that and if the certificates are not found correct in the later check, or the fact/evidence given by the candidate is found wrong/erroneous, then the application of the candidate will be cancelled and the decision of the Commission on this will be final and the candidate will have no objection on it. Also due to this, the candidate can be declared ineligible for present and future, the full responsibility of which will be of the candidate only.
  • (iii) Necessary (detailed) instructions related to filling online application are displayed on the official website of the Commission www.bpsc.bihar.gov.in.
  • Candidates will study the said guidelines well before filling the online application and will enter all the information correctly and clearly in the course of filling the online application.

Vacancy Details

Post Name No of Posts
Project Associate II 1

Eligibility Criteria

  • Desirable Qualification: Redcap database management

Salary/ Stipend

Age Limit (as on 20-01-2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 35 years (as of last date of receipt of applications)
  • Upper age relaxation for SC/ ST up to 5 years and OBC and women up to 3 years.

Important Dates

Notification Date 31 December 2025
Walk-in Date 20 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Written test (areas which will be covered) specify approx. syllabus: Basic knowledge of cancer, knowledge about clinical research, GCP, patient care-related skills, consenting process, drug storage
  • Interview: As above, ability to interact and respond to situations in clinical research and patient management.

General Information / Instructions

  1. Validity the appointment will be purely 1 year from the date of publication and renewable accordingly.
  2. Qualification and experience should in relevant discipline/field and from an institute of reputation. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification.
  3. Upper age relaxation for SC/ ST up to 5 years and OBC and women up to 3 years.
  4. The posts are purely on temporary/contractual basis for the specified period of time and based on project no calm for ny other regular post in JIPMER shall be entertained.
  5. Application form dully filled and signed along with a photocopy of all relevant certificates including experience along with one set of self-attested copies should be submitted in the office on the day of Walk in-interview.
  6. Decision of the principal investigator will be final.
  7. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
  8. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification.
  9. Submission of wrong or false information during the process of selection shall disqualify the candidature at any stage.
  10. If the performance of the appointee is not found satisfactory by the investigator, the appointment can be terminated at any time without any notice.
  11. The appointment may be relived from the current job position, with one-month prior notice, failing to do so may be held responsible for paying one month's salary.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Computer Knowledge: Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967 is required. Candidates must have a certificate/marksheet of basic computer knowledge from any training institute, or diploma/degree with computer as a subject, or passed Standard 10/12 with computer subject.
  • Language Knowledge: Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both is required.
  • Citizenship: Candidate must be a citizen of India or possess nationality as per the provisions of Rule-7 of Gujarat Civil Service Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967.

Salary/Stipend

  • For the first five years: Fixed salary of Rs. 26,000/- per month as per Finance Department Resolution dated 18/10/2023.
  • After five years of satisfactory service: Regular appointment in Pay Level-2 (Rs. 19,900/- to Rs. 63,200/-) as per 7th Pay Commission.
  • All other benefits as per government resolutions will be applicable.
  • The appointment is subject to the judgment of Supreme Court in SLP No. 14124/2012 and SLP No. 14125/2012.

  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Men: 10 years (maximum age 43 years)
  • Age Relaxation for General Category PwD Women: 15 years (10+5) (maximum age 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Men: 15 years (5+10) (maximum age 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Reserved Category PwD Women: 20 years (5+10+5) (maximum age 45 years)
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Period of service rendered plus three years beyond the upper age limit.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on a one-stage competitive examination through MCQ (Multiple Choice Question) type Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / OMR method.
  • The examination will be conducted in two parts: Part-A and Part-B.
  • Part-A (90 Marks): Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (30 marks), Constitution, Current Affairs, English and Gujarati Comprehension (30 marks).
  • Part-B (120 Marks): Questions related to technical qualification and its applications.
  • Total 210 questions will be asked for 210 marks.
  • Total time allotted: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined.
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 mark will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Minimum Qualifying Standard: 40% for both Part-A and Part-B separately.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the competitive examination.
  • Candidates equal to approximately two times the number of vacancies will be called for certificate verification based on provisional merit list.
  • Final selection will be made based on merit and office preference given by candidates.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the entire advertisement carefully before applying online.
  • Only online applications will be accepted through OJAS website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
  • Candidates must have all original certificates (educational qualification, age, caste, disability, ex-servicemen, etc.) with them while filling the online application.
  • Candidates should carefully verify all details from their certificates and fill accurate information in the online application.
  • Any incorrect or false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage.
  • The Board reserves the right to modify or cancel this advertisement at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • All instructions and updates regarding the recruitment process will be published on the Board's website https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.
  • Candidates must keep checking the Board's website regularly for updates.
  • The mobile number and email ID provided in the application must remain active throughout the recruitment process.
  • Candidates must upload a recent passport size photograph with white background taken within one year before the last date of application.
  • The same photograph must be used at all stages of recruitment including examination hall ticket and certificate verification.
  • Multiple applications from the same candidate will result in cancellation of all except the last confirmed application.
  • Gujarat Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2023 is applicable to all examinations conducted by GSSSB.
  • Candidates found guilty of unfair means will face legal action as per the Act.

How to Apply

  • Visit the official OJAS website: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Click on "Online Application" and select GSSSB.
  • Select Advertisement No. 357/202526 for Draftsman, Class-3 and click on Apply.
  • Click on "More Details" to read the detailed advertisement.
  • Click on "Apply Now" to open the application form.
  • Fill in Personal Details carefully (fields with red asterisk * are mandatory).
  • Fill in Educational Details accurately.
  • Accept the Assurance (Guarantee) by selecting "Yes" and click "Save".
  • An Application Number will be generated after saving. Note down this number for future reference.
  • Upload recent passport size photograph (white background) and signature in JPG format (not exceeding 15 KB).
  • Photo size: 5 cm height and 3.6 cm width; Signature size: 2.5 cm height and 7.5 cm width.
  • After uploading photo and signature, click on "Confirm Application" and verify all details.
  • Make corrections if necessary before confirming. No changes can be made after confirmation.
  • After confirming, a Confirmation Number will be generated. Save this number.
  • Pay the examination fee online through Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallets by 02/02/2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Take printout of the application form and fee receipt for future reference.
  • Download the Call Letter/Hall Ticket when notification is published on the Board's website.

The National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU), a prestigious Institution of National Importance operating under the Ministry of Home Affairs, has announced a significant recruitment drive for 28 various non-academic positions. The university is seeking qualified Indian Nationals to fill key administrative, engineering, and library roles across its numerous campuses nationwide. This direct recruitment offers an opportunity to join a leading forensic sciences institution, with all applications required to be submitted online via the official Samarth Portal between December 18, 2025, and January 18, 2026.

The advertised positions span multiple pay levels and departments, including vital roles like Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Deputy and Assistant Engineers (Civil/Electrical), Statistical Assistant, and library cadre staff. Candidates with the required educational qualifications and relevant experience are encouraged to apply. The selection process involves either an interview or a written test depending on the post applied for, and successful candidates should note that appointment is transferable across any of the NFSU's campuses nationwide, including Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, and Bhopal.

The total number of vacancies for NFSU Recruitment 2025 is 28 posts, distributed across Non-Academic and Library Cadre positions as follows:

Academic Pay. PwBD reservation is horizontal and adjusted against respective categories.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility varies by position, encompassing educational qualifications, age limits, and experience requirements.

1. Educational Qualification & Experience

  • Deputy Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 9 years experience as Assistant Professor (Level 10+) or 5 years as Assistant Registrar or equivalent.
  • Assistant Registrar: Master’s Degree with 55% marks, plus 3 years experience in relevant university fields (Procurement/HR/Academics/Accounts/Examinations).
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil): Bachelor’s in Civil Engineering (55%) (Master's preferred), plus 2 years relevant experience.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical): Bachelor’s in Civil/Electrical Engineering (55%). Master’s degree is desirable.
  • Statistical Assistant: Bachelor Degree with Statistics as a special subject.
  • Assistant Librarian: Master’s Degree in Library Science (55%), consistently good academic record, and must have cleared UGC NET/SLET/SET or hold a Ph.D. as per regulations.
  • Library Assistant: Bachelor’s degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent, typing speed 30 wpm in English, and computer knowledge.

2. Age Limit

Age is determined as of the closing date of application:

  • Deputy Registrar: Not more than 50 years.
  • Assistant Registrar / Deputy Engineer (Civil) / Assistant Librarian: Not more than 40 years.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) / Statistical Assistant: 21 to 35 years.
  • Library Assistant: Not more than 32 years.

Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen candidates as per Government of India rules. The upper age limit is not applicable to existing government/university employees.

3. Nationality

Candidates must be citizens of India.

Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable:

  • General/EWS/OBC Candidates: ₹500/- + GST & transaction charges.
  • SC/ST Category, PwBD, and Women candidates: Exempted from paying the application fee.

Salary/Stipend

Posts fall under the 7th Pay Matrix system. Based on general Government of India norms for these levels, the approximate starting basic pay ranges are:

  • Deputy Registrar (Level 12): Basic Pay approx. ₹78,800 per month.
  • Assistant Registrar / Assistant Librarian (Level 10 / Academic Level 10): Basic Pay approx. ₹56,100 per month.
  • Deputy Engineer (Civil) (Level 9): Basic Pay approx. ₹53,100 per month.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil/Electrical) (Level 8): Basic Pay approx. ₹47,600 per month.
  • Statistical Assistant (Level 5): Basic Pay approx. ₹29,200 per month.
  • Library Assistant (Level 4): Basic Pay approx. ₹25,500 per month.

Selected candidates will receive basic pay within the respective pay matrix level, plus other admissible allowances as per government norms.

Selection Process

  • For Sr. No. 01, 02, and 07 (Registrar & Librarian posts): Selection will be based on overall record and performance in an interview. A screening test may be conducted to shortlist candidates.
  • For Sr. No. 03, 04, 05, 06, and 08 (Engineer & Assistant posts): Selection will be based on merit in a written test. The university may conduct a screening test to shortlist candidates.
  • Original documents must be produced at the time of interview/document verification.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for NFSU Recruitment 2025 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the NFSU Samarth Portal link: https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.
  2. Fill in the online application form with correct details.
  3. Upload all required documents (Photo, Signature, Certificates, Category Certificates/NOC, etc.).
  4. Pay the application fee online if applicable.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications and fees for each post.

Important Dates

Advertisement Date 18/12/2025
Online Application Start Date (Portal Open) 18/12/2025 (12:00 PM IST)
Online Application End Date (Last Date for Submission) 18/01/2026 (11:59 PM IST)

Instructions

The positions are for direct recruitment and candidates will be on probation for two years as per university norms. Selected candidates may be posted at any of the NFSU Campuses across India (Gandhinagar, Delhi, Goa, Agartala, Bhopal, Dharwad, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Raipur, Nagpur, Chennai, Jaipur) and positions are transferable across all campuses. No TA/DA will be paid for attending tests or interviews. Candidates in service must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview.

Post Name Senior Scientific Officer, Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant, Laboratory Assistant (various scientific/technical positions)
No of Posts 30 (06 Scientific/Technical posts + 24 Laboratory Assistants)
Salary Senior Scientific Officer – Pay Level 10; Junior Scientific Officer – Pay Level 7; Senior Scientific Assistant – Pay Level 6; Laboratory Assistant – Pay Level 5 as per 7th CPC.
Qualification Ph.D./Master’s degrees in relevant disciplines for scientific posts; Bachelor’s degree in specified science/forensic subjects for Laboratory Assistant as per post-wise criteria.
Age Limit Up to 40 years (Senior Scientific Officer), 35 years (Junior Scientific Officer), 30 years (Senior Scientific Assistant), and 27 years (Laboratory Assistant), with relaxations as per GoI norms.
Start Date for Apply  18/12/2025 (Samarth portal opens at 12:00 PM IST)
Last Date for Apply  18/01/2026 (Samarth portal closes at 11:59 PM IST)
Official Website https://nfsu.ac.in

NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

Name of the Post Pay Level Total Posts
Senior Scientific Officer (Centre of Excellence in Investigative Forensic Psychology) Level 10 01
Senior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing) Level 10 01
Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing) Level 7 01
Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics) Level 7 01
Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics) Level 7 01
Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics) Level 6 01
Laboratory Assistant Level 5 24#

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior Scientific Officer (both Centres): Not more than 40 years of age; Ph.D. in relevant discipline OR Master’s degree in Forensic Psychology/Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or other Psychology discipline; Ph.D. holders need minimum 2 years’ experience, Master’s degree holders need minimum 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible government/research/forensic/industry organizations; desirable experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Centre for Happiness and Wellbeing): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Psychology/Criminology/Neuropsychology/Forensic/Clinical/Investigative Psychology or any Psychology/Forensic Psychology discipline or Master’s in Forensic Science with specialization in Psychology/Criminology; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant fields in government/research/forensic labs or industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research experience; desirable Ph.D. and experience in polygraph, BEOS, SDS, Eye Detect & LVA.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 35 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR Master’s in Computer Science/IT/Electronics/Physics/Forensic Science (with physical sciences)/Cyber Forensics/Digital Forensics/Information Security/Cyber Security/Multimedia Forensics/ICT/AI/Data Science/Cyber Security Management; 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field in forensic labs/recognised institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., familiarity with forensic audio-video tools and FSL experience.
  • Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics): Not more than 35 years; Master’s in Zoology/Microbiology/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Biology/Life/Biological Sciences/Forensic Biotechnology/Forensic Science (Biology/Biotechnology) OR BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology; 3 years’ analytical/research experience in relevant field in government/recognised labs/research institutes/industry; Ph.D. full-time counts as max 3 years’ research; desirable Ph.D., knowledge of forensic DNA technology and FSL experience.
  • Senior Scientific Assistant (Multimedia Forensics): Not more than 30 years; BE/B.Tech in CSE/ECE/IT/Electronics/EEE/Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security) OR same set of relevant Master’s degrees as JSO (Multimedia Forensics) with Forensic Science (physical sciences) eligibility; desirable experience with forensic audio-video tools and FSL work.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Age between 18 and 27 years (relaxable for Govt. servants up to 40 years); Bachelor’s Degree in any one of Physics, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physical Anthropology, Genetics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pharmacy, Forensic Science or Criminology from a recognised University/Institute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Senior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 10 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix with corresponding monthly pay and allowances as per NFSU/GoI rules.
  • Junior Scientific Officer posts are in Pay Level 7; Senior Scientific Assistant in Pay Level 6; Laboratory Assistant in Pay Level 5, all with pay and allowances as applicable to NFSU technical staff.
  • All posts are regular direct recruitment positions with probation and service conditions as per University norms.

Age Limit (as on 18-01-2026)

  • The date for determining eligibility including age shall be the prescribed closing date for submission of online application i.e. 18/01/2026.
  • Upper age: 40 years for Senior Scientific Officer; 35 years for all Junior Scientific Officer posts; 30 years for Senior Scientific Assistant; 18–27 years for Laboratory Assistant with relaxation for Government servants up to 40 years.
  • Upper age limit relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/Disabled/Ex-servicemen as per Government of India rules; current employees of Central/State/UT Government/University/Board/Corporation are exempt from the specified upper age limit for some posts as mentioned.

Application Fee

  • Gen/EWS/OBC category applicants: Rs. 500/- plus GST and applicable transaction charges; application fee is non-refundable.
  • SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.
  • Separate online applications with separate fees must be submitted for each post applied.

Selection Process

  • Selection for Senior Scientific Officer posts (Sr. No. 1 and 2) will be based on overall record and performance in interview; University may conduct a screening test and/or apply higher qualification/experience norms to shortlist candidates.
  • Selection for Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant and Laboratory Assistant posts (Sr. No. 3 to 7) will be based on merit of marks obtained in written test; University may conduct a screening test and/or shortlist based on experience.
  • Call letters for screening test/written test/interview will be sent only to shortlisted candidates via email/Samarth portal; interviews will be conducted only in physical mode.
  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD will be as per Government of India norms, including latest requirements for OBC-NCL (non-creamy layer) and EWS certificates issued on/after 01-04-2025.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens and must apply only through the online Samarth portal; incomplete applications or those without requisite documents will not be considered.
  • Experience will be counted only from the date of acquiring the essential qualification; qualifications from UGC-recognised universities or approved institutions only are considered valid.
  • The University reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all posts, to withdraw or modify the advertisement, and to increase or decrease the number of posts without notice.
  • Reservation claims must be supported by valid certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD) issued within specified dates; PwBD disability must be permanent and at least 40%.
  • Age, educational qualification, experience, and other details will be verified at the time of interview/document verification; if documents are found false or candidates have suppressed information, services may be terminated.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending screening test/written test/interview; selected candidates may be posted at any NFSU Campus and transfers across campuses are possible.
  • All updates, corrigenda and communication regarding recruitment will be published only on NFSU website and/or sent via email; candidates must regularly check their email and Samarth dashboard.

How to Apply

  • Interested and eligible candidates must submit applications using the online Samarth portal accessible via NFSU website’s Career > Regular Recruitment section.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate online applications and pay the application fee separately for each post (if applicable).
  • Before applying, candidates should carefully read “Details of Minimum Qualification and Experience” and “Instructions to the Candidates” sections in the advertisement.
  • At interview/document verification, candidates must produce all original documents related to educational qualifications, category, experience and other essential requirements, along with self-attested copies.
  • Candidates already in service must submit No Objection Certificate and Vigilance Clearance from their employer at the time of interview/document verification as per rules.
  • For any queries, applicants may contact via email at [email protected]; online application link (Samarth) is https://nfsunt.samarth.edu.in.

NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the last date to apply for NFSU Scientific/Technical Posts Recruitment 2025?

Ans: The last date for submission of the online application through Samarth portal is 18 January 2026 up to 11:59 PM (IST).

2. How many vacancies are available under NFSU Technical Posts Advertisement No. NFSU/TECHNICAL POSTS/10/2025?

Ans: There are 30 vacancies in total, including Senior Scientific Officer, Junior Scientific Officer, Senior Scientific Assistant and 24 Laboratory Assistants.

3. What is the eligibility for Senior Scientific Officer posts at NFSU?

Ans: Candidates must have Ph.D. in relevant discipline with at least 2 years’ experience or Master’s degree in specified Psychology/Forensic disciplines with 5 years’ analysis/research experience in eligible organisations.

4. What is the eligibility for Junior Scientific Officer (Multimedia Forensics) at NFSU?

Ans: Candidates need BE/B.Tech in specified computing/electronics branches or relevant Master’s degrees in Computer/IT/Forensic/Cyber disciplines with 3 years’ analysis/research experience in relevant field.

5. What is the eligibility for Junior Scientific Officer (DNA Forensics) at NFSU?

Ans: Candidates must hold relevant Master’s degree in biological/forensic biotechnology fields or BE/B.Tech in Biotechnology with 3 years’ experience in analytical methods and research in relevant organisations.

6. What is the educational qualification for Laboratory Assistant at NFSU?

Ans: A Bachelor’s degree in subjects such as Physics, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physical Anthropology, Genetics, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Pharmacy, Forensic Science or Criminology from a recognised University/Institute.

7. What is the age limit for various NFSU Technical Posts?

Ans: Upper age is 40 years for Senior Scientific Officer, 35 years for Junior Scientific Officer, 30 years for Senior Scientific Assistant, and 18–27 years for Laboratory Assistant, with relaxations as per Government norms.

8. Is there any application fee for NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Gen/EWS/OBC candidates must pay Rs. 500/- plus GST and transaction charges; SC/ST, PwBD and Women candidates are exempted from application fee.

9. What is the selection process for NFSU Technical Posts?

Ans: Senior Scientific Officer posts are filled based on interview performance and overall record; other posts are filled based on written test merit, with possible screening tests and shortlisting.

10. How can candidates apply for NFSU Technical Posts Recruitment 2025?

Ans: Candidates must apply online only through the NFSU Samarth portal accessible via the University’s Regular Recruitment page, submitting separate applications and fees for each post.

Post Name Total Vacancies

Category-wise Reservation

Social Category UB AB
OBC/MOBC 27% 27%
