Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Constable (UB): Higher Secondary (HS) or Class XII passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Constable (AB): HSLC or Class X passed from Government recognized Board or Council
  • Applicants having educational qualification of Higher Secondary and above may apply for both Armed Branch and Unarmed Branch with clear preference indication

Essential Requirements

  • Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam
  • Must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam
  • Must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently
  • Selected applicants will have to submit Proof of Residence after publication of Final Select List (SC, ST, OBC/MOBC exempted)

Experience

  • For Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers: Minimum 1 year service certificate required for reservation quota benefit; Minimum 3 years service for age relaxation
  • For SPOs: Appointment Certificate required for reservation and age relaxation benefits
  • For FMMOs: Certificate issued by Special Branch, HQrs. of Assam Police, Kahilipara, Guwahati required

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 14,000 - 70,000/- per month
  • Grade Pay: Rs. 5,600/-
  • Other Benefits: Allowances as admissible under the Rules
  • Pension Benefits: Selected applicants shall be entitled to pension benefits as per the pension scheme existing at the time of appointment

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years (Applicants born not later than 01-01-2008)
  • Maximum Age: 25 years (Applicants born not before 01-01-2001)

Age Relaxation

  • SC, ST(P) and ST(H): 5 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • OBC/MOBC: 3 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Home Guards/VDP/Civil Defence Volunteers (served 3 years or more): Additional 3 years relaxation
  • Former Members of Militant Organization (FMMOs)/SPOs: Additional 10 years relaxation
  • Age will be calculated based on Matriculation/HSLC Admit Card or Certificate issued by recognized Board/Council only
  • No other documents like Horoscope, Affidavit, Birth Extract etc. will be accepted for age proof

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: NIL - There will be no Application Fee for this recruitment

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 05-12-2025
Online Application Start Date 16-12-2025
Online Application Last Date 16-01-2026
Edit Option Available (After Last Date) 5 days from 16-01-2026 (Only once, subject to SLPRB approval)
Last Date for Document Submission 16-01-2026 (All documents must be issued on or before this date)
Age Calculation Date As on 01-01-2026
PET & PST Date Will be notified later on official website
Written Test Date Will be notified later on official website
Viva-Voce Date Will be notified later on official website

Selection Process

  • Stage 1: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 marks for Constable (UB) Male & Female, 40 marks for Constable (AB) Female, 60 marks for Constable (AB) Male
  • Stage 2: Medical Examination - Applicants will be examined by Medical & Health Officer for mental and bodily health parameters
  • Stage 3: Physical Standard Test (PST) - Height and Chest measurement (No marks, qualifying in nature)
  • Stage 4: Written Test - 50 marks (100 MCQ questions, 0.5 marks each, no negative marking)
  • Stage 5: Oral/Viva-Voce - 5 marks
  • Academic Weightage: 5 marks (Only for Constable UB based on HS percentage)
  • Biometric verification will be conducted at entry, exit and during all stages of recruitment
  • Shortlisting for Written Test: 5 times the number of posts based on PET merit
  • Shortlisting for Viva-Voce: 2 times the number of vacancies based on PET + Written Test merit

Total Marks Distribution

  • Constable (UB) Male & Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) + Academic (5) = 100 marks
  • Constable (AB) Male: PET (60) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 115 marks
  • Constable (AB) Female: PET (40) + Written (50) + Viva (5) = 95 marks

Physical Standards

Category Male Height Female Height Male Chest (Normal) Male Chest (Expansion)
General/OBC/MOBC/SC/ST(P) 162.5 cm 154 cm Min. 80 cm +5 cm
ST(H) 160 cm 152 cm Min. 78 cm +5 cm

Medical Standards

  • Applicants must be in good mental and bodily health
  • Must be free from physical deformities and diseases like diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other without correction; Near vision should be normal
  • Varicose vein shall be considered as temporary disqualification

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicants must register in the application portal only once for all advertisements using single Application ID
  • Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Name must be entered exactly as per HSLC Certificate
  • Valid mobile number and email address must be provided and kept active throughout recruitment process
  • Documents required: Latest passport photo (max 450 KB), Signature (max 100 KB in black/blue ink), Age proof, Mark sheets, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • All documents uploaded must be issued on or before 16-01-2026
  • Caste Certificate must be from Competent Authority authorized by Govt. of Assam only
  • Admit Card and Identity Proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License) mandatory for PET & PST
  • CCTV surveillance and RFID chips will be used for Race events
  • Individual statement of marks signed by applicant and conducting officer will be provided
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for journey and stay during any stage of recruitment
  • The number of posts may increase or decrease at any time due to administrative reasons
  • Final appointment subject to satisfactory Police Verification and Medical Examination Report
  • Selected candidates must undergo basic police training and serve minimum 3 years after posting
  • Selected applicants will be required to work in any District or Unit anywhere in Assam
  • No payment required at any stage except medical investigations in Government Hospital if required
  • Anonymous complaints will not be entertained
  • Incomplete, defective or invalid applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidature will be rejected for providing wrong information, fake documents, misrepresentation or impersonation at any stage

Written Test Details

  • 100 Multiple Choice Questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Question level: Class IX and X standard
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, Assam's History/Geography/Polity/Economy, General Awareness/GK and Current Affairs
  • Languages Available: Assamese, Bodo, Bengali, English

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the SLPRB portal at www.slprbassam.in with valid mobile number (Register only once for all advertisements)
  • Step 2: Provide accurate information including Employment Exchange Number, Highest Qualification, Permanent District, Gender, Caste/Category, Date of Birth, and Aadhaar Number
  • Step 3: After successful registration, an Application ID will be generated - keep it safe for future reference
  • Step 4: Login using Application ID or Registered Mobile Number along with Date of Birth
  • Step 5: Apply for the relevant Advertisement (SLPRB/REC/CONST (AB & UB)/727/2025/94)
  • Step 6: Upload mandatory documents - Photograph (450 KB max), Signature (100 KB max), Age Proof, HSLC/HS Mark sheets and Certificates, Employment Exchange Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • Step 7: Upload additional documents if claiming reservation/quota benefits (Home Guard/VDP/SPO/FMMO/Sports/NCC certificates)
  • Step 8: Select post preferences clearly (UB/AB if applying for both)
  • Step 9: Fill in all personal and academic details carefully
  • Step 10: Generate OTP and download the Acknowledgement Slip
  • Step 11: Keep Acknowledgement Slip and Application ID safe for future reference
  • Edit option available for 5 days after last date (only once, subject to SLPRB approval) for inadvertent entry corrections
  • Bring all original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies on the day of PET & PST for verification
  • Detailed instructions available on SLPRB website at time of application submission

Important Dates

Description Date
Submission of online application starts from 09-01-2026
Last date for submission of online application 26-01-2026 till Office working hours
Last date for payment of fees 29-01-2026 till bank transaction hours

Selection Process

  • Stage-I Written examination: 120 marks The written examination (objective type multiple-choice) of 2 hours duration will be conducted on OMR sheets and will test the candidates' proficiency in English language, general knowledge, general aptitude, reasoning and Assamese language (20 marks).
  • The Assamese language proficiency segment will be of qualifying nature. Candidates securing at least 40% marks i.e. 8 out of 20 marks in the Assamese language proficiency segment shall be treated as qualified to appear in the next stage. The marks obtained in the Assamese language segment shall not be taken into account while preparing the merit list.
  • There shall be negative marking in the written examination. For every incorrect answer, 0.25 mark (one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question) will be deducted.
  • Interview/Viva-Voce: 20 marks Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the written examination will be called to appear in the Interview/Viva-Voce and verification of documents. A candidate must secure at least 60% i.e. 12 out of 20 marks in the Interview/Viva-Voce in order to be considered qualified.
  • Final selection will be made on the basis of the total marks obtained by the candidate in the written examination (Stage-I) and Interview/Viva-Voce (Stage-II). Where more than one candidate obtains same grand total marks, the candidate who obtains more marks in the written examination will get preference. Where the marks obtained by such candidates in the written examination are also same, then the candidate who is senior in age will get preference. The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or alter the cut off mark in written examination and Interview/Viva-Voce.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before applying online, candidates must possess a valid e-mail ID and Mobile Number which are mandatory for registration. E-mail ID should be kept active. Though the system is designed to send e-mail immediately acknowledging the Registration Code, sometimes due to network congestion, the e-mail may not be delivered, hence the candidates are requested to note down the Registration Code.
  • For any technical assistance for submission of online application forms please email to [email protected] mentioning the name of the post in the subject line and related Registration Code (if any), Applicant's name and Father's name indicating the grievance in the body of the e-mail. A copy of the email should also be sent to [email protected].
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances. The fee will also not be held in reserve for any other vacancies.
  • Candidates are advised in their own interest to apply online well before the last date and not to wait till the last date, so as to avoid heavy load on internet or website.
  • Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria will not entitle a candidate to be called for the written examination/Interview etc.
  • Candidates have to upload clear scanned copies of their documents/testimonials rather than submitting physical copies at the time of submission of online application. However, candidates have to produce their original testimonials regarding educational qualification, claim of reservation, date of birth, caste, working experience (if applicable), etc. at subsequent stages when asked for.
  • No person, who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living or who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for appointment to any of the aforementioned posts.
  • The admission of candidates at all stages of the selection process shall be purely provisional and subject to their satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. If, on verification at any time before or after the selection process, it is found that a candidate does not fulfil any of the eligibility condition, his/her candidature shall stand cancelled without any notice. Mere calling of candidate to written examination/Interview etc. or issuance of admits cards/call letter etc. does not mean acceptance of candidature of any candidate which shall be further scrutinized at every stage and the High Court reserves the right to reject the candidature of any candidate at any time.
  • The provisional list of the candidates and reject list (if any) will be published in the High Court website for the candidates' reference.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidate for appearing in any stages of the selection process.
  • Valid Disability Certificate for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), if applicable, must be issued by competent authority.
  • Candidates who are already in the Government Service in State/Central/PSU may apply after intimating their employers regarding submission of online application forms for the advertised vacancies. They shall have to produce \"No Objection Certificate\" from their present employer at the time of document verification and \"Release Order\" at the time of appointment.
  • The High Court may decide not to issue any admit card/call letter etc. to any candidate and may decide to call candidates to written examination/Interview etc. by publishing a notification in the official website and notice board of the High Court. Candidates are advised to visit the official website (www.ghconline.gov.in) of the High Court regularly for updates and important information. Unnecessary correspondence should be avoided.
  • Application form, which is incomplete in any respect, such as without the photograph and signature upload, is liable to be rejected summarily, unless otherwise decided by the High Court.
  • Any information submitted by an applicant in his/her application will bind the candidate personally. The candidate will be responsible for any mistake made by him/her in the application form and the High Court shall not be responsible or liable in any way.
  • The certificate for claim of benefit of reservation must be issued by the competent authority.
  • If any candidate is found canvassing directly or indirectly, his/her candidature will be rejected.
  • The High Court reserves the right to cancel the advertisement, alter any terms and conditions of the advertisement at any stage.
  • The answer keys of the question paper for the written examination will be uploaded in the Official Website after the examination for reference.
  • The examination materials will be destroyed following the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) laid down in Notification No. 50 dated 26-06-2025 issued by the High Court.
  • All other matters which are not specifically provided in this advertisement shall be as decided by the High Court.

How to Apply

  • Log on through the website https://ghconline.gov.in and click on 'Online application for the post of Judicial Assistant in the Principal Seat of the Gauhati High Court'.

Eligibility Criteria for Special Assam TET 2026

Basic Eligibility Requirements

A. Residency: Candidates must be permanent residents of Assam.

B. Academic and Professional Qualifications: Candidates must meet NCTE-prescribed minimum qualifications.

Minimum Qualification for Lower Primary TET (Classes I to V)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  3. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education)
  4. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education

Minimum Qualification for Upper Primary TET (Classes VI to VIII)

Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications:

  1. Graduation + 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education
  2. At least 50% marks in Graduation + B.Ed.
  3. At least 55% marks in Post Graduation (or equivalent grade) + 3-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.
  4. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)
  5. Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks + 4-year B.A./B.Sc. Ed. or B.A. Ed./B.Sc. Ed.
  6. Graduation with at least 50% marks + 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education)

Important Note: Minimum percentage requirements in graduation do not apply to candidates who took admission to B.Ed. or B.El.Ed. or equivalent courses before July 29, 2011.

Relaxation in Eligibility

  • 5% relaxation in academic marks (HSSLC or Graduation) for SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) candidates
  • PWD candidates must have a minimum 40% degree of handicap certified by competent authority

Exam Pattern and Structure

Total 150 MCQs 150

Exam Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes) for each paper Additional Time: 20 minutes per hour for visually impaired candidates Marking Scheme: Each question carries 1 mark Negative Marking: No negative marking

Qualifying Marks for Special Assam TET 2026

For General Category Candidates

  • Overall: 60% (90 marks out of 150)
  • Language-1 Section: 60% (18 marks out of 30)

For SC/ST/OBC/MOBC/PWD(PH) Candidates

  • Overall: 55% (83 marks out of 150) - 5% relaxation
  • Language-1 Section: 50% (15 marks out of 30) - 10% relaxation

Both conditions must be satisfied to qualify the examination.

Exam Centers

  1. Cachar
  2. Dibrugarh
  3. Kokrajhar
  4. Kamrup

  1. Visit the official website: https://sebaonline.org
  2. Read instructions carefully for submitting the online application

    • Signature

  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference

Important Application Guidelines

  • Portal opens on January 7, 2026
  • Exact dates for application submission and admit card release will be notified separately
  • Incomplete forms will be summarily rejected
  • No corrections will be entertained after submission
  • Carefully verify all details before final submission

Medium of Question Papers

The question papers will be available in the following languages:

Validity of Certificate

The Special Assam TET 2026 certificate will remain valid for lifetime from the date of issue by the Empowered Committee, TET, Government of Assam (unless otherwise notified by the appropriate government).

Important Points to Remember

  1. No Automatic Appointment: Qualifying the Special Assam TET 2026 does not confer automatic right to appointment. Teacher recruitment in government/provincialized schools is a separate process conducted when vacancies arise.
  2. Document Verification: No document verification during examination. However, documents will be thoroughly verified during the teacher engagement process. False information can lead to criminal liability.
  3. State-Specific Validity: Qualified candidates can participate in teacher recruitment processes only in Assam.
  4. TET as Qualifying Criteria: TET is one of the qualifying criteria for teacher recruitment. Candidates must also meet other academic and professional qualifications as per NCTE norms.
  5. Both Papers: Candidates intending to appear in both Paper I and Paper II must submit separate applications and pay fees for each paper separately.
  6. Regular Updates: Candidates should regularly visit the official websites for updates on application dates, admit cards, and examination schedules.

Kashmir University has released an official notification for the recruitment of 11 Non Teaching Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Offline through the official Kashmir University website. The last date to submit the application form is 30-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the Kashmir University Non Teaching Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Offline application form.

CUK Various Non-Teaching Posts Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Central University of Kashmir (CUK)
Post Name Various Non-Teaching Posts
No of Posts 11
Salary Level-2 to Level-14 of 7th CPC
Qualification Master's Degree/ Bachelor's Degree
Age Limit Not exceeding 32 to 58 years
Start Date 5 January 2026
Last Date 30 January 2026
Official Website www.cukashmir.ac.in

Vacancy Details

Name of the Post No. of posts
Finance Officer 01-UR (Tenure Post)
Controller of Examinations 01-UR (Tenure Post)
Deputy Librarian 01-UR
Internal Audit Officer 01-UR (Deputation)
Executive Engineer (Civil) 01-UR (Deputation/Contract.)
Private Secretary 01-OBC
Personal Assistant 02 (01-UR,01-OBC)
Laboratory Assistant 01-UR
Lower Division Clerk 02 (UR-01, SC-01)
Total 11

Eligibility Criteria

  • Finance Officer
  • Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed.
  • At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor along with experience in the educational administration.
  • Comparable experience in research establishment and / or other institutions of higher education.
  • 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post.
  • Controller of Examinations
  • Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed.
  • At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above or with 8 years of service in the Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor along with experience in the educational administration.
  • Comparable experience in research establishment and / or other institutions of higher education.
  • 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post.
  • Deputy Librarian
  • Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed.
  • 08 years' experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian.
  • Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library.
  • A Ph.D. Degree in Library Science/Information Science/Documentation Science/ Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library.
  • Internal Audit Officer
  • By drawing officers belonging to Audit and Accounts Services or other similar organized Accounts Services in Central / State Govt., holding analogous posts on regular basis.
  • with 03 years regular service in Level 11 or equivalent in the area of Audit and Accounts in any Govt. Department/ Autonomous Bodies.
  • with 05 years regular service in Level 10 or equivalent in the area of Audit and Accounts in any Govt. Department/ Autonomous Bodies
  • Executive Engineer (Civil)
  • First Class Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized Institute/ University or equivalent.
  • Eight years of experience as Assistant Engineer in the relevant field from CPWD/State Government PWD services or similar organized services/Semi Government/PSU/Statutory or Autonomous organization/University System or reputed private organizations with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200/-Crores or more.
  • Officers holding analogous post or one below category with 3 years experience in the CPWD/State Government PWD services or similar organized services/ Semi Government/ PSU/ Statutory or Autonomous Organisation/University System.
  • Private Secretary
  • A Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University/Institute.
  • At least 03 years experience as Personal Assistant or 5 years as Stenographer in a University/ Research establishment/ Central/ State Govt./ PSU and other autonomous bodies.
  • English/Hindi Stenography speed: 120 wpm in English or 100 wpm in Hindi.
  • English/Hindi typing speed: 35 wpm in English or 30 wpm in Hindi.
  • Knowledge of computer applications.
  • Personal Assistant
  • Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from any recognized Institute/ University.
  • Proficiency in Stenography in English or Hindi with minimum speed of 100 wpm.
  • Proficiency in Typing in English or Hindi with minimum speed of 35/30 wpm respectively.
  • Knowledge of Computer Applications.
  • Two years experience as Stenographer or equivalent in Central State Govt. Organisations / University Research Institution or Central / State autonomous Institution/ reputed private institutions having a turnover 200 Crores.
  • Laboratory Assistant
  • Bachelor's degree with a minimum of two years of working and maintenance experience of electronics and instrumentation equipment in a Laboratory. However, the relevant subject will be as decided by the university as per the functional requirement of the department concerned.
  • The experience should be in University/ Research establishment/Central/ State Government/ PSU and other autonomous bodies or Private organization or repute with annual turnover of at least Rs. 200/- Crores or more.
  • Lower Division Clerk
  • A Bachelor's Degree from any recognized Institute/ University.
  • English Typing @ 35 wpm OR Hindi Typing @ 30 wpm (35wpm and 30wpm correspond to 10500KDPH/ 9000KDPH on an average of 5 Key depressions for each work).
  • Proficiency in Computer Operations.

Salary / Stipend

  • Finance Officer: Level-14 of 7th CPC
  • Controller of Examinations: Level-14 of 7th CPC
  • Deputy Librarian: Academic Level-13A of 7th CPC
  • Internal Audit Officer: Level-12 of 7th CPC
  • Executive Engineer (Civil): Pay Matrix Level-11 of 7th CPC
  • Private Secretary: Level-7 of 7th CPC
  • Personal Assistant: Level-6 of 7th CPC
  • Laboratory Assistant: Level-4 of 7th CPC
  • Lower Division Clerk: Level-2 of 7th CPC

Age Limit (as on 30-01-2026)

  • Finance Officer: Preferably below 57 Years / Not exceeding 58 years
  • Controller of Examinations: Preferably below 57 Years / Not exceeding 58 years
  • Deputy Librarian: 62 years
  • Internal Audit Officer: Not exceeding 56 years
  • Executive Engineer (Civil): Not exceeding 56 years
  • Private Secretary: Not exceeding 35 years
  • Personal Assistant: Not exceeding 35 years
  • Laboratory Assistant: Not exceeding 32 years
  • Lower Division Clerk: Not exceeding 32 years

Application Fee

S.No. Category Amount
1. UR/Open Rs. 1500/-
2. OBC/EWS Rs. 750/-
3. SC/ST/PwD/Women Exempted

Important Dates

S. No. Particulars Date
1. Date of availability of online application form 5 January 2026
2. Last date for submission of online application form with fees 30 January 2026
3. Last date for submission of downloaded copies of the application form along with enclosures/documents 6 February 2026

Selection Process

  • The University shall conduct written test at two stages for Group B and C posts (i) An objective type test (Paper I) carrying 100 marks, and (ii) a descriptive-type test (Paper II) carrying 100 marks.
  • The minimum qualifying marks to be secured in Paper I shall be 40%. The answer scripts of the candidates for the descriptive test shall be evaluated only in respect of those candidates who secure the minimum qualifying marks in Paper I. The candidates who secure 50% marks in Paper II shall be called for the skill test/interview, wherever applicable.
  • The marks allocated for the skill test, wherever applicable, shall be 50 and the minimum qualifying marks in the skill test shall be 25. The merit list of the candidates shall be drawn based on the performance in Paper I (Objective Type Test) and Paper II (Descriptive test) and Interview (wherever applicable) subject to qualifying the skill test, wherever applicable.
  • Notwithstanding the above, the University at its discretion may hold single written test (Descriptive Test) and skill test, wherever applicable, depending upon the number of candidates, job requirements (such as posts under Technical/Laboratory services, Engineering, Information and Communication Technology, Library services etc.)

General Information / Instructions

1. All the appointees including the in-service candidates shall be governed by the New Pension System (NPS) introduced by Govt of India.
2. The age of superannuation for the post of Finance Officer, Controller of Examinations and the Deputy Librarian is 62 years, whereas the age of superannuation for other non-teaching posts mentioned in this notification is 60 years.
3. Candidates who are already in service shall submit their applications through proper channel along with vigilance clearance certificate from the Competent Authority. However, they may send an advance copy of the applications and in case their application is not forwarded due to whatever reasons till the time of interview as the case may be, they shall not be allowed to appear in the interview as a candidate through proper channel.
4. For all those appointments made on deputation basis the University, however, shall have the right to repatriate the incumbent at any time even before the prescribed period in case his/her performance, integrity or conduct is found to be unsatisfactory, in the opinion of the Competent Authority.
5. For the post of Finance Officer, Controller of Examinations and Executive Engineer, applications from eligible interested candidates, shall be sent through proper channel duly forwarded by their respective Administrative Heads to the Registrar Central University of Kashmir, Ganderbal (J&K), 191131. Applications not routed through proper channel for the aforementioned posts shall not be considered. Applications for appointment on deputation/direct recruitment must be forwarded by the employer along with the Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs) for the preceding three years and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate, duly certified by the Competent Authority.
6. For the post of Internal Audit Officer application form from eligible interested candidates, may be sent through proper channel through their Administrative Heads to the Registrar Central University of Kashmir, Ganderbal (J&K), 191131. Applications not routed through proper channel for the post of Internal Audit Officer shall not be considered. The application for appointment on deputation shall be forwarded by the employer along with the Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs) for the preceding five years and Vigilance Clearance Certificate, duly certified by the Competent Authority.
7. Candidate appointed to the post of Internal Audit Officer is purely on deputation basis and shall not have any claim for the permanent appointment at this University.
8. Appointment on deputation for the post of Internal Audit Officer shall be made initially for a period of two years, which may be extended further at the discretion of the Competent Authority subject to the satisfactory performance.
10. It shall be the responsibility of the candidates to assess their eligibility for the posts for which they are applying in accordance with the prescribed qualifications, experience, etc. and submit their applications, along with the desired information and documents as per the advertisement. Suppression of factual information, supply of fake documents or misleading information or canvassing in any manner on the part of the candidates shall lead to their disqualification.
11. Documents submitted by an applicant shall be subject to verification by the Competent Authority at any time even after joining the employment. If any document is found to be false/fake/incorrect either before or after the appointment, the document shall be summarily rejected and action under rules shall be initiated against the candidate which shall lead even to the cancellation of the appointment.
12. Appointment under OBC quota is provisional and is subject to the community certificate being verified through the proper channels. If the verification reveals that the claim of the candidates belonging to Other Backward Classes or not to belonging to creamy layer is false, their services will be terminated forthwith without assigning any further reasons and without prejudice to such further action as may be taken under the provisions of Indian Penal Code for production of false certificates.
13. Candidates seeking reservation under OBC category are required to upload certificate on the format prescribed by the Government of India, Department of Personnel & Training (Annexure-I). Further, they shall submit the declaration given at the end of the application form.
14. The Caste/Tribe/Community certificates in the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36012/6/88-Estt. (SCT), dated 24.4.1990 and OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt. (Res.), dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidates claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class. Relevant Caste/Tribe/Community certificates are required to be uploaded with duly completed application form. No other certificate will be accepted as a sufficient proof. The caste of the candidate must be in the state-wise central list of SCs given at http://socialjustice.nic.in/UserView/PrintUserView?mid=76750 OR http://socialjustice.nic.in/UserView/index?mid=76750 The caste of the candidate must be in the state-wise central list of STs given at https://tribal.nic.in/ST/LatestListofScheduledtribes.pdf
15. OBC certificate submitted in support of the claim of reservation under this category (Non-Creamy Layer) must have been issued on or after January, 2021. The certificate should clearly mention that the candidate belongs to non-creamy layer and the caste of the candidate must be in the state-wise central list of OBCs given at http://www.ncbc.nic.in/User_Panel/CentralListStateView.aspx.
16. Candidates shall bring all the original certificates relating to their age, qualifications, experience, etc., at the time of tests/ interview. In case a candidate/s fails to submit the original documents for the verification, he/she may not be allowed to appear in the test/interview and his/her candidature shall be cancelled without giving any further communication/explanation in this regard.
17. A person appointed against any post shall be governed by the Act/Statutes/Ordinances/Rules of the University and also the CCS (conduct) Rules, 1964, CCS (CCA) Rule, 1965 or any other rules of the Government of India, as amended from time to time and any other rule/resolution prescribed specifically for maintaining the conduct of the employees by the Executive Council of the University.
18. The Appointment of candidates shall be subject to the verification of character and antecedents by the Competent Authority. Until the receipt of such verification reports, the appointment shall be treated as provisional. In case the report/s with regard to the conduct, character, antecedents etc., is/are found to be unsatisfactory, the appointment shall be cancelled/ terminated forthwith.
19. Canvassing in any form on behalf of any candidate shall be treated as disqualification which shall lead to the cancellation of candidature.
20. The reservation for SC/ST/OBC/ PWD candidates has been arrived at as per the Govt of India rules.
21. Requirement of experience wherever mentioned in this advertisement shall mean post-qualification experience only. However, in case the number of eligible candidates against any post is found to be less, the University reserves the right to consider the pre-qualification experience and other experiences also.
22. The recruitment to the advertised posts shall be carried out in accordance with the prevalent UGC/University/Gol norms.
23. The University shall strictly follow the norms of the Government of India in respect of reservation/relaxation/concessions to various categories in recruitment pertaining to age, qualifying marks, experience/fees, etc. as amended from time to time.
24. Besides, all the other conditions as prescribed in the Cadre Recruitment Rules (CRR)-notified by the UGC/MoE/University along with amendments from time to time and not mentioned in the advertisement shall be deemed to have been included on the conditions associated with this advertisement.
25. The Selection Committee has the discretion to fill or not to fill up the posts advertised by the University in this notification due to non-availability of suitable candidate/s or any other reasons. No candidate/s reserves any claim for filling the vacancies mentioned in this advertisement.
26. Application Fee: All applications must be accompanied by a non-refundable processing fee or processes prescribed through online mode.
27. Candidates, who wish to apply for more than one post, should apply separately for each post and separate application must be submitted for each post along with requisite fees.
28. The date for determining eligibility of candidates in every respect i.e. qualifications, experience etc. shall be considered as on the closing date, i.e. the last date of the submission of the online application form. However, preferred age limit shall be considered on the issuance date of notification.
29. All the relevant information/ updates shall be uploaded on University website. The candidates are advised to remain in-touch with the University website www.cukashmir.ac.in and notifying the same in newspapers shall not be obligatory on University part.
30. The Institute shall retain the application forms of non-shortlisted candidates and non-selected candidates only for three months after the completion of recruitment process.
31. For those candidates who are in service (Govt. / Semi Govt. / PSUs / Universities / Educational Institutions), their application/s must be forwarded through proper channel, as prescribed and should furnish “No Objection Certificate” from the Competent Authority of the serving organization along with the forwarding letter at the time of presentation and/or interview otherwise they may not be allowed to appear in the skill test/presentation and/or interview as a candidate through proper channel. However, they may submit the advance copy of the application form to be considered otherwise.
32. All updates to this advertisement including corrigendum, amendment, if any, will be hosted on the University website only and the candidates are advised to check the website periodically for updates. No separate communication would be ordinarily dispatched.
33. Relaxation of 5% shall be provided, (from 55% to 50% of the marks) to the Ph.D. Degree holders who have obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19 September, 1991.
34. A relevant grade which is regarded as equivalent of 55%, wherever the grading system is followed by a recognized university, at the Master's level shall also be considered valid.
35. Candidates who have been awarded Ph.D/Masters/Bachelors degree from foreign Universities should enclose “Equivalence Certificate” issued by Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi, without which their degrees will not be considered.
36. The selected candidates shall be appointed only after undertaking a written contract.
37. The University reserves the right:
a. To withdraw the advertisement either partly or wholly at any time without assigning any reason to this effect.
b. To fill or not to fill up some or all the posts advertised for any reasons whatsoever.
c. To increase/decrease the number of posts at the time of selection and make appointments accordingly.
38. The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum and the mere possession of the same does not entitle candidates to be called for the interview.
39. All certificates, which are not in either English or Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either English or Hindi and the same shall be self-attested.
40. Central University of Kashmir will not be responsible for any loss of e-mail, loss of any communication due to wrong address provided by the candidate, unsuccessful transaction by Payment Gateway etc.
1. Before applying for a post, candidates are advised to satisfy themselves about their eligibility.
2. No TA/DA will be paid for attending interview. However, for outstation SC/ST/PWD candidates second class railway to and fro fare on shortest route will be reimbursed after attending the interview. This is not admissible to SC/ST/PWD candidates who are already employed in the Central/ State Government services.
3. Applications not accompanied by necessary supporting documents, self-attested copies of degree certificates/ marks sheets/experience certificate/category certificate (if applicable) issued by the competent authority and the incomplete applications shall be rejected summarily.
4. Candidates are advised to attach a duly signed list of enclosures with the application form.
5. Any change of address given in the application form should at once be communicated to the University.
6. The University will not be responsible for any postal delay.
7. In case the last date fixed for receipt of applications is declared a holiday/closed day, next working day shall be deemed to be the last date for receiving the forms.
8. In case of any dispute, any suit or legal proceedings against the University, the jurisdiction shall be restricted to the Courts at Srinagar, J&K.

How to Apply

  • The online prescribed application form is available on the Samarth e-governance (CU-Kashmir recruitment portal) link https://cukashmirnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/signup).
  • The application form along with payment of applicable non-refundable application fee is to be submitted online through portal.
  • The candidates need to apply through online mode only till 30-01- 2026 and submit the downloaded application form along with relevant self- attested documents (Qualification Certificates/Exp. Certificates etc.) at Recruitment Section, Central University of Kashmir, Tulmulla Campus Ganderbal-191131 in person or by post till 06-02- 2026.
  • Applications received after the last date shall be summarily rejected and no further correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.

Jammu and Kashmir.contentHtml:
Government Medical College Udhampur (GMC Udhampur)  has released an official notification for the recruitment of 142 Junior Staff Nurse, Lab Technician and Other Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official GMC Udhampur website. The last date to submit the application form is 24-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the GMC Udhampur Junior Staff Nurse, Lab Technician and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Lab Technician: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma in Laboratory Assistant Course or having Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Technical Assistant Lab: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma in Laboratory Assistant Course or having Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Public Health Nurse: 10+2 with science having two Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery/B.Sc Nursing from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • EEG Technician: Graduation with two-year Diploma Course in electroencephalograph from any recognised Institute/J&K Para Medical Council.
  • Theatre Technical Assistant/Technical Theatre Assistant: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma or Degree in Operation Theatre Technology Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Speech Therapist: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma or Degree in Speech Therapy Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Technical Assistant (Anaesthesia): 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma in Anaesthesia Assistant Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Technical Assistant (ENT): 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma in Laboratory Assistant Course or having Degree in Medical Laboratory Technology Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Refractionist: B.Sc or above having two-year Diploma or Degree in Refractionist course from any recognised institute.
  • Radiographic Technician: B.Sc or above having two-year Diploma in X-Ray Assistant Course or having Degree in X-Ray Technology/Radiography Course from recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Physiotherapist: Graduation with two-year Diploma or Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognised Institution.
  • Dental Technician: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma in Dental Assistant Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • Junior Staff Nurse: 10+2 with science having Diploma in General Nursing & Midwifery/B.Sc Nursing from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.
  • CSSD Technical Assistant: 10+2 with science or above qualification with two-year Diploma or Degree in Operation Theatre Technology Course from any recognised Institution/State Medical Faculty/J&K Paramedical Council.

Essential Qualifications

  • Candidates must be domiciles of UT of Jammu & Kashmir.
  • Valid Registration Certificate from J&K Para Medical Council is mandatory.
  • The eligibility criteria shall be considered in accordance with Govt. Order No. 670-JK(HME) of 2022 dated 19-09-2022.

Salary/Stipend

  • Level-6 Posts: Rs 35,400 - Rs 1,12,400 per month (Lab Technician, EEG Technician, Refractionist, Radiographic Technician, Physiotherapist)
  • Level-4 Posts: Rs 25,500 - Rs 81,100 per month (Technical Assistant Lab, Public Health Nurse, Theatre Technical Assistant, Speech Therapist, Technical Assistant Anaesthesia, Technical Assistant ENT, Dental Technician, Junior Staff Nurse, CSSD Technical Assistant)
  • The candidates shall be paid salary as per SO-364 dated 27-11-2020.
  • The engagement shall be for an initial period of one year, extendable on yearly basis for a maximum period of six years (one year at a time) subject to good performance and conduct or till the posts are filled up on regular basis through the competent authority, whichever is earlier.

Age Limit 

  • Maximum Age: 63 years as on cut-off date (As per S.O 364 of 2020)
  • The last date for the receipt of applications as per notification shall be the cut-off date for determining the eligibility.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: Rs 500/- (Non-Refundable) through online mode
  • All applicants are required to pay the application fee online during the application process.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 10/01/2026
Last Date for Online Application 24/01/2026
Last Date for Hardcopy Submission 28/01/2026 (up to 4:00 PM)

Selection Process

  • The selection shall be done on the basis of the marks secured in the written exam (MCQ type).
  • The provision of J&K Reservation Act and rules made therein as amended from time to time shall govern the selections.
  • No weightage shall be given to any qualification higher than the prescribed minimum qualification for the post.
  • The candidature of all applicants shall be considered provisional subject to verification of eligibility.
  • The appointing authority reserves the right to cancel the candidature at any stage without assigning any reason/notice.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement shall not confer upon the appointee any preferential right or claim for regularization or for substantive appointment under the normal process of selection/appointment.
  • The services of an appointee under these terms shall be liable to termination at any time before expiry of the tenure of the appointment on one month's notice from either side or on filling of the posts up on substantive basis, whichever is earlier.
  • The number of posts may be increased/decreased at any stage as per the requirement of the Institution without any further notice.
  • The Selection Committee reserves the right to withhold or cancel the filling up of any post/posts in part or in full in view of any administrative exigencies without assigning any reason thereof.
  • The application forms found incomplete in any manner during the scrutiny of applications shall be rejected without any prior notice to the applicant.
  • Application form submitted without a valid Registration Certificate from the J&K Para Medical Council shall be rejected outrightly.
  • Candidates must not furnish any information or document that is false, incorrect or misleading and must not suppress any material fact; if found guilty, the candidate shall be debarred from applying for a period of two years in addition to any other action as may be deemed appropriate under rules.
  • No application shall be entertained after the last date of submission of the application forms.
  • Candidates intending to apply for the aforementioned posts are hereby advised to thoroughly adhere to the prescribed eligibility and selection criteria. Applications from candidates found ineligible as per these criteria shall be summarily rejected, and such candidates shall have no entitlement or claim to appointment.
  • These are purely academic arrangement basis posts under SO-364 dated 27-11-2020.

How to Apply

  • The application form shall be available separately on the official website www.gmcudhampur.edu.in along with the necessary detailed instructions.
  • Interested candidates are advised to fill the application form through online mode only.
  • Upload self-attested requisite supporting documents pertaining to the posts on or before 21/01/2026.
  • Pay application fee of Rs 500/- (Non-Refundable) through online mode.
  • The hardcopy of the application form shall also be submitted in the office of the Principal, GMC Udhampur in person on or before 28/01/2026 (up to 4:00 PM).
  • Documents Required (Self Attested Copies):
    • Date of Birth Certificate (10th Diploma)
    • Qualification Certificate 10th, 12th and above (Academic & Technical with marksheets of all years/Semesters)
    • Diploma/Degree Certificate of the concerned Technical Qualification
    • Valid Category Certificate in the prescribed proforma issued from the competent authority
    • Registration Certificate from J&K Para Medical Council
    • Domicile Certificate

How to Apply

  • a) Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. http://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • b) Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website http://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • c) After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • d) The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size colour photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • e) Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • f) After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • g) On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • h) An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • i) On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • j) On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • k) Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • l) On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • m) Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • n) After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/ Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • o) After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • p) The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • q) Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate, one fourth (0.25) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty. b) If a candidate gives more than one answer, it will be treated as a wrong answer even if one of the given answers happens to be correct and there will be same penalty as above for that question. c) If question is left blank i.e. no answer is given by the candidate, there will be no penalty for that question.

General Information/Instructions

How to Apply

  • Candidates are required to apply online through the website of the Commission i.e. https://www.jkpsc.nic.in. No other means/ mode of application shall be accepted.
  • Candidates are first required to go to the JKPSC website https://www.jkpsc.nic.in and click on the link "One Time Registration" or click on Login menu if they have already created their profile with the JK PSC.
  • After logging into their account, candidates are required to fill all the requisite fields of One Time Registration (OTR) i.e. personal information, contact information & educational qualification, service details etc.
  • The candidate shall also be required to upload the image of date stamped recent passport size color photograph and signature. The photograph should not be taken earlier than 01.01.2025.
  • Size of the photograph (passport size) and signature must be between 10kB to 20kB in *.jpeg or *.jpg only.
  • After successful submission of all the details in the OTR account, check the eligibility conditions as mentioned in the advertisement notification before applying for the post.
  • On Clicking on the "show examination" a window will appear on the computer screen. Select the month of the advertisement notification for which candidate wants to apply, a link(s) for the post(s) will appear on the computer screen.
  • An "APPLY" button is shown against the respective post and the candidates will click on the APPLY button against the post he/she is eligible.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, an instruction window will appear. Candidates should read instructions carefully before clicking on "APPLY" button at the bottom of the webpage.
  • On clicking "APPLY" button, the system will display all facts/particulars that a candidate may have mentioned while filling up the necessary fields of his/her OTR account. Candidate shall fill up the remaining required fields in the application form and accept the declaration thereof.
  • Once the candidate is satisfied about the correctness of the filled in details, then, he or she may click on "SUBMIT" button to finally push the data into server with successful submission report.
  • On successful submission of the basic details, the candidates will be required to pay the online fee and uploading of the documents, for final submission of the online application form.
  • Candidates can pay the requisite fee through online mode in the "SUBMITTED APPLICATIONS" menu in their account.
  • After successful payment of the fee, the fee status will get reflected on the Online Application form. Candidates can check the fee status by clicking on the Print Application Button in the submitted Applications menu in their JKPSC account. In case the payment status shows either "not submitted or under processing or status has not been reflected on the submitted application form", candidates(s) are advised to contact the JKPSC office at Solina Srinagar/Resham Ghar Colony Jammu immediately for clarification. Further where the online fee is paid through other service providers the candidate must ensure that not only the amount of fee is debited from his/service provider's Account but also credited into the official account of JKPSC.
  • After successful submission of fee, the candidates will be required to upload requisite documents as specified in the advertisement/application form.
  • The candidate would be able to get the printout of his/her submitted application only after the payment of the requisite fee and uploading of requisite documents.
  • Please note that the above procedure is the only valid procedure for applying. No other mode of application or incomplete steps would be accepted and such applications would be rejected.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Master Degree with Economics or Commerce or Statistics or Business Studies or Public Administration from recognised University or Institute. AND
  • Experience: One year experience in handling stores and keeping accounts in store in a concern of Central Government or State Government or Statutory or Autonomous Organisation or Public Sector Undertaking or University or any recognised Institutions or Bank or in a private sector organisation listed on the Stock Exchange of India.
  • Bachelor degree in Economics or Commerce or Statistics or Business Studies or Public Administration from recognised University or Institute or Diploma in Material Management or Warehousing Management or Purchasing or Logistics Public procurement from recognised University or Institute
  • Experience: Two years’ experience in handling stores and keeping accounts in store in a concern of Central Government or State Government or Statutory or Autonomous Organisation or Public Sector Undertaking or University or any recognised Institutions or Bank or in a private sector organisation listed on the Stock Exchange of India.”

 Age Limit

  • Not exceeding 30 years
  • Relaxable by 05 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies.
  • Relaxable for Government servants upto five years in accordance with the instruction or orders issued by the Central Government.
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply: 06-12-2025
  • Last Date for Apply: 20-01-2026

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of Applications. All the applications received from the candidates will be scrutinised subject to the eligibility criteria and necessary documents as mentioned above and only the candidates whose applications are shortlisted will be issued with admit card. The admit card of the shortlisted candidates will be sent by post in the envelope enclosed with the application. Further, a list of the shortlisted candidates will be published on Indian Coast Guard website.
  • Document Verification. All the shortlisted candidates issued admit card will undergo document verification. Candidates will be required to bring their original documents and self-attested photocopies (02 Sets) of the same as per the directives/ instructions given in their admit cards. All the documents should be issued prior closing date of application i.e 20 Jan 26.
  • Written Examination. All the shortlisted candidates will undergo written examination on the basis of educational qualification prescribed for the post. The written examination will be pen-paper based. The question paper (bilingual) for written examination will consists of 80 objective type questions with one mark for each correct answer and there will be no negative marking. The detailed syllabus, pattern of written examination and marking scheme for question paper is given at succeeding paragraphs.
  • Exact Date/time and venue of written examination will be communicated on the admit card issued to the candidates. Exam centers will be in Kolkata and Port Blair, candidate can choose the center in the application form.
  • Merit list will be prepared strictly based on merit position as per marks obtained in written examination and will be published on the Indian Coast Guard website alongwith necessary instructions.

How to Apply

  • The application with duly affixed self-attested colour photograph should be accompanied by Xerox copies of the documents listed below, duly self-attested with name and date. No original certificates are to be forwarded alongwith the application form.
  • Aadhar card
  • Matriculation or equivalent marksheet and certificate
  • UG/PG/Diploma marksheet and certificate as per the essential eligibility.
  • Latest Category Certificate {SC /EWS} for reserved category candidates.
  • Experience Certificate as mentioned.
  • NOC from the employer for candidates presently serving in any government organization (if applicable).
  • Two latest passport size colour photographs.
  • Applicants are to enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp (pasted on the envelope) addressed to themselves with the application.

  • Those who qualify the written exam will be called for document verification and physical standard tests (PST), which are qualifying in nature.
  • Physical Standard Test (PST) includes separate minimum height, chest (for males), and weight (for females) standards. A minimum chest expansion of 5 cm is mandatory for males.
  • A Physical Efficiency Test (PET) will follow for qualified candidates. Men must complete 4.8 km in 25 minutes, and women must complete 2.4 km in 14 minutes. Candidates failing to meet these timings will be disqualified.
  • The final selection will be based on written exam marks, reservation policy, Merit-cum-Order of Preference, medical exam, and character verification.

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies may change before the exam, and the recruitment may be canceled at any level without any reason.
  • Vertical and horizontal reservations are valid only for Uttar Pradesh permanent residents, and reservations for women are applicable as per departmental guidelines.
  • All caste certificates and age relaxation proofs must be issued by competent authorities as per the prescribed format before the last date, otherwise the benefit will not be given.
  • Candidates with criminal records, bigamy, or moral turpitude are disqualified for service.
  • Physically handicapped candidates are not eligible for police services, as per the relevant rules.
  • Any false documents or information will lead to the disqualification of the candidate, and legal action can be taken.
  • All information related to the recruitment will be available only on the official website, and no personal correspondence will be made. The decision of the board will be final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must complete One Time Registration (OTR) before applying online, requiring a unique email ID and mobile number.
  • OTR will be validated via Aadhaar-based OTP and possibly DigiLocker; candidates are advised to update their Aadhaar and mobile number.
  • After OTR, candidates will log in on the official website and complete the online application form.
  • The application form should be filled accurately with all necessary documents uploaded via scanning or DigiLocker.
  • Government employees must upload a "No Objection Certificate," and only one application per candidate will be accepted.
  • Once the form is completed, candidates should pay the application fee online and take a printout of the preview for future reference.
  • During the online application, the candidate's real-time photograph will be taken, and technical standards for photographs, signatures, etc., must be adhered to.
  • Candidates must choose the order of preference for posts, and no changes will be allowed later.

General Information / Instructions

  • Self-attested copies of documents which are clean and readable will be uploaded by the applicant, which are mentioned in the online form.
  • No application or document/form sent offline or by post will be valid.
  • If there is any error in the application or any fact/data/marks/full marks of educational records are found wrong or forged, the candidature will be cancelled.
  • One Anganwadi center will not have two women from the same family appointed as Anganwadi Worker/Helper.
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease, which will be displayed on the website.
  • The entire process is to be done online from the departmental portal upanganwadibharti.in. No application is to be received in hard copy at any level.
  • While applying online, special care should be taken regarding the serial numbers of certificates and educational qualifications.
  • The online verification of the applicant's income, caste and residence certificate serial number, registration number, issue date etc. will be done by the portal itself.
  • In case of any wrong entry, the candidature will be automatically cancelled, for which the entire responsibility will be of the applicant herself.
  • The entire process of selection of Anganwadi Worker is to be done from the portal on the basis of online received applications.

How to Apply

Desirable:

  • Proficiency in MS Office, Google Suite, and online learning platforms.

  • Working experience with IIMs/IITs/NITs or Institutes of national importance preferred.

Age Limit (as on closing date 19/01/2026)

  • Junior Manager, Assistant Manager, Deputy Manager Posts: Maximum 40 years
  • Manager and Senior Manager Posts: Maximum 45 years

  • No Rounding Off: Candidates are required to fill their exact percentage of marks and age. No rounding off of percentage allowed.

Event Date

Advertisement Number IIML/Rectt.-11C/2025

Last Date for Online Application 19January 2026 (5:00 PM)
Crucial Date for Age Calculation 19 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection Method: The selection shall be made through an interview, which may be conducted online, offline, or in multiple phases, as deemed appropriate by the Institute.
  • Written Test/Skill Test: Depending upon the number of applications received, the Institute may also conduct a Written Test and/or Skill Test as part of the selection process.
  • Shortlisting: Mere fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for Written Test/Skill Test/Interview. Institute reserves right to restrict number of shortlisted candidates based on higher qualifications and/or experience.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be required to produce all original Certificates, Degrees and other documents pertaining to educational/professional qualifications, work experience, age, caste etc. for verification at time of final selection. Failure to do so may result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Communication: Date for selection process will be communicated to shortlisted candidates through email ONLY. Candidates must provide valid and active email ID as all communications will be made exclusively through email.
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance/Daily Allowance or any other incidental expenses will be reimbursed to attend the Interview.
  • Final Authority: Institute reserves right to modify, amend, or cancel recruitment process, in part or in full, at any stage without assigning any reason.

General Information/Instructions

  • Contract Period: Selected candidates will be engaged on contract basis initially for period of one-year, extendable on year-to-year basis for further three years, subject to satisfactory performance and need of Institute.
  • Nature of Employment: Positions are purely contractual in nature. Candidates will have no right to claim any regularization/absorption in the Institute.
  • Working Hours: Normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs for 6 days in a week. Sundays will be weekend off. Working hours subject to change as per need. In exigencies of work, incumbent may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible.
  • Single Application: An individual can apply for only one position. In case of duplicate/multiple applications for single or more positions, last submitted application will only be considered.
  • No Modification: Once application is finally submitted through Google Form, no request for modification or correction shall be entertained.
  • Indian Citizens Only: Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.
  • Gender Balance: Institute strives to promote gender balance and encourages applications from women candidates.
  • Preference to Agniveer: Preference may be given to Agniveer applicants, subject to fulfilling prescribed qualifications & experience.
  • Panel Validity: Panel of recommended candidates will be valid for one year from date of approval of Competent Authority. Institute can make appointments in future by operating panel within validity period.
  • Number of Posts: Number of posts may be increased or decreased as per need of Institute.
  • Institute Rights: In case of any inadvertent mistake in selection process at any stage even after issue of appointment letter, Institute reserves right to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to candidates.
  • Email Responsibility: Institute shall not be responsible for any delay or non-receipt of communication due to incorrect or inactive email ID provided by candidate.
  • Canvassing: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Legal Jurisdiction: Legal disputes, if any, will be restricted within jurisdiction of Lucknow only.
  • No Interim Correspondence: No interim correspondence will be entertained or replied to.

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: Online through Google Form only
  • Step 1: Visit the official website of IIM Lucknow: www.iiml.ac.in
  • Step 2: Check for updates, amendments and corrigendum on the website regularly
  • Step 3: Access the Google Form Link: https://forms.gle/UpjEtt2piyErNnP3A
  • Step 4: Fill the application form carefully with all accurate details including:
    • Personal Information
    • Educational Qualifications with exact percentage (no rounding off allowed)
    • Work Experience details
    • Post Code and Post Name you are applying for
    • Valid and active Email ID (mandatory)
    • Contact details
  • Step 5: Review all filled information carefully before final submission
  • Step 6: Submit the application on or before 19-01-2026 (5:00 PM)
  • Important Notes:
    • No other mode for receipt of applications will be entertained
    • Institute shall not be responsible for incomplete submissions or technical issues at candidate's end
    • Apply for only ONE position - multiple applications will result in only last submission being considered
    • Once submitted, no modification or correction requests will be entertained
    • Keep checking your registered email regularly for all communications
  • Technical Support: In case of any technical issues, applicants may contact on 0522-6696940 during office hours (09:00 AM to 05:30 PM) on any working day.

Eligibility Criteria

Hindi Officer (Post Code - A)

  • Essential Qualification:
    • Master's degree from a recognized university in Hindi with English as compulsory/optional subject at graduation level (or equivalent combinations where Hindi/English is medium/compulsory/optional at graduation/post-graduation).
    • Plus 3 years experience in terminology work (translation of technical/scientific literature English ↔ Hindi) or teaching/research in Hindi/English in Central/State Govt, Autonomous bodies, Universities, or recognized institutions.
  • Desirable Qualification: Experience in conducting Hindi classes/workshops; administrative experience.
  • Job Responsibilities: Ensure compliance with Official Language Policy/Rajbhasha Act 1963 and related rules/orders in CSIR-CDRI; any other duties assigned by superiors.

Multi Tasking Staff (Post Code - B)

  • Essential Qualification: Matriculation (10th) or equivalent pass OR ITI pass (specific requirements may apply as per post).
  • Desirable Qualification: Intermediate (12th) pass.
  • Job Responsibilities (Multi-faceted non-technical duties):
    1. Office upkeep and assistance: Physical maintenance of records/files/registers, general cleaning, arranging furniture/equipment, opening/closing office on time.
    2. Filing and document handling: Moving files/documents between sections, assisting in filing, photocopying, faxing, scanning.
    3. Distribution and correspondence: Distributing internal/external dak/mail, sending parcels/letters as directed, assisting at reception.
    4. Equipment/utility tasks: Operating simple machines (photocopier/fax), assisting in equipment maintenance, proper use/storage of stationery.
    5. Assistance to officers/staff: Serving water/tea during meetings/office hours, helping seniors with daily tasks, assisting in official meetings/workshops/conferences.
    6. Other assigned duties: Any tasks within the general nature of MTS role.
  • General duties: Filing, photocopying, data entry, record maintenance/updation, handling mail/documents, general cleaning, carrying files within building, non-clerical tasks.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Hindi Officer (Group A, Gazetted): Pay Level-10 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹56,100 – 1,77,500; Approx. gross emoluments ₹97,452/- (including HRA, TA, DA for Class 'Y' city).
  • Multi Tasking Staff (Non-Technical Group 'C'): Pay Level-1 (Cell-1), Pay Scale ₹18,000 – 56,900; Approx. gross emoluments ₹35,393/- (including allowances).

Age Limit (as on 16 February 2026)

  • Hindi Officer: Not exceeding 35 years.
  • Multi Tasking Staff: Not exceeding 25 years.
  • Relaxations:
    • SC/ST: 5 years (where posts reserved).
    • OBC: 3 years (where posts reserved).
    • PwBD (UR): 10 years; PwBD (SC/ST): 15 years; PwBD (OBC): 13 years.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Service rendered + 3 years.
    • Widows/Divorced women/judicially separated women (not remarried): Up to 35 years (higher for reserved categories).
    • CSIR/Govt employees: Up to 40 years (general); 45 years (SC/ST).
    • Other relaxations as per GoI/DoPT/CSIR rules.
  • Minimum age to apply: 18 years.

Application Fee

  • Unreserved (UR), EWS, OBC: ₹500/- (online via Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking).
  • Women / SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen / CSIR Departmental Candidates: Exempted (Nil).

Important Dates

  • Online application start date and time: 12 January 2026, 10:00 AM
  • Last date and time for online submission: 16 February 2026, 05:30 PM (website link deactivates thereafter)

Selection Process

Hindi Officer

  • Written Examination (Objective, 300 marks, 2 hours, Hindi medium, 1/3 negative marking for wrong answers) + Interview (100 marks); Weightage 75:25.
  • Top 12 unreserved candidates (minimum 50% in written) called for interview in Lucknow.
  • Syllabus: Official Language Policy, Constitutional provisions, Presidential Orders-1960, Rajbhasha Sankalp-1968, Hindi literature/history/development, grammar/spelling, translation (Hindi↔English, technical/scientific), IT tools in Hindi, e-Governance in Hindi, general knowledge related to Hindi.

Multi Tasking Staff

  • Trade Test (qualifying) → Competitive Written Examination (CWE) – OMR/CBT based, objective, 150 questions, 450 marks (3 marks per correct), 2 hours, Class X level, bilingual (except English section), 1 mark negative for wrong answers.
  • Subjects:
    • General Intelligence & Reasoning: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • Numerical Aptitude: 25 questions (75 marks)
    • General Awareness: 50 questions (150 marks)
    • English Language: 50 questions (150 marks)
  • Final merit list based on CWE marks.

General Information / Instructions

  • Women candidates are encouraged to apply (focus on gender balance).
  • Age/qualification/category claims as on 16 February 2026.
  • Upload scanned photo, signature, certificates (caste/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD in prescribed format).
  • False claims lead to disqualification/legal action.
  • No hard copy of application to be sent.

How to Apply

  • Submit before deadline; keep printout for reference.

The engagement on purely contractual basis in IWAI shall be regulated as per the following guidelines:

Eligibility Criteria

For Veterinary Officer:

For Vetting Officer:

  • Essential Qualification: Bachelor of Arts degree (with English or Hindi Literature) or Bachelor of Science or Bachelor of Commerce with minimum 50% marks AND three years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks; OR Five years Bachelor of Laws with minimum 50% marks
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, obtained 'B' certificate of NCC, or Post-graduate degree in Law

For Swasthya Shiksha Adhikari:

  • Essential Qualification: Master's Degree from a recognised University in Sociology or any subject of Social Science (includes Sociology, Anthropology, Psychology, Social Psychology, Political Science, Geography, History, and Economics)
