For Inspector of Drugs:

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Pharmacy or Pharmaceutical Sciences or Medicine with specialization in Clinical Pharmacology or Microbiology from recognized University
  • 18 months experience in manufacture OR testing of substances specified in Schedule 'C' to Drug and Cosmetics Rules 1945 in approved laboratory OR 3 years experience in inspection of firms manufacturing substances in Schedule 'C' as Drug Inspector
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

  • Essential Qualification: B.D.S. (Bachelor of Dental Surgery) degree from recognised university or equivalent qualification recognised by Indian Dental Council
  • Rotary Internship completed before last date of application
  • Registration with U.P. Dental Council
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Ayurved):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Ayurvedic from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Vaidya with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Ayurvedic or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurvedic from recognized institution

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from University established by law in India or equivalent qualification
  • Registration as Vaidya or Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience in State Ayurvedic, Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Ayurveda or Unani Tib from recognised institution, served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years, or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Unani):

  • Essential Qualification: Degree in Unani Tib from University established by law in India OR Five years degree or diploma in Unani Tib from Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • Registration as Hakeem with Board of Indian Medicine, U.P.
  • At least 6 months professional experience of State Unani or Allopathic Hospital or dispensary
  • Desirable: Post-graduate degree in Unani Tib from recognized institution

For Chikitsa Adhikari (Homoeopathic):

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years (preference to degree holders)
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.
  • Desirable: Served in Territorial Army for minimum 2 years or obtained 'B' certificate of NCC

  • Essential Qualification: Recognised degree in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 5 years OR Recognised Diploma in Homoeopathy with study duration not less than 4 years
  • Must be registered with Homoeopathic Medicine Board, U.P.

Important Dates

Selection Process

  • Screening Examination: Commission will hold Screening Examination (Objective Type) for selection of suitable candidates for admission to interview
  • Question Paper: Objective type multiple choice questions with four alternatives for each question
  • Negative Marking: For each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty
  • If question is left blank, no penalty will be imposed
  • If more than one answer is given, it will be treated as wrong answer with same penalty
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: SC/ST candidates must secure minimum 35% marks, other category candidates must secure minimum 40% marks in screening examination
  • Candidates securing less than minimum efficiency standard will be disqualified
  • Final Merit: Determined by adding 75% marks in screening test and 25% marks in interview
  • Only candidates qualifying in Screening Examination will be entitled for Interview as per Commission's standard
  • Interview: Original certificates required for verification at the time of interview
  • Candidates serving under Central/State Government must produce "No Objection Certificate" at interview

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Online application only through O.T.R. (One Time Registration) based system. Applications through any other medium will not be accepted
  • O.T.R. Mandatory: Candidates must obtain O.T.R. Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submission of online application
  • Knowledge of Hindi: Essential for all posts
  • Domicile: Only domiciled persons of U.P. are entitled for reservation benefits
  • EWS Certificate: Valid for application year only; must be for previous year from application year with gross annual income from all sources
  • Caste Certificate: Must be issued by District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/City Magistrate/SDM/Tehsildar in prescribed format
  • Document Verification: Hard copy of online application with self-attested copies of all marksheets and certificates to be submitted when asked
  • No Change After Submission: Any request for change in qualification and category after receipt of application will not be entertained
  • Wrong Information: Candidates furnishing wrong information will be debarred from this selection and all future examinations up to maximum 5 years
  • Vacancy Numbers: May increase/decrease depending upon circumstances/requirements
  • Commission's Decision Final: Decision of Commission regarding eligibility/candidature/selection shall be final
  • Anti-Malpractice: Provisions of Uttar Pradesh Examination (Prevention of unfair Means) Act-2024 dated 06 August 2024 will be applicable
  • Candidates must visit Commission website continuously for updates
  • All future information/instructions will be sent to registered mobile number and email ID linked in O.T.R. by SMS or email

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - O.T.R. Registration: Obtain One Time Registration (O.T.R.) Number from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before applying
  • Step 2 - Visit Official Website: Go to https://uppsc.up.nic.in and click on "All Notifications/Advertisements"
  • Step 3 - Read Instructions: Go through User Instructions and View Advertisement thoroughly
  • Step 4 - Click Apply: Click on "Apply" button and authenticate with O.T.R. using O.T.P. received on registered mobile/email or O.T.R. password
  • Step 5 - Fill Application Part-1: Personal details will be auto-filled from O.T.R. Fill essential qualification required for the post
  • Step 6 - Fill Application Part-2: Click 'Submit Details' under 'Application Part-2'. Permanent and correspondence address will be auto-displayed. Choose Yes/No for preferential qualifications
  • Step 7 - Fee Payment: Click 'Proceed for fee payment' and pay through NET BANKING/CARD PAYMENTS/OTHER PAYMENT MODES via SBI MOPS
  • Step 8 - Take Print: After successful payment, take print of Payment Transaction Slip and submitted application form
  • Step 9 - Modification: If needed, modification in qualification can be done only once till last date for correction through 'Candidate Dashboard Login'
  • Important: Complete all stages of online application (O.T.R., Fee payment, Final submission) before last date
  • Preserve Records: Keep soft/hard copy of all information regarding all stages for future reference

  • In cases where two or more candidates secure the same percentage of marks, their position in the merit list shall be determined according to their date of birth, with the older candidate being placed higher in the order of merit.
  • Shortlisted Candidates will be intimated through their registered Email IDs only. Shortlisted candidates will have to appear in person for verification of documents at various offices of United India Insurance Co Ltd, the details of which will be intimated in due course.
  • The final engagement list will be prepared after verifying all the details entered by the respective candidate in the NATS portal against the original documents and shall be subject to the availability of vacancies in the respective state.

  • All correspondence will be made only on the email ID mentioned by the candidate in their online application form and same has to be kept active for receiving all communications from Company related to Apprenticeship Training program.
  • Incomplete applications / applications without supporting documents will be rejected outright. Company takes no responsibility to receive/ collect any certificate/ document sent separately.
  • The name of the candidate should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the certificates/ mark sheets. Any change/ alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Candidates are advised not to change their appearance till the engagement process is complete.
  • Decision of the Company in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the stages at which such scrutiny of eligibility is to be undertaken, the documents to be produced for the purpose of the conduct of selection and any other matter relating to selection process will be final and binding on the candidate. Company reserves the right to modify/ amend/ cancel any of the eligibility criteria and/or any other terms and conditions spelt out in this Notification.
  • The shortlisted candidates are required to produce original documents pertaining to Age, Qualification, etc. for verification. If any candidate is found ineligible while verifying the documents, he / she shall not be allowed to join Apprenticeship Program.
  • Mere submission of application and apparently fulfilling the criteria as prescribed in the advertisement do not entitle a candidate to be called for Apprenticeship program.
  • Canvassing in any form for training seats will be treated as disqualification.
  • In case it is detected at any stage of engagement of apprentice that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he has furnished any incorrect /false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), including in unfair practices in the process, his/her candidature will be cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her contract of Apprenticeship Training is liable to be terminated without any compensation or claim whatsoever.
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to submit their applications well in time before the last date for submission and Company does not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications within the last date on account of the reasons beyond the control of the Company.
  • Shortlisted candidates shall be required to produce all requisite original documents, along with self-attested photocopies, in support of their eligibility, educational qualification, and identity at the time of document verification. Failure to produce the required documents, at the time of verification shall render the candidate ineligible for further participation in the engagement process.
  • Further, non-submission of requisite documents by the candidate at the time of engagement shall result in cancellation of candidature and debarment from any subsequent stage of the Apprenticeship engagement process.
  • Candidates must ensure that the following documents are clearly uploaded in their NATS student profile: Degree Certificate, Provisional Certificate, Consolidated Mark sheet, Aadhaar Card, Bank Passbook (in the candidate's name), Latest Passport-size Photograph.
  • Candidates must ensure that all details entered in the student profile match the information on their educational documents, including: Candidate's Name, Parents' Names, Aadhaar Number, Educational qualification.

How to Apply

  • For students who have already enrolled in the National Web Portal and having login details: Login, search for "UNITED INDIA INSURANCE COMPANY LTD" under "Apply against advertised vacancies", click apply.
  • For first time enrollment: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click Student Register, complete form, get Enrollment Number, then login and apply as above.
  • Upload the B.E / B.Tech/ B.A./ B.Sc., / B.Com.,/ BBA/ BCA etc., Provisional Certificate (or) Consolidated Mark Sheet. Percentage of marks in the Graduate / Non Engg, Graduate Examination is mandatory. Hence candidates are advised to compulsorily enter percentage of marks in the column "% of marks / CGPAx10" in the NATS portal.

Indian Navy SSC Officers Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Branch/ Cadre Vacancy Gender
Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre) 76 (including 06 Hydro) Men and Women (maximum of 10 vacancies in GS (X) and 01 vacancy in Hydro for women)
Pilot 25 Men and Women (maximum of 03 vacancies for women)
Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers) 20 Men and Women (maximum of 03 vacancies for women)
Air Traffic Controller (ATC) 18 Men and Women
Logistics 10 Men and Women (maximum of 01 vacancies for women)
Education 07 Men and Women
Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)) 42 Men and Women (maximum of 07 vacancies for women)
Submarine Tech Engineering 08 Only for Men
Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)) 38 Men and Women (maximum of 07 vacancies for women)
Submarine Tech Electrical 08 Only for Men

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Logistics: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with First Class or MBA with First Class, or B.Sc/ B.Com/ B.Sc.(H) with First class along with PG Diploma in Finance / Logistics / Supply Chain Management / Material Management or MCA/ M.Sc.(H) with First Class.
  • Education: MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Maths/ Operational Research (with Physics in BSc) or MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Physics/ Applied Physics (with Maths in BSc)/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths in BSc) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/ Production Engineering or BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Computer Science Engineering/ MCA (with either Physics or Mathematics in graduation level) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical/ Electronics and Communication/ Electronics and Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electronics & Communication/ Controls/ Radar and Microwave/ Optical Fibre Communication/ Digital Signal Processing/ Wireless Communication/ Laser and Electro Optics/ VLSI/ Power Systems/ Communications Systems/ Electronics & Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Thermal/ Production Engineering/ Machine Design/ System and Controls/ Manufacturing/ Mechatronics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation level). Candidates applying for the Education entry must have scored minimum of 60% marks in class X or class XII.
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Marine Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Metallurgy Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Production Engineering, Control Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Instrumentation & Control, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Electronics Engineering, Tele Communication, Power Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).

Salary/Stipend

  • The initial gross salary of Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,25,000/- (approximately) per month alongwith other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/ NAOO allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Pilot: Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Logistics: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jun 2007
  • Education: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007

Important Dates

Event Date
Apply Online from 24 Jan 2026
Last date for Online Application 24 Feb 2026
Course commencing Jan 2027
Inform final result to Indian Navy prior 20 Dec 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of application will be based on normalised marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree. Marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae mentioned in Join Indian Navy website (URL: - https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf)
  • BE/ B.Tech. For candidates who have completed or are in final year of BE/ B.Tech, marks obtained upto fifth semester will be considered for SSB shortlisting.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme. For candidates who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered. For candidates who are in final year, shortlisting will be based on pre-final year performance.
  • Candidates selected in the final merit list will be required to submit the proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by sending an email at the address [email protected]. Candidates failing to meet the criteria will not be permitted to join the Academy.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS (provided by candidates in their application form). Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/ mobile number till selection process is over and check their inbox and spam folder periodically.
  • Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Any correspondence regarding change of SSB dates be addressed to the call up officer of the concerned SSB on receipt of call up letter. Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters through SMS/ email (provided by candidates in their application).
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews.
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission. Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB.
  • Details of SSB procedure are available on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries as per availability of vacancies and medical clearance for respective entry. Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

General Information/Instructions

  • Vacancies mentioned in para 2 are tentative and may be changed depending on availability of training slots.
  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Male Candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies and service requirements. Candidates exercising option for this branch will have to additionally indicate option for submarine specialisation while filling the online application form.
  • Eventual selection/ nomination to undergo submarine specialisation will be subject to clearing submarine medicals (after joining INA) and service requirements.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.
  • Candidates selected under GS(X) may be nominated to undergo specialisation in RPA (after completion of training at INA), subject to medical fitness and service requirements.
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency (Foreign going) either as a Second Mate, Mate or Master and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Executive Branch entry (General Service) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(1).
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency as 1st class Engineer and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Technical Branch entry (SSC Engineering) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(7) and 2(8).
  • Candidates having valid CPL issued by DGCA (India) and born between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2008 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Pilot entry as per eligibility criteria stated at Para 2(2).
  • NCC 'C' certificate holders will be given relaxation of 5% in cut off marks towards shortlisting for SSB subject to meeting following criteria: Having NCC 'C' certificate of Naval/Army/Air Wing with minimum 'B' Grade. Not served less than two academic years in the Senior Division, Naval/Army/Air Wing of the NCC. 'C' certificate should not be dated prior to 01 Jan 2024.
  • The final selection will be subject to verification of the certificate by DG(NCC) concerned NCC unit for its validity. Candidature of individual will be cancelled at any stage of selection/ training/ post-commissioning, in case of false declaration, misinformation or concealing of information.
  • The candidate will be required to fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by Jan 2027.
  • The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • All SSB recommended candidates would be required to inform their final result of respective degree to Indian Navy at the email ID [email protected] prior 20 Dec 2026.
  • Specified number of candidates based on service requirement, who have chosen SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/ CPSS/ Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/ medical standards (Height, leg length etc) for this entry prior selecting this option. Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates must indicate their preference for other branches/ cadres also, if they wish to be considered for those branches/ cadres.
  • Candidates will not be considered for branches/ cadres that they have not selected.
  • Candidates are advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches/ cadres, with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference.
  • No equivalent stream of BE/ B.Tech qualifications other than those mentioned in para 2(5), 2(6), 2(7), 2(8), 2(9) and 2(10) above, will be considered valid for selection process at any stage.
  • Candidates will be denied to appear SSB if any backlog in any subject is pending at the time of document verification at SSB centers.
  • Medical standards/ Relaxation in Height and Weight/ Tattoo. Please visit website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB recommended candidates are required to undergo medical examination as applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/ centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years extendable by maximum 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness of candidates
  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant subject to clearing of induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala post reporting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay and allowances drawn by him/ her and other expenditure incurred on the candidate by the Government.
  • If the officer voluntarily withdraws from initial training or resigns during the probationary period, he/ she shall be required to refund the cost of training in whole or in part, as may be determined by Govt and all money received by him/ her as pay and allowances from the Govt together with the interest on the said money calculated at the rate in force for Govt loans.
  • Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation the officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.
  • All officers/ cadets would be compulsorily members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS) as received and approved for insurance cover on contribution basis. The cover would be applicable whilst in service and post retirement as per extant regulations.
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the Select List/Merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment.
  • Candidates may also note that mere empanelment is under no circumstances be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post applied for.
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time.
  • Please read the instructions given on the website carefully before finally submitting your online application.
  • Your candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.
  • Use/ possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/ medical/ training and subsequently during service. If candidate is found to be using/ in-possession of narcotics during any time of selection/ medical/ training/ service, candidate would be debarred from joining the Indian Navy or be removed from service if already joined.
  • Your application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and the application can be rejected, if found INELIGIBLE/ INVALID at any point of time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and fill application on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling up the e-application, it is advisable to keep the relevant documents readily available to enable the following: Correct filling up of personal particulars. Details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate. Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled.
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original), marks sheets upto 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/ B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree examination, date of birth proof (as per 10th & 12th certificate), CGPA conversion formula for BE/ B.Tech, Merchant Navy certificate issued by Government of India, Ministry of Shipping and Transport, NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps and a recent passport size colour photograph should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format, for attaching the same while filling up the application.
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason, the application will be rejected. Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.

Important: CSL reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of vacancies or not to fill up the vacancies or cancel the recruitment process as per its requirement.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • All Posts: Pass in SSLC (Secondary School Leaving Certificate)
  • ITI (National Trade Certificate) in relevant trade
  • All India National Trade Test (National Apprenticeship Certificate) in relevant trade
  • The minimum qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognized by AICTE/appropriate statutory authority/State/Central Government
  • Candidates with equivalent qualifications should submit Equivalency Certificate issued by Competent Authority

Trade-wise Qualification Requirements

  • Welder Cum Fitter (Welder/Welder Gas & Electric): ITI and NCVT in Welder/Welder (Gas & Electric) trade
  • Welder Cum Fitter (Sheet Metal Worker): ITI and NCVT in Sheet Metal Worker trade
  • Welder Cum Fitter (Fitter): ITI and NCVT in Fitter trade
  • Welder Cum Fitter (Plumber): ITI and NCVT in Plumber/Pipe Fitter trade
  • Welder Cum Fitter (Mechanic Motor Vehicle): ITI and NCVT in Mechanic Motor Vehicle trade
  • Welder Cum Fitter (Mechanic Diesel): ITI and NCVT in Mechanic Diesel trade
  • Machinist: ITI and NCVT in Machinist trade
  • Fitter (Electrical): ITI and NCVT in Electrician trade
  • Fitter (Electronics): ITI and NCVT in Electronic Mechanic trade
  • Crane Operator (Electrical): ITI and NCVT in Electrician/Electronic Mechanic/Instrument Mechanic trade
  • Instrument Mechanic: ITI and NCVT in Instrument Mechanic trade
  • Shipwright Wood: ITI and NCVT in Shipwright Wood (Carpenter) trade
  • Painter: ITI and NCVT in Painter (Marine/General)/Fitter/Sheet Metal Worker trade

Experience Requirements

  • For All Posts: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience in relevant areas
  • Experience must be acquired after passing the stipulated qualification
  • Experience period will be reckoned as on 23 January 2026
  • Experience in Shipyard, Engineering Company, Government Company/Establishment, or Semi-Government Company/Establishment is required
  • Completed Apprenticeship Training under Apprentices Act 1961 in relevant trade shall be treated as experience
  • Training with remuneration shall also be treated as experience
  • Experience certificates from Companies registered under Companies Act 1956 or Foreign Companies of equivalent status only will be considered
  • For current employees, Appointment/Offer letter, latest Pay Slip, or copy of last pay drawn should be submitted as proof
  • For past employment, experience certificate indicating date of joining and relieving should be submitted
  • Work experience from contractors (Proprietary/Partnership Firms) may be considered based on Principal Employer's endorsement along with ESI/EPF statements

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: W6 - ₹22,500 - ₹73,750 per month
  • Basic Pay: ₹22,500
  • Dearness Allowance (DA): ₹11,655 (at present 51.8%)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA): ₹4,500 (at present 20%)
  • Other Allowances: ₹3,140
  • Total Monthly Emoluments (as on date): ₹41,795
  • Additional Benefits: National Pension System (NPS), Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Accident Insurance coverage, Medical Assistance Scheme, Post-Retirement Medical Assistance Scheme, Earned Leave encashment, Working Dress Maintenance Allowance etc. as admissible

Age Limit (as on 23-01-2026)

  • Maximum Age: 35 years (Applicants should be born on or after 24 January 1991)
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation for posts reserved for them
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years relaxation for posts reserved for them
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-servicemen: As per Government of India guidelines - period of military service deducted from actual age and adding 3 years thereto, subject to maximum age of 45 years
  • Upper age limit is relaxable as per Government directives

Application Fee

  • General/OBC/EWS Candidates: ₹700/- (Non-refundable, plus bank charges extra)
  • SC/ST Candidates: Exempted from application fee (No fee required)
  • Payment Mode: Online payment only through Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI etc.
  • Payment Period: From 06 January 2026 to 23 January 2026
  • No other mode of payment shall be accepted
  • Candidature shall be considered only on receipt of application fee (except for SC/ST candidates)

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 05/01/2026
Commencement of Online Application 06/01/2026
Last Date of Online Application 23/01/2026
Phase I - Online Objective Test Date To be notified later
Certificate Verification Date To be notified later
Phase II - Practical Test Date To be notified later (at CSL, Kochi)
Result Declaration To be notified later

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Objective Type Online Test: 30 marks (35 minutes duration)
  • Part A: General Knowledge - 5 questions (5 marks)
  • Part A: Quantitative Aptitude - 5 questions (5 marks)
  • Part B: Trade Related - 20 questions (20 marks)
  • Each question carries one mark
  • No negative marking
  • Phase II - Practical Test: 70 marks in relevant trade
  • Total Marks: 100 marks (Phase I + Phase II)
  • Mark lists for each post shall be prepared based on marks secured in Objective type online test
  • Candidates scoring minimum pass marks will be shortlisted for certificate verification
  • CSL shall call sufficient number of candidates for certificate verification to get minimum ratio of 6 candidates against one post in order of merit/reservation
  • Candidates successfully completing certificate verification shall be shortlisted for Phase II Practical Test at CSL, Kochi
  • Minimum Pass Marks:
  • Unreserved posts & EWS candidates: 50% of total marks in each test
  • OBC Candidates: 45% of total marks in each test (for reserved vacancies)
  • SC/ST Candidates: 40% of total marks in each test (for reserved vacancies)
  • Final rank lists shall be prepared based on aggregate marks secured in both Phase I and Phase II by candidates meeting eligibility requirements
  • In case of tie, marks scored in trade part of Objective test shall determine rank; if still tied, seniority in age will be considered
  • Online test shall be held at various test centres in Kerala as decided by CSL
  • CSL reserves right to scrutinize applications and prepare shortlist based on eligibility requirements before selection process

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian nationals need to apply
  • CSL is a listed premier Mini Ratna Schedule 'A' Company of Government of India
  • CSL is engaged in hazardous operations; hence PwBD candidates shall not apply for these posts as deployment may put them and others at serious risk
  • Posting shall be at CSL/any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL
  • Candidates are liable to be transferred within different units of CSL depending on project requirements
  • Appointment carries obligation to serve in any department of CSL, on-board ships, or in any units/work sites/projects in India or abroad
  • Government of India directives on reservation shall apply
  • EWS candidates should produce valid Income and Asset Certificate issued by competent authority in prescribed format
  • SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates should produce valid recent community certificate issued by Revenue Authority not below rank of Tahsildar
  • Applicants should not submit more than one application for the same post
  • Online exams for various posts will be conducted simultaneously; hence applicants shall apply only for one post

  • Additional Requirement: Call up for Service Selection Board (SSB) will be issued on the basis of JEE (Main) All India Common Rank List (CRL) - 2025 published by NTA

Age Limit (as on 02 Jan 2007 to 01 Jul 2009)

  • Age Eligibility: Candidates must be born between 02 Jan 2007 and 01 Jul 2009 (both dates inclusive)
  • For All Branches: Same age criteria applies to Executive & Technical Branch for both men and women candidates

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date for Online Application 03 Jan 2026
Last Date for Online Application 19 Jan 2026
SSB Interviews for Shortlisted Candidates From Mar 2026 onwards
Course Commencing Jul 2026

Selection Process

  • Naval Headquarters reserves the right to fix the cut off for shortlisting of applications for SSB based on JEE (Main) All India Common Rank List (CRL) - 2025
  • All candidates are required to fill their Rank as per Common Rank List (CRL) in the application
  • SSB interviews for shortlisted candidates will be scheduled at Bangalore/ Bhopal/ Kolkata/ Visakhapatnam from Mar 2026 onwards
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail and SMS
  • All candidates recommended by SSB are required to undergo medical examination applicable to 10+2 (B. Tech) entry
  • Merit list would be prepared based on SSB marks
  • Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed subject to police verification and character verification & availability of vacancies
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission

General Information/Instructions

  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled
  • Change of SSB Centre for examination/interview is not permissible under any circumstances
  • Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters via SMS/email
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews
  • The maximum permissible vacancy that can be allotted to women cadets is 07, subject to the condition that they should feature in the common merit list
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the common merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained
  • Candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service
  • Use/possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/medicals/training and subsequently during service
  • Application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and can be rejected if found ineligible/invalid at any point of time
  • There is no relaxation in medical standards on any grounds
  • Change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible under any circumstances
  • Guidelines for medical standards are available on the Indian Navy website

Training

  • Selected candidates will be inducted as Cadets for the four years B. Tech Course at Indian Naval Academy, Ezhimala
  • Courses offered: Applied Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering as per Naval requirements
  • On completion of the course, B. Tech Degree will be awarded by the Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU)
  • Distribution of cadets amongst Executive and Technical Branch (Engineering & Electrical) will be as per the extant policy
  • The entire cost of training, including books and reading material, will be borne by the Indian Navy
  • The cadets will also be provided with entitled clothing and messing

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and submit their application on the recruitment website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance under their user profile
  • Correct personal particulars details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate/12th class certificate
  • Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original) should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format for attaching while filling up the application
  • Required documents: Date of Birth proof (as per 10th/12th certificates), 10th class marksheet, 12th class marksheet, JEE(Main)-2025 Score card indicating Common Rank List (CRL) and a recent passport size colour photograph
  • Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it along with original certificates/documents while appearing for SSB interview
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason the application will be rejected
  • Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB

Eligibility Criteria

1. Project Coordinator (BES) - 1 Post

  • Qualification: B.Tech in Civil Engineering from recognized university
  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in structural design & design review
  • Essential Experience: Experience in planning and design of bridges, flyovers, elevated structures, railway bridges, cause ways, regulator cum bridge etc.
  • Desirable: Experience in design review of road and railway bridges, regulator cum bridges and flyovers
  • Technical Skills: Working experience in softwares like MIDAS/STADD PRO/E TABS
  • Essential: Should be familiar with relevant IRC codes

2. Project Coordinator (Electrical) - 1 Post

  • Qualification: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from recognized university
  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in Electro-Mechanical sector & HVAC works
  • Essential Experience: Good exposure to design review of electrical & HVAC systems in infrastructure projects like hospitals, stadiums, educational institute, water sector, general construction etc.
  • Essential: Should have knowledge in IS/IEC codes and standards
  • Essential: Should have knowledge in CPWD/CEA/NBC norms

3. Project Coordinator (Civil) - 1 Post

  • Qualification: B.Tech in Civil Engineering from recognized university
  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in structural design and design review of building projects and water supply projects
  • Essential Experience: Experience in planning and design of multistoried buildings, water retaining structures etc.
  • Essential: Strong understanding of architectural and structural design process, coordinate activities between architectural, structural and MEP disciplines to ensure design compatibility
  • Desirable: Support in developing scopes of work, proposals and technical documentation
  • Technical Skills: Working experience in softwares like STAAD PRO/E TABS
  • Essential: Knowledge of relevant IS codes

4. Project Examiner (Electro-Mechanical Services) - 1 Post

  • Qualification: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from recognized university
  • Experience: Minimum 8 years of experience in Electrical & HVAC works
  • Essential Experience: Good exposure to quality control/quality assurance activities
  • Essential: Should have experience in execution supervision of electrical and mechanical work
  • Essential: Should have experience in ensuring compliance with technical specifications, safety standards and regulatory requirements
  • Essential: Should have knowledge in CPWD/CEA/NBC norms

5. Inspection Engineer (Electrical) - 1 Post

  • Qualification: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering from recognized university
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in Project Execution/Construction Management
  • Essential Experience: Experience associated with Public Infrastructure works or other leading infrastructure organisations

Note: Only post qualification experience will be considered for all positions.

  • Final selection will be based on overall performance in the selection process

  • Ensure all information provided is accurate and complete
  • Upload recent passport size photograph:
    • Scanned image should be latest photograph
    • File size: Less than 200KB
    • Format: JPG only
  • Upload signature:
    • Sign on white paper with black ink
    • Scan the full signature (not initials)

    • Must be signed only by the candidate
  • Upload required documents:

  • Check spam/junk folder also for important emails from CMD/KIIFB

  • Upload clear and legible scanned copies only

  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: Candidates who are Ex-serviceman or Ex-General Reserve Engineer Force person or a disembodied Territorial Army person can exclude the period of service in defence forces and period of unemployment on discharge up to a maximum of five years, provided they have not completed the age of 50 years

    • General Knowledge/Current Affairs - 30 marks
    • Questions to test proficiency in English language - 20 marks
  • Number of Questions: 100 questions, each carrying 1 mark
  • Negative Marking: For every incorrect answer, 1/4 mark will be deducted
  • Interview: Total marks for Interview shall be 10
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Candidate must secure minimum 35% marks in the Interview to be considered for inclusion in the ranked list

  • Government employees must obtain No Objection Certificate/Service Certificate from their Head of Office
  • Candidates should ensure they fulfill eligibility norms before applying
  • Furnishing incorrect/false information or suppression of material facts will lead to cancellation of candidature
  • Canvassing in any form will entail cancellation of candidature
  • High Court reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage
  • Decisions of High Court regarding eligibility and selection would be final and binding

  • Stage 1: Scrutiny of online applications and uploaded documents
  • Stage 2: Written Test (if conducted) - Objective type examination covering Diploma in Electronics syllabus, General Knowledge and English proficiency
  • Stage 3: Interview for shortlisted candidates - Assessment of technical knowledge, communication skills, and suitability for the post
  • Stage 4: Document Verification - Verification of all original certificates including educational qualifications, caste certificate, experience certificate
  • Stage 5: Medical Examination (if required) - Fitness certificate from competent medical authority
  • Final Selection: Preparation of ranked list based on performance in written test (if conducted) and interview

    • Passport size photograph (face and shoulder clearly visible, white/light colored background)
    • Signature
    • Plus Two or equivalent certificate
    • Diploma in Electronics certificate
    • Experience certificate (in prescribed format)
    • Scheduled Castes certificate
    • Any other relevant documents
  • Step 4: After logging into profile, select "My Profile" option and enter required details
  • Step 5: Select "Upload Documents" option and upload all qualification documents
  • Step 6: Ensure documents are properly scanned and legible
  • Step 7: Preview uploaded documents before submitting (once submitted, documents cannot be re-uploaded or deleted)
  • Step 8: Once documents are uploaded, select "Apply Now" option from dashboard
  • Step 9: Fill in the online application form with accurate details:
    • Personal information

    • Contact details
  • Step 10: Check preview of application before final submission
  • Step 11: Submit the application (no changes can be made after submission)
  • Step 12: Take printout/save soft copy of submitted application for future reference
  • Step 13: Do not send printout to High Court (keep for personal records only)
  • Important: Candidates will be called for Written Test (if conducted) only after scrutiny of uploaded documents

  • After registration, a login ID will be created, and candidates can apply against the advertisement as per their qualifications by using their login ID.
  • After filling up the application form, candidates must submit the same by making payment of the requisite fee and then take a printout of the application form and upload the same after duly checking and signing it.
  • If a candidate does not upload a signed copy of the downloaded application form, his/her application will be considered incomplete and candidature will be automatically rejected.
  • The candidate should carefully enter all particulars and details in the online application form, as after submission no change in any particular/detail will be allowed.
  • After successful submission of application, candidates should again take print out of the signed application form which has been uploaded and bring the hard copy along with all uploaded documents when called upon by the Commission.

  • The provisionally selected candidates will be imparted training state-wise where he / she is selected, depending on the requirement of the Bank

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate should not have undergone apprenticeship in any other organization or terminated their apprenticeship midway or pursuing apprenticeship training in bank or any other organization/s / companies / firms etc. as per the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended from time to time
  • Candidates who had training or job experience of one or more years after completion of educational qualifications shall not be eligible for being engaged as apprentice
  • It shall neither be obligatory on the part of the Bank to offer any employment to any apprentice who has completed the period of his apprenticeship training, nor shall it be obligatory on the part of the apprentice to accept an employment
  • The apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in Bank after completion of the training
  • Bank does not have any obligation to offer regular employment to apprentice during or after completion of apprenticeship period
  • Candidates shall be relieved from the respective area after immediate completion of apprenticeship period. The apprentices will have no right to claim for regular employment in the bank based on the apprenticeship training undergone and such apprenticeship training will not cast any liability on the bank for providing any job to any such apprentice
  • Providing Transport / Hostel facility or any other form of residential accommodation during Apprentice training is not under the scope
  • The candidature of the candidate would be provisional and subject to verification of documents subsequently. At any stage, if it is found that the candidate has furnished false or incorrect information, then the candidature is liable for cancellation of engagement
  • Candidates selected for training will not be allowed to withdraw from training except for reasons that are beyond their control. Before commencement of the training, the candidates will have to execute a Contract of Apprenticeship. Those who absent themselves are liable to refund the whole cost of their training as well as the amount received as stipend as determined by the Central Apprenticeship Advisor. These are only indicative and not exhaustive; the terms & conditions stipulated in the notification shall be applicable
  • During the period of Apprenticeship, the selected Apprentices will be governed by the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time) and applicable commensurate polices / rules of the bank
  • Any resultant dispute arising out of this advertisement for engagement of apprentices will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Pune only

How to Apply

  • Scan their photograph, signature, left thumb impression and the handwritten declaration, ensuring that both the photograph and signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration adhere to the required specifications as given under guidelines.
  • Candidates should be in possession of Aadhaar Card. At the time of registration, Candidates have to fill 12-digit Aadhaar Card number.
  • The Candidates not having Aadhaar number and have enrolled for Aadhaar but have not received Aadhaar Card can enter 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID printed on the Aadhaar Enrolment slip.
  • Left thumb impression (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb. If both thumbs are missing, the impression of one of the fingers of the left hand starting from the forefinger should be taken.
  • If there are no fingers on the left hand, the impression of one of the fingers of the right hand starting from the forefinger should be taken. If no fingers are available, the impression of left toe may be taken.
  • In all such cases where left thumb impression is not uploaded, the candidate should specify in the uploaded document the name of finger and the specification of left/right hand or toe).
  • A handwritten declaration (text given below) must be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only.
  • If it is written by anybody else and uploaded or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid. (In the case of candidates who cannot write, may get the text of declaration typed and put their left-hand thumb impression (if not able to sign also) below the typed declaration and upload the document as per specifications).

Eligibility Criteria

  • Blood Transfusion Officer (Level-11; Age 18–35 years): Recognized medical qualification included in I or II Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956; five years’ experience in Blood Bank work after registration as Medical Graduate; registration with a State Medical Council.
  • Store Keeper (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Bachelor degree in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics and MBA/Postgraduate in Maths/Economics/Commerce/Statistics/Finance from a recognized University with at least 50% marks.
  • Junior Engineer (Civil/Electrical/Refrigeration & Air Conditioning/Horticulture) (Level-6; Age 18–30 years): Degree in respective branch of Engineering OR minimum three years diploma in respective branch of Engineering from a recognized Institute.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or its equivalent; Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized Institution/Board; registered Pharmacist under Pharmacy Act, 1948. Desirable: Degree in Pharmacy and experience in dispensing and/or storage and dispensing of drugs in a reputed hospital/Institution or pharmaceutical concern.
  • Receptionist (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Degree from a recognized University; Postgraduate diploma in journalism/Public relations. Desirable: Experience in public relations/publications/printing/publishing; exposure to working on Personal Computer.
  • Sanitary Inspector Grade-II (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; certificate of Sanitary Inspector course from a recognized Institution; at least four years’ experience in the line preferably in a hospital of repute.
  • Junior Photographer (Level-5; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma in Photography from a recognized Institute; two years’ experience in Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital OR Matriculation and five years’ experience in Medical Photography in a teaching Institute/Hospital.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science; Dental Mechanic course of two years duration from a recognized Dental Institution approved by Dental Council of India. Desirable: Two years’ experience as Dental Mechanic; special training/experience in crown and bridge chrome cobalt, myofunctional orthodontic appliances.
  • Hand Prosthesis Technician (Level-4; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; Diploma from I.T.I. or equivalent in trade of turner, fitter or metal worker with five years’ experience in making and fitting splints, braces or appliances for disabled people.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; Diploma or certificate in Radiography of minimum one year duration from a recognized Institution. Desirable: One year’s experience as Dark Room Assistant in a hospital.
  • Animal Keeper (Level-2; Age 18–30 years): Matric with Science and two years’ experience in breeding and keeping of animals preferably in a medical or research Institution.
  • CSR Assistant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric with Science and certificate course of Operation Theatre Assistant of one year duration from this Institute. Desirable: Diploma in Operation Theatre Techniques.
  • Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant) (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matric/10th Standard with ITI certificate in the respective trade OR Matric with trade certificate from a recognized Institute/Board/authority with five years’ experience in the trade where ITI certificate is not available.
  • Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation or equivalent; valid Driving Licence for driving heavy vehicles; knowledge of motor mechanism and ability to remove minor defects; three years’ experience of driving motor vehicles (including heavy vehicles). Desirable: Three years’ service as Home Guard/Civil Volunteer.
  • Laboratory Attendant Grade-II (Level-2; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: 10th class pass (with Science as one of the subjects) from a recognized Board. Desirable: Experience in Medical Laboratory.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation; ITI in respective trade with two years’ experience in the trade.
  • Security Guard Grade-II (Level-1; Age 18–30 years) – Essential: Matriculation from a recognized Board/University (relaxable up to Middle Standard pass for certain Ex-servicemen); prescribed physical standards and qualifying Physical Efficiency Test as detailed in the guidelines. Desirable: Service in Armed Forces/Para-Military Forces/Police; experience of performing security duties, preferably in a hospital of repute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Blood Transfusion Officer: Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,08,700/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Store Keeper and all Junior Engineer posts: Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Pharmacist Grade-II, Receptionist, Sanitary Inspector Grade-II, Junior Photographer: Level-5 (Rs. 29,200 – 92,300/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dental Mechanic Grade-II and Hand Prosthesis Technician: Level-4 (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Dark Room Assistant Grade-III, Animal Keeper, CSR Assistant Grade-II, Technician Grade-IV (Manifold Room/Plant), Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade, Laboratory Attendant Grade-II: Level-2 (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.
  • Technician Grade-I (Laundry) and Security Guard Grade-II: Level-1 (Rs. 18,000 – 56,900/-) as per 7th CPC pay matrix.

Age Limit 

  • For Blood Transfusion Officer: 18–35 years.
  • For all other advertised posts: 18–30 years.
  • Upper age limit shall be determined as on the last date of submission of online application form i.e. 16.02.2026.
  • Permissible relaxations in upper age limit for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Govt. Civilian Employees, Ex-Servicemen, Widows/Divorced women/women judicially separated and not remarried, candidates domiciled in J&K, Defence personnel disabled, Service Clerks and permanent employees of PGIMER are as per detailed table in the guidelines.

Application Fee

  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Exempted from payment of application fee.
  • SC/ST category candidates: Rs. 800/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • All others including General/OBC/EWS candidates: Rs. 1500/- plus Transaction Charges as applicable.
  • Application fee is to be deposited through online payment gateway available at the application portal using Debit/Credit Card/Net Banking (payment through UPI may be avoided).
  • The cost of Application Form includes the fee for the Computer Based Test and is non-refundable.

Important Dates

Item / Activity Timeline / Remarks
Opening date for online registration for filling up of online application on PGIMER’s website (Recruitment link at Home Page) 01.01.2026
Closing date for online registration & submission of online applications 16.02.2026
Crucial date for determining eligibility w.r.t. essential qualification(s), age and experience 16.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Candidates who successfully submit online applications will appear in an online Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in English language only, on an all-India basis.
  • For Group ‘A’ posts: CBT of 85 MCQs (85 marks) and Interview of 15 marks; total 100 marks with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC).
  • For Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts: CBT of 100 MCQs (100 marks) with minimum qualifying criteria of 40% (General/EWS) and 35% (SC/ST/OBC); no interview for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts.
  • There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in CBT.
  • Shortlisting will be done post-CBT for scrutiny of applications and document verification, using candidate-wise merit and prescribed ratios (3× or 5× of posts as applicable).
  • For Staff Car Driver Ordinary Grade and Security Guard Grade-II, shortlisted candidates must qualify Trade Test/Physical Efficiency Test as per parameters given in the guidelines.
  • Final selection will be based purely on merit: marks in CBT for Group ‘B’ and ‘C’ posts, and CBT plus Interview for Group ‘A’ posts, subject to verification of documents and eligibility conditions.

General Information/Instructions

  • Information relating to this recruitment including Addendum/Corrigendum, CBT notice, results, eligibility notice, provisional and final results will be displayed only on PGIMER’s website; no individual intimation will be sent.
  • All applicants must read the Guidelines and Help Manual carefully before online registration and ensure that no column is left blank and all entries are correct; once submitted, entries cannot be changed.
  • Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages and may be cancelled if eligibility conditions are not met or incorrect information is found at any stage, even after appointment.
  • Incomplete applications, applications without requisite documents, applications where fee is not paid properly, or where eligibility/age criteria are not met, are liable to be rejected without correspondence.
  • No offline application form or copy of downloaded application form will be accepted by PGIMER.
  • Roll Numbers/Admit Cards for the CBT will be available online only and must be downloaded from the website; they will not be sent by post.
  • No TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in document verification or further stages of recruitment.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant; candidates must be in good mental and bodily health as per medical examination requirements.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must visit PGIMER website (www.pgimer.edu.in), check the advertisement and confirm their eligibility before applying online.
  • Applicants should have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, which must remain active throughout the recruitment process; these are required for initial registration and communication.
  • Candidates must first complete online registration by filling mandatory details like Advertisement Number, Date, Name (as per Matriculation), Date of Birth, Mobile Number and Email ID; these details cannot be changed once registered.
  • After registration, candidates should log in using their User ID and password, fill the Online Application Form section-wise (personal information, qualifications, experience, and document uploads), and then proceed to fee payment.
  • Application fee must be paid online through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card using the payment gateway on the application portal; fee is non-refundable.
  • Candidates must upload legible scanned copies of required documents: educational qualifications (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificates, experience certificates, NOC (if applicable), etc.
  • Photograph must be a clear passport-size coloured photo with light background, in .jpg/.jpeg format, 50–80 KB in size, showing the candidate’s name and date of photograph (snapped on or after 01.10.2025).
  • After final submission and successful fee payment, candidates should take a printout of the completed application form for future reference; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Age Limit 

  • Minimum Age: 18 years for all categories
  • Maximum Age for General Category: 37 years

If the remaining age after deduction does not exceed 3 years from the upper age limit as per service rules, the candidate will be considered eligible.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Candidates who successfully apply online will be called for an Objective Type Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) written examination
  • Merit List Preparation: The merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination
  • Tie-Breaking Rules: In case of equal marks in the written examination:
    • First preference: Older candidate (based on date of birth)
    • Second preference: Higher percentage in required educational qualification
    • Third preference: Higher marks in Matriculation examination
  • Document Verification/Counseling: Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for document verification/counseling. The number of candidates called will be decided by the Board or competent authority considering category-wise vacancies
  • Final Selection: Only after successful verification of all documents and fulfillment of eligibility criteria, candidates' names will be recommended to the concerned department based on available vacancies
  • Important Note: Appearing in online application, written examination, merit list, or counseling does not guarantee selection. Final recommendation depends on complete eligibility verification and vacancy availability

General Information/Instructions

  • Punjab Domicile Mandatory: Only residents of Punjab State are eligible for reservation benefits. Valid Domicile/Residence Certificate (not older than 5 years) must be submitted during counseling
  • Category Certificates: SC/BC/Ex-Servicemen/PWD/EWS certificates must be as per Punjab Government's prevailing instructions
  • Category Code Selection: Candidates must carefully select category and category code while filling the online form as it cannot be changed at any stage
  • Ex-Servicemen Priority: ESM (Self) candidates will be given first preference. Only if ESM (Self) is not available, ESM (Dependent) candidates will be considered
  • Women Reservation: Recruitment will be done as per Punjab Civil Services (Reservation of Posts for Women) Rules, 2020, Notification No. G.S.R. 87/Const/Art.309 and 15/2020 dated 21/10/2020
  • Document Upload: Candidates must scan and upload required certificates in PDF format in a single file during online application
  • No Personal Communication: All recruitment-related information will be published only on the Board's website. No individual communication will be sent to candidates
  • No TA/DA: No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for attending written examination or counseling
  • Board's Rights Reserved: The Board reserves the right to modify/cancel/increase/decrease the number of vacancies or category-wise distribution at any stage of recruitment
  • Final Decision: The decision of the Board or Committee constituted by the Board shall be final and binding on all candidates

How to Apply

  • Step 1 - Visit Official Website: Visit the official website of PSSSB at https://sssb.punjab.gov.in
  • Step 2 - Click on Online Applications: Click on "Online Applications" link on the website
  • Step 3 - Select Post: For Advertisement 16, first click on Junior Engineer post, then select one from Civil/Mechanical/Electrical as per your qualification
  • Step 4 - Registration: Fill personal and educational details carefully and complete registration. A Username will be generated after successful registration
  • Step 5 - Login and Fill Form: Login using the generated Username and complete the application form step-wise
  • Step 6 - Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of passport size photograph, signature, Matriculation certificate (for date of birth), 12th certificate, Diploma/Degree certificates, and category certificates (if applicable)
  • Step 7 - Submit Application: After uploading all documents, submit the complete application form. The form will be accepted only after successful fee payment
  • Step 8 - Fee Payment: After submitting the form (skipping one day), pay the application fee through:
    • State Bank of India branch via Challan (on any working day)
    • Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI (anytime before 31-12-2025)
  • Step 9 - Download Application Form: After successful fee payment (after 2 days), download and print the application form for future reference
  • Step 10 - No Correction After Submission: Once submitted, no changes can be made to the application form. Candidates must fill the form carefully
  • Important Note: Candidates are advised to apply themselves and not take help from cyber cafes to avoid errors. Self-application is recommended
  • Technical Support: For technical issues during online application, email at [email protected]

  • Latest Caste & Disability (PwD) certificates wherever applicable should be produced

Documents Required at Time of Joining

ECIL being highly protected establishment, Selected Apprentices should produce the following documents at time of joining:

  • Character/Conduct certificate from the concerned institution where they last studied
  • Police verification certificate from concerned District Police Superintendent
  • A physical fitness certificate from a Civil Assistant Surgeon

Important Instructions

  • Before applying, candidate should read the advertisement carefully and ensure eligibility criteria is fulfilled in all respects
  • The application is liable for rejection at any stage of engagement process in case of suppression of facts/furnishing of false information
  • If any shortcoming is noticed even after Apprenticeship commencement, apprenticeship will be liable for termination forthwith
  • No separate communication will be sent to any candidate on their non-selection at any stage of engagement process
  • ECIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the selection process, if need arises, without assigning any reason
  • ECIL reserves the right to increase or decrease the notified seats based on need
  • ECIL will not be responsible for Network/Internet related difficulties/issues
  • Canvassing in any form will result in immediate rejection of application
  • Any Legal proceeding can be instituted only in jurisdiction limited to Courts at Medchal District, Telangana

Important Caution

  • Some unscrupulous elements may approach candidates with assurance of procuring Apprenticeship through illegal gratification
  • Candidates must not fall prey to such assurance or exploitation
  • Selection exercise will be done only on basis of merit and in a transparent manner
  • Corrigendum, if any shall be published only on official website
  • Do not rely on other websites/social media handles for any information or updates

How to Apply

Application Process (Two Steps)

STEP 1: NATS Registration

  • Interested candidates who possess required criteria/educational qualification MUST register themselves on National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) website
  • Visit: www.nats.education.gov.in
  • Complete the registration process

STEP 2: ECIL Online Application

  • Subsequent to registration in NATS portal, interested eligible candidates shall submit online application through ECIL website
  • Visit: www.ecil.co.in > Careers > Current Job Openings
  • Fill and submit the online application form before 20/01/2026 (16:30 Hrs.)
  • Take printout of registered online application form with system-generated application serial number
  • Note down application serial number for all future references

IMPORTANT NOTE: Applications submitted on ECIL website shall only be accepted and considered.

Documents Required for Document Verification

Candidates called for document verification shall require to present following original documents mandatorily with a set of photocopies:

  • Online registered application form duly signed by candidate with recent color passport size photo affixed
  • All original certificates in support of NATS Registration
  • Date of Birth certificate
  • Identity proof (Govt. issued only like Aadhaar, Driving License, Passport etc.)
  • Educational Qualification certificates (B.E./B.Tech. or Diploma)
  • All mark sheets and consolidated marks sheet
  • CGPA to percentage conversion certificate (if applicable)
  • Latest Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer/EWS) in prescribed proforma
  • Disability (PwD) certificate (wherever applicable) showing 40% or above disability

Document Verification Venue

  • Venue: Electronics Corporation of India Limited, Corporate Learning & Development Centre (CLDC), Nalanda Complex, ECIL (PO), Hyderabad-500062
  • Phone: 040-27186454, 040-27182279
  • Dates: 28/01/2026 to 30/01/2026

TGSRTC Traffic Supervisor Trainee & Mechanical Supervisor Trainee Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details
