Note: LR – Limited Recruitment (Backlog) - All these vacancies will be filled up with the local candidates of the respective Revenue Zone only. DR – Direct Recruitment. The number of vacancies indicated is tentative and liable to change without any notice.

Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility by Gender

  • Men and Women are eligible for the Posts of Traffic Supervisor Trainee and Mechanical Supervisor Trainee
  • 33⅓% of the vacancies in each category are reserved for Women under Direct Recruitment on horizontal basis

Educational Qualifications

  • For Post Code No. 47 (Traffic Supervisor Trainee): Must possess a Graduate Degree awarded by any university in India, established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or of any Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission or any other equivalent qualification as on 1st July 2025
  • For Post Code No. 48 (Mechanical Supervisor Trainee): Must have passed Diploma in Automobile/Mechanical Engineering conducted by the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or its equivalent qualification in the same discipline as on 1st July 2025
  • Candidates possessing higher qualification of BE/B Tech/AMIE in the discipline of Automobile/Mechanical Engineering are also eligible for Post Code 48
  • Candidates who possess higher qualification than the prescribed one will also be considered for Post Code 47

Essential Qualifications

  • All educational qualifications must be obtained as on 1st July 2025
  • Degrees must be from universities in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, Provisional Act of State or from institutions recognized by the University Grants Commission
  • Diploma must be from the Department of Technical Education, Government of Telangana or equivalent

Desirable

  • For Departmental Candidates: Must have completed 5 years of service on regular basis as an approved probationer as on 25th December 2025

Experience

  • No specific experience mentioned as mandatory for external candidates
  • Departmental candidates must have 5 years of regular service in TGSRTC as on the date of notification

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: ₹27,080 – ₹81,400 per month
  • During Training Period (12 months): Selected candidates shall be eligible for stipend i.e., minimum of the time scale of Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • After Training: On successful completion of training, candidates will be appointed in the regular post as Deputy Superintendent (Traffic)/Deputy Superintendent (Mechanic)
  • During both regular and extended training period, candidates will receive the stipend amount

Age Limit (as on 1st July 2025)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 25 years
  • Upper Age Limit Relaxation: Government of Telangana vide GO Ms No. 30 dated 08-02-2024 have raised the upper age limit by 12 years (making it 37 years) for direct recruitment

Additional Age Relaxations

  • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years in addition to the length of service rendered in the Armed Forces (Indian Army/Indian Navy/Indian Air Force/Indian Territorial Army)
  • SC, ST, BC and EWS Category: 5 years
  • Departmental Employees (SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation to the extent of service rendered in the Corporation on regular basis, subject to maximum age not exceeding 45 years as on 1st July 2025
  • Departmental Employees (Other than SC/ST/BC): Age relaxation up to maximum of 10 years regular service, subject to maximum age not exceeding 40 years as on 1st July 2025

Note: Date of Birth accepted is that entered in the Secondary School Certificate or Matriculation or equivalent examination certificate. No other document relating to age will be accepted.

Application Fee

Post Name SC/ST Local to Telangana All Others
Traffic Supervisor Trainee ₹400/- ₹800/-
Mechanical Supervisor Trainee ₹400/- ₹800/-
  • Fee is towards Registration of Application, Processing of Application, Conduct of Test, Maintenance of Portal etc.
  • Fee can be paid using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or any other mode available on TSLPRB Website
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Date 25th December 2025
Online Application Start Date 30th December 2025 (8:00 AM)
Last Date for Online Application 20th January 2026 (5:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date As on 1st July 2025
Qualification Date As on 1st July 2025

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: All eligible registered candidates shall be required to appear for Written Exam in one paper (three hours duration) for 200 marks (200 Questions - MCQs)
  • Paper Pattern for Traffic Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 47):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Numerical Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Paper Pattern for Mechanical Supervisor Trainee (Post Code 48):
    • Supervisory Aptitude: 60 Questions
    • Engineering Aptitude: 40 Questions
    • Reasoning: 40 Questions
    • General English: 30 Questions
    • General Knowledge: 30 Questions
    • Total: 200 Marks
  • Language of Question Paper: Questions will be set in English, Telugu and Urdu languages (except General English and Engineering Aptitude which will be in English only)
  • Answer Sheet: Candidates have to answer questions on an OMR answer sheet using Blue/Black Ball Point Pen only
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • OC including EWS: 40%
    • BC Category: 35%
    • SC/ST Category: 30%
  • Merit Determination: Selection shall be made strictly on relative merit based on score in Written Examination
  • Zone-wise Selection: First 5% of posts filled following combined Qualified Candidates List, remaining 95% filled by local candidates of respective zones
  • Tie-Breaking: When two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference given to candidate who was born earlier
  • Certificates Verification: Candidates must produce original documents for verification
  • Medical Examination: Provisionally selected candidates will undergo medical fitness examination
  • Biometrics: Fingerprints and photographs will be taken at the time of Written Examination and whenever required

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted through ONLINE mode only on TSLPRB Website (www.tgprb.in)
  • Candidates must check their eligibility carefully before applying
  • Only online applications will be considered
  • Candidates should not furnish any false, tampered or fabricated particulars
  • All testimonials issued by competent authorities must be produced when required
  • Claims regarding Age, Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, Community etc. are accepted provisionally
  • If under-aged or over-aged candidates apply, their candidature will be rejected at any time
  • Candidates must use their personal mobile number as User ID which should remain active throughout recruitment process
  • No relevant column of Online Application Form should be left blank
  • Once submitted, no corrections can be made to the Online Application Form
  • Passport size photo and specimen signature must be combined as one file/image in jpg format (30kb to 100kb)
  • Application will be rejected if candidate uploads only photo without signature
  • Candidates should not submit more than one application
  • Giving false information will result in disqualification and prosecution
  • Candidature is provisional at all stages
  • TSLPRB reserves right to reject candidature at any stage without notice
  • Impersonation will be viewed adversely and prosecuted criminally
  • Candidates must behave in orderly and disciplined manner during examinations

Medical Standards

  • Candidate must be in good health mentally and bodily
  • Persons with disabilities are not eligible
  • Vision Test/Standards:
    • Distant Vision: Naked Eye vision 6/24 in each eye, corrected vision 6/9 with glasses in each eye
    • Near Vision: J1 with Glasses
    • Colour Vision: Normal (Colour blindness is disqualification)
    • Field of Vision: Normal
    • Fundus: Normal
  • Provisionally selected candidates will be referred to District Headquarters Hospital for medical examination
  • Candidates declared unfit in eye issues will be referred to Sarojini Devi Eye Hospital, Hyderabad
  • Candidates advised to have medical examination before applying

Reservation Information

  • Reservation as per Rule 22 and 22(A) of Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 applicable
  • 33⅓% vacancies reserved for Women on horizontal basis
  • Reservation for Local Candidates as per Presidential Order, 2018 and Regulation 8 of TGSRTC Recruitment Regulations
  • SC, ST and BC candidates must be local to Telangana to claim reservation
  • SC candidates must submit Community Certificate as per Act No. 15 of 2025 dated 14.04.2025 with sub-classification
  • BC candidates must submit Non-Creamy Layer Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • EWS candidates must submit Income and Asset Certificate issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • BC-E Group relaxation subject to adjudication of litigation and government orders

Documents to be Uploaded

  • SSC/Matriculation Certificate for Date of Birth
  • Educational Qualification Certificates
  • Study Certificate from 1st to 7th class or Residence Certificate issued by MRO
  • Latest Community Certificate issued by Telangana Government
  • Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for BC candidates) issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable) issued on or after 1st April 2025
  • PPO/Discharge Book (for Ex-servicemen)
  • Service Certificate from TGSRTC (for Departmental candidates)

Training and Service Bond

  • Selected candidates will undergo 12 months training
  • Provisionally selected candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond to serve the Corporation for 5 years after training

Disqualification Grounds

  • Suppression of material facts
  • Canvassing for support
  • Having more than one spouse
  • Previously dismissed from government service
  • Convicted by court of law for offence involving moral turpitude

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Register on TSLPRB Website www.tgprb.in using Mobile Number as User ID
  • Step 2: Select the Post(s) for which you want to apply as per eligibility
  • Step 3: Note the fee amount depending on Post chosen and category
  • Step 4: Pay the fee using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or other available modes
  • Step 5: After payment, continue on TSLPRB Website with User ID and fill the Application Form
  • Step 6: Prepare combined image of Passport Photograph and Specimen Signature as one file in jpg format (30kb to 100kb)
  • Step 7: Scan and upload the photo+signature file with Online Application Form
  • Step 8: Fill all relevant columns carefully without leaving any column blank
  • Step 9: Carefully read all instructions before clicking "I AGREE"
  • Step 10: Endorse the declaration and confirm with OTP sent to registered mobile
  • Step 11: Verify all details carefully before submission
  • Step 12: Click Submit button to complete the application process
  • Step 13: Download a copy of submitted application form in PDF for future use
  • Use "Apply Online" option in main menu after payment of fee
  • Candidates advised to fill application themselves to avoid wrong entries
  • Ensure photo and signature are uploaded together as one file, otherwise application will be rejected
  • Even after payment, if Submit button is not pressed, application will be rejected
  • No corrections possible after submission
  • Do not submit more than one application

Eligibility Criteria for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed SSC / 10th Standard or equivalent with Science subjects, with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, one of the following must be met:

  • ITI certificate or national/state trade certificate in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 2 years’ full-time experience as an apprentice trainee in the relevant trade from a recognized institution, OR
  • 3 years of work experience in the relevant trade in a government organization/PSU/Autonomous Body.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for CSIR-CMERI Recruitment 2025 is:

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years (as on the last date of online application: 21.01.2026)
  • Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC-NCL, 10-15 years for PwBD, 5 years for Departmental/Govt. employees, and for Ex-Servicemen and Widows/Divorced Women as per government norms.

Application Fee for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

A non-refundable fee of Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only) is mandatory for applicants other than Ex-servicemen, SC/ST, Women, and PwBD candidates. The fee must be deposited online through the State Bank Collect system; payment through any other mode will result in application rejection.

Salary/ Stipend

The post is in the Pay Level – 2 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) Pay Matrix (₹19,900-₹63,200). The total emoluments (Basic Pay + DA + HRA + TA etc.) are approximately ₹ 37,000/- per month at the minimum of the scale when stationed at Durgapur/Ludhiana.

Selection Process for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I 2025

The selection process consists of two stages:

  • Trade Test: Online applications will be screened, and shortlisted candidates will be called for a trade test, which is qualifying in nature.
  • Competitive Written Examination: Candidates who qualify in the trade test will be called for a written examination (OMR or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination). The final merit list will be prepared solely on the marks obtained in Paper-II and Paper-III of this examination.

How to Apply for CSIR-CMERI Technician-I Recruitment 2025?

Eligible candidates are required to apply ONLINE only through the CSIR-CMERI website.

  1. Visit the official website: www.cmeri.res.in.
  2. Register with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, ensuring all details are accurate.
  4. Pay the application fee online through State Bank Collect and upload the e-receipt.
  5. Upload scanned copies of a recent photograph, signature, and all relevant certificates (education, ITI, experience, category, Aadhaar Card, NOC if applicable).
  6. Submit the application online before the deadline. Candidates should not send a hard copy after online submission.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Eastern Coalfields Limited (A Subsidiary of Coal India Limited) invites applications for engagement of one full time Advisor (E&M) on contractual basis from retired E7 or above grade executives or equivalent from CIL and its subsidiaries, PSUs or Autonomous Organizations of Central / State Government.

Eligibility Criteria

Project Assistant-II (P-2601)

  • Qualification: 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
  • Desirable: Experience in Electrical Vehicle prototype development, PLC and Instruments, tractor testing, data collections

Project Assistant-II (P-2602)

  • Qualification: 3 Years Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Technology
  • Desirable: Hands-on experience on development, assembly and integration of various small mechanical, electronic, electrical components of vehicle/mechanical systems. Capability to develop manufacturing drawings using Auto CAD software and mechanical system integration. Field data survey & collection

Project Technical Support-III (P-2603)

  • Qualification: Four Years Graduate degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Production/Mechanical Design/Aeronautical/Mechatronics
  • Desirable: Experience and Knowledge in ANY ONE or more of the following:
    • Design and analysis of Mechanisms and Machines
    • Dynamics and Control of Mechanical systems/Multibody Dynamics (ADAMS/ANSYS Motion etc)
    • Solid mechanics, Mechanics of composites
    • Solid Modeling Software (any of Solidworks/CATIA/Inventor/Siemens NX etc.)
    • Finite Element Method (ANSYS Mechanical/Abaqus/Marc etc.)
    • Programming in Matlab/C++
    • Physics based/Robot simulation software such as Gazebo/MuJoCo/PyBullet etc.
    • Basics of instrumentation, data acquisition, experiment design, sensing and actuation principles

Project Associate-I (P-2604)

  • Qualification: M.Sc. in Chemistry/Physics from a recognized University
  • Desirable: Background knowledge of energy materials and carbonaceous materials

Project Associate-II (P-2605)

  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Civil/Applied Mechanics/Aerospace from a recognized University or equivalent and 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services OR Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Civil/Applied Mechanics/Aerospace from a recognized University
  • Desirable: Finite Element Modeling and Analysis, Dynamic Modeling of Multibody systems, Mathematical Programming

Project Associate-II (P-2606)

  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Mechatronics/Robotics/Production/Mechanical Design/Robotics & Mechatronics/Engineering Design from a recognized university or equivalent and 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services OR Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Mechatronics/Robotics/Production/Mechanical Design/Robotics & Mechatronics/Engineering Design from a recognized university
  • Desirable: Conversant in product modelling and engineering softwares like SolidWorks, Ansys FEM/Catia/ProE, Cradle CFD/Siemens NX and dynamic simulation cum analysis software like ADAMs. Knowledge of Design & Analysis, Structural/Stress & Stability Analysis, Bulking Analysis of pressure enclosures or other structures

Project Associate-II (P-2607)

  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electrical and Electronics/Electrical from a recognized university or equivalent and 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services OR Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Electrical and Electronics/Electrical from a recognized university
  • Desirable: Knowledge in Signal Processing, Analog & Digital Electronics. Handling of SBC interface and motor control device and communication using Arduino/Raspberry Pi micro controller. Knowledge of algorithms development and implementation real-time project. Proficiency in Python, Matlab, C++ Programming, HTML. Development of interface with different sensors/instruments and system Integration, use of third-party DLLs and other drivers etc. Field data survey & collection. Technical Report writing

Project Associate-II (P-2608)

  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Electronics/Electronics and Instrumentation/Electrical/Mechatronics/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Electrical & Electronics/Control System/Information Technology from a recognized University or equivalent and 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services OR Masters/Integrated Masters in Engineering or Technology in Electronics/Electronics and Instrumentation/Electrical/Mechatronics/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Electrical & Electronics/Control System/Information Technology from a recognized University
  • Desirable: Knowledge of Signal Processing, PCB Design, Electric motors, Power Electronic Converters, Motor controllers, Programming using Python/C++, MATLAB/SIMULINK based simulation

Salary/Stipend

  • Project Assistant-II (P-2601): Rs. 20,000/- per month with increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project
  • Project Assistant-II (P-2602): Rs. 20,000/- per month with increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project
  • Project Technical Support-III (P-2603): Rs. 28,000/- per month
  • Project Associate-I (P-2604): Rs. 31,000/- per month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent. Rs. 25,000/- per month for others
  • Project Associate-II (P-2605): Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR National level examinations. Rs. 28,000/- per month for others
  • Project Associate-II (P-2606): Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR National level examinations. Rs. 28,000/- per month for others
  • Project Associate-II (P-2607): Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR National level examinations. Rs. 28,000/- per month for others
  • Project Associate-II (P-2608): Rs. 35,000/- per month for candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET incl. lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE OR National level examinations. Rs. 28,000/- per month for others

Age Limit (as on 21/01/2026)

  • Maximum Age: 35 years for all positions
  • Age Relaxation: Relaxation in age limit of the candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD/WOMEN shall be 05 years. For OBC category candidates, relaxation is 03 years or as per the Government of India/CSIR rules
  • Age Calculation Date: The date for determining the upper age limit will be the date of interview of the respective Post Code (21/01/2026)

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 06/01/2026
Walk-in Interview Date 21/01/2026
Reporting Time 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM
Project Tenure (P-2601) Up to 31/03/2028
Project Tenure (P-2602) Up to 31/03/2026 (Extendable up to 16/09/2027)
Project Tenure (P-2603) Up to 14/09/2026 (Extendable up to 2028)
Project Tenure (P-2604) Up to 31/03/2026 (Extendable)
Project Tenure (P-2605) Up to 31/03/2026
Project Tenure (P-2606) 6 Months (Extendable up to March 2028)
Project Tenure (P-2607) Up to 31/03/2026 (Extendable up to 16/09/2027)
Project Tenure (P-2608) 6 Months (Extendable up to March 2028)

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on Walk-in Interview conducted at CSIR-CMERI, Durgapur on 21st January 2026
  • The selections will be based on the performance and overall assessment of the candidates by the selection committee
  • Candidates must appear at the walk-in interview with all their original certificates and mark sheets
  • Self-attested photocopy of each certificate and a recent passport size photograph must be brought along with filled-in Application Form
  • Application Form is available on the Institute website
  • The result of the interview will be published on the institute's website or may also be communicated via email
  • Hindi/English Language can be opted as a medium of communication during interview
  • The selection process may continue till late evening/next day
  • If it is found at any stage of the process or thereafter that the candidates do not fulfil the eligibility criteria, their candidature shall be cancelled without assigning any reason whatsoever
  • The decision of CSIR-CMERI in regard to the selection process will be final and binding to all concerned

General Information/Instructions

  • This is an excellent opportunity for young and motivated candidates looking to grow, explore career possibilities, and take the next step toward their future careers
  • Selected candidates will have the opportunity of hands-on training/exposure and to work closely with experienced team members
  • Actual number of positions may vary on the date of the Interview
  • Tenure as mentioned in the advertisement is tentative and liable to be curtailed/extended as per decision of the Competent Authority
  • In any case, tenure is co-terminus with the project or till such time this requirement exists whichever is earlier
  • Candidates who have already engaged in CSIR-CMERI or any other Lab/Institute of CSIR as a Trainee/Project Assistant/Project Fellow/JRF/SRF/Project Associate/Research Associate etc. for a period of 6 years or more are not eligible for these engagements
  • Candidates who have engaged for a period less than 6 years, upon selection, their tenure will automatically end on completion of six years
  • Selected Candidates will be engaged for above mentioned period of the respective project, which may also be curtailed or extended up to completion of project period or maximum six years, whichever is earlier
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the Walk-in Interview
  • Candidates are advised to come prepared accordingly as the selection process may continue till late evening/next day
  • Candidates who are presently engaged in any project either in CSIR-CMERI or any other Labs/Institute of CSIR, should produce the NOC for appearing for the interview from Competent Authority, failing which, they will not be allowed to appear in the interview
  • Offer of engagement to the selected candidates will be issued subject to availability of fund and approval of the Competent Authority
  • No correspondence in this regard will be entertained by the Institute
  • In case of any doubt/discrepancy of the Advertisement between Hindi and English version, the English version of the same will be treated as final

How to Apply

  • Candidates interested in the positions should appear for Walk-in Interview on 21st January 2026
  • Reporting Time: 09:30 AM to 11:30 AM
  • Venue: CSIR – Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute, M.G. Avenue, Durgapur-713209, West Bengal, India
  • Candidates must bring the following documents:
    • All original certificates and mark sheets
    • Self-attested photocopy of each certificate
    • Recent passport size photograph
    • Filled-in Application Form (available on the Institute website)
  • Candidates must appear at the scheduled date and time mentioned for the walk-in interview
  • For candidates presently engaged in CSIR-CMERI or any other CSIR Labs/Institute, NOC from Competent Authority is mandatory
  • Candidates should verify their eligibility for the specific post code before appearing for the interview
  • The date for determining the upper age limit, qualification and/or experience will be the date of interview (21/01/2026)
  • Download the Application Form from the Institute website before appearing for the interview

Selection Process

  • Project Assistant (Mechanical):
    • Selection through Objective Type Offline Test (Phase I – 80 marks) and Descriptive Type Test (Phase II – 20 marks); total 100 marks.
    • Objective test (Multiple Choice Questions) – areas: General Knowledge (5 marks), Reasoning (5 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (10 marks), General English (10 marks), Discipline related (50 marks); duration 90 minutes; no negative marking.
    • Descriptive Test – Writing skills in English (20 marks); duration 45 minutes.
    • Minimum pass marks: 50% of total marks in each test for all categories (except PwBD); 40% for PwBD candidates.
    • Discipline-wise merit list prepared based on aggregate marks of Objective and Descriptive tests; tie resolved by Discipline-related marks and then seniority in age.
    • Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called for certificate verification; only those successfully completing verification and found medically fit will be provisionally selected.
  • Office Attendant:
    • Phase I – Objective Type Offline Test (60 minutes) comprising 50 Multiple Choice Questions: General Questions (40 marks) and Quantitative Aptitude (10 marks); medium English and Bengali/Hindi; no negative marking.
    • Minimum pass marks: 50% of total marks for unreserved posts (except PwBD); 40% for PwBD candidates.
    • Candidates scoring minimum pass marks and above in Phase I will be shortlisted for certificate verification and Phase II Practical Test.
    • Phase II Practical Test – held at CSL-Kolkata Ship Repair Unit or other centre; minimum pass marks same as above.
    • Rank list prepared based on marks of candidates who meet eligibility and pass both Phase I and Phase II; tie resolved on Objective Test marks and then seniority in age.
  • General:
    • Tests will be held in West Bengal as decided by CKSRU on behalf of CSL; exam centre allocation at sole discretion of CSL.
    • CSL/CKSRU reserves right to scrutinise applications and permit only shortlisted candidates to attend selection process.

General Information/Instructions

  • Posting will be at CKSRU / any other CSL units / project sites; candidates are liable to be transferred within different units and to serve in any department, on-board ships or at any work sites/projects in India or abroad.
  • Government of India directives on reservation will apply; reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) as per guidelines, with minimum disability of 40% and valid certificate.
  • Applicants must ensure they meet eligibility requirements; incomplete applications, applications with junk data or without required documents/fee are liable to be rejected.
  • CSL reserves the right to increase/decrease number of vacancies, not to fill any vacancy or cancel recruitment process; vacancies are purely on contract basis and do not confer any right to permanent employment.
  • Rank lists will be maintained for posts and operated to fill vacancies arising within validity period (up to 18 months from date of reporting of last candidate), at CSL’s discretion.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification; only Indian Nationals need apply.

How to Apply

  • Online application to be submitted through CSL website (Career → CKSRU, Kolkata) only; applications by post or any other mode will not be accepted.
  • All entries in online application must be correctly filled; once submitted, data cannot be changed; incomplete/withdrawn/draft applications will not be considered.
  • After successful submission, status of application must show “In process”; candidates should retain soft copy/printout with unique registration/application number for reference.
  • Applicants need not send printout of application, certificates or fee instruments by post to CKSRU/CSL.
  • Online application facility remains functional from 30 December 2025; last date for submission is 20 January 2026; candidates are advised to apply well before last date to avoid technical issues.

  • Visit the official website of West Bengal Municipal Service Commission: www.mscwb.org
  • Click on the online application link for Advertisement No. 17 of 2025

  • Fill in the online application form completely with correct information

    • UR & OBC: Rs.200/- (Rs.150 Application Fee + Rs.50 Processing Charges)
    • SC/ST & PWD: Rs.50/- (Processing Charges only)

The short-listing norms may not be uniform across the departments/ posts of the Institute and shall be binding on all the applicants. Priority of shortlisting shall be as under: (i) All three degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (ii) At least two degrees (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500. (iii) At least one degree (UG/PG/PhD) from IIT/IISc/IIM/NIT or reputed institute with NIRF ranking within 100 for universities and engineering institutes or 50 for management institutes for three years or foreign university an institute in QS/THE world ranking upto 500.
  • The decision of the Institute related to all matters pertaining to the recruitment shall be final and binding on the applicants.
  • Note: if the candidate achieves the degree under integrated mode, then it shall be considered as two degrees among UG/PG/PhD.
  • Policy on avoiding ‘In-Breeding’: Candidates who have obtained their most recent Degree (Ph.D.) from NIT Raipur, will not be considered for recruitment, except where there is a 3-year gap between leaving the Institute and last date of the submission of online application.
  • Govt. of India (GoI) norms of Reservations are followed in the Institute. All reserved candidates are required to submit their Caste/Category certificates in prescribed format [Annexure-IV/V/VII] along with the hard copy of application. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof of Caste/Category.
  • The Caste/Tribe/Community certificates (Annexure-IV) in the proforma prescribed and issued by any of the authorities stated in the OM No. 36012/6/88-Estt. (SCT), Dated 24.4.1990 and OM No.36012/22/93-Estt. (Res.), Dated 15.11.1993, GoI, No. 36028/1/2014-Estt (Res), Dated 3rd September, 2015 will only be accepted as sufficient proof in support of a candidate’s claim belonging to Schedule Caste/ Schedule Tribe/ Other Backward Class (NCL). Relevant Caste /Tribe/ Community certificates are required to be submitted with duly completed application form. No other certificate will be accepted as sufficient proof.
  • (i) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of SCs given at: https://socialjustice.gov.in/common/76750 or https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Compendium-2016.pdf
  • (ii) The caste of the candidate must be in the State-wise Central list of STs given at: https://tribal.nic.in/ST/LatestListofScheduledtribes.pdf
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate issued on or after 1stApril 2025 shall only be considered for reservation under OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) category. [Refer Annexure-V].
  • EWS certificate should be issued by Competent Authority (Tahsildar or above). Also, this certificate must be issued on or after 1st April 2025 in order to be considered for reservation under EWS category [Refer Annexure-VI], (NOT APPLICABLE IN THIS ADVERTISMENT).
  • The persons with disability (PWD) shall be required to submit the Disability/Medical Certificate in the prescribed form (Annexure–VII) issued by the Competent Medical Authorities for the purpose of employment as per Government of India norms along with the hard-copy of the application form.
  • The reserved candidates who have applied for unreserved posts will not be eligible for any age relaxation or any other concessions as per DOPT Office Memorandum No. 36011/1/98 Est. (Res) Dated, 1-7-98.
  • The directives contained in the matter of reservation in posts and implementation of Central Educational Institutions Act, 2019 enunciated in the Ministry of Education’s letter dated 05.11.2019 (attached herewith as Annexure-VIII) shall be applicable.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing any influence of any form will be treated as disqualification for the faculty position applied.
  • Legal disputes if any, with NIT Raipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Raipur Courts only.
  • The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, documents and photographs, etc.
  • The list of candidates shortlisted for further participation in the selection process such as written test/presentation/interview etc. will be displayed on the Institute Website only. The applicants need to keep on visiting Institute Website www.nitrr.ac.in for updates. No correspondence will be made regarding non-eligibility/ not-short listing/ non-selection of the candidates.
  • Information uploaded on the website shall not be provided to the candidate or any other person under R.T.I Act. 2005. The information uploaded on the website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are advised to download the uploaded information and keep with them for future. During ongoing process of recruitment, neither any application under Right to Information Act. 2005 shall be entertained nor information will be provided. Factual information under the R.T.I Act shall be provided only after declaration of final results of the process. Inferential questions or speculative questions shall not be answered in RTI.

How to Apply

  • Please note that application(s) filled only through the official portal (Google Chrome is more friendly for filling the online application) in the institute website (www.nitrr.ac.in) shall be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted but summarily rejected. Applicants are required to apply separately for different Posts in the same discipline or in different Disciplines/Departments. A print-out of the application form obtained from the Online Portal, duly signed by the candidate, should be sent to the Institute along with self-attested photocopies of the supporting documents, testimonials and the proof(s) of Fee paid. The duly completed Application Form along with all above-mentioned enclosures must be sent by Speed/Registered Post/By Hand to the Registrar, National Institute of Technology Raipur, Raipur -492010, Chhattisgarh, India, failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • Complete hardcopy of Application Form(s) for each applied Branch/Discipline/ Post must be submitted in separate envelopes. The envelope containing the application must be superscribed as “Application for the Post of ‘Assistant Professor’/ ‘Associate Professor’/ ‘Professor’ in the Department of ………………………………”
  • Please note that the deadline for online application is 17/02/2026 till 5:30 PM and the last date of receiving hard copies of the print-out of the online application prepared as given in point 12 above, is 27/02/2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  • Please also note that an online application for which hard-copy application along with necessary documentation is not received in the Institute upto the stipulated time, the online application will be rejected summarily.
  • NIT Raipur shall in no case be responsible for postal delays and hard copies of the applications received after the last date will be rejected along with its online version.
  • The Institute reserves the right to extend the last date. Therefore, candidates are advised to keep visiting the Institute Website regularly.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualifications:
    • Law Graduate (LL.B) OR Masters in Social Work (MSW) from a University established by law in India.
    • Working knowledge of Hindi written in Devnagari Script and knowledge of Rajasthani culture.
  • Candidates who are appearing in the final year examination of the required educational qualification are also eligible to apply, but must produce proof of passing before the competitive examination conducted by the Commission.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay-Matrix Level: L-11 (Grade Pay -4200/-).
  • Note: During the probation period (परिवीक्षाकाल), a fixed monthly salary (Fix Pay) will be payable as per State Government rules.

Age Limit (as on 01 January2027)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years.
  • Maximum Age: 40 years.
  • Age relaxation provided as per rules (e.g., 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS Male of Rajasthan; 10 years for SC/ST/OBC/MBC/EWS Female of Rajasthan; 5 years for General Female).

  • Candidates will be selected through a written competitive examination (लिखित परीक्षा).

  • Minimum passing marks are 40% in each paper.
  • The names of suitable candidates will be recommended to the state government based on merit order from the written exam marks.

  • The post is permanent (स्थाई).
  • Reservation benefits are available only to original residents of Rajasthan state.

  • Admit cards and all further information will be uploaded only on the RPSC website (rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in).

How To Apply

  • Apply online via the RPSC website `https://rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in` or SSO Portal `https://sso.rajasthan.gov.in` by selecting the Recruitment Portal in Citizen Apps (G2C).
  • Complete the One Time Registration (OTR) process.
  • Fill the detailed online application form, upload a live photo, signature, and left thumb impression scan.
  • Pay the non-refundable OTR/application fee online.
  • Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Further, the provisionally selected eligible candidates may be required to go through the skill and aptitude test (Situation Analysis Test & Presentation) on the date of interview for their final short-listing to appear for Interview so as to restrict the numbers to a reasonable limit.

General Information / Instructions

1. The applicant must be the citizen of India and below 56 years of age.

2. The candidates should go through all the instructions & recruitment rules carefully and ensures that they fulfill all eligibility conditions. Their candidature to any stage of the recruitment process will be provisional subject to satisfying the eligibility criteria for the post.

3. The candidates should carefully fill up all the details required in the application form as no correspondence regarding change of details will be entertained after the submission of application/last date for applying. If any of their claims is found to be incorrect, it will lead to the rejection of their candidature.

4. The applicant will be responsible for the authenticity of submitted information, other documents and photograph. Furnishing of any false information and/or suppression / concealment of facts shall lead to rejection/cancellation of selection/appointment.

5. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates, by shortlisting, to be called for selection process to a reasonable limit on the basis of qualifications, relevance of experience higher than the minimum prescribed in the advertisement, other academic / professional achievements. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee candidates being called for selection process. The qualifications prescribed should have been obtained from recognized University / Institutions.

6. The Institute reserves the right to decide the mode of screening of applications for short listing. Institute reserves the right to reject or accept the candidature of any applicant at any stage and also has right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement / recruitment process, if need arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereto. The mode of selection process for the post may be through presentation and/or interview, or through interview only.

7. Candidates are advised to fill their correct and active e-mail addresses in the online application as all correspondence will be made by the Institute through e-mail only. Schedule for selection process will be e-mailed in due course to the candidates in their registered e-mail. No separate letter (Hard copy) will be sent for this purpose. Further, for any updates, please visit the Institute website regularly, for subsequent amendments, if any, in the advertisement and for results.

8. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised post.

9. The details regarding qualification and experience etc. are as per the recruitment rules for non-teaching staff of NITs notified by the Ministry of Education (MoE) vide letter no. F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 04th April 2019. However, any modification in the recruitment rules notified by MoE will be applicable. The selection procedure will governed by the latest recruitment rules and OMs issued by MoE till the date of interview.

10. The age limit and qualifications/experience etc. for the post shall be determined as on the last date of submission of application form.

11. Date of birth mentioned in Online Recruitment Application is final. No subsequent request for change of date of birth will be considered or granted.

12. The Candidate should pay a non-refundable processing fee through online mode as below: ➢ For the candidates other than SC/ ST/ PwD/ Woman Category: Rs. 1,000 (Rupees One Thousand only) ➢ For SC/ ST Category: Rs.500 (Rupees Five hundred only) ➢ For Woman/ PwD Category: No fee is required. ➢ Application processing fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

13. Application form without self-attested copies of certificates/testimonials and prescribed application fee will not be considered and shall be rejected.

14. Mere fulfillment of the required qualifications and experience etc., does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview/selection.

15. Further, the provisionally selected eligible candidates may be required to go through the skill and aptitude test (Situation Analysis Test & Presentation) on the date of interview for their final short-listing to appear for Interview so as to restrict the numbers to a reasonable limit.

16. Besides the pay in the pay matrix as per the 7th CPC, admissible allowances applicable for the post like DA, HRA etc. in accordance with Institute Rules in force from time to time are payable. The employees of the Institute will be entitled to medical benefits for self and family as per the relevant rules. Leave Travel Concession for self and family as per Central Government Rules.

17. Officers under the Central/State Governments/Universities/Recognized Research Institutes or Institute of national importance or Govt. laboratory or PSU are eligible to apply for the post through proper channel for appointment on Deputation (including Short Term Contract).

18. The print out of application duly signed in each page should be routed through proper channel and accompanied with required self attested documents and duly certified attested copies of Annual Confidential Report (ACR)/Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR) for the last five years, Experience certificate, Vigilance Clearance Certificate from the Competent Authority. If the candidates anticipate unavoidable delay in their applications being forwarded through proper channel, they may submit advance copies of their applications alongwith self-attested copies of other credentials directly to The Deputy Registrar, Establishment Section, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur, JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India, which will be considered provisionally. Candidates will be allowed to appear for the selection process only if the applications are duly received being forwarded through proper channel by the employer. Institute shall not be responsible for any postal /courier delay.

19. Applications submitted online but not followed by sending complete hard copies will not be considered. Applications through any mode, without the online version of the application submitted through the online portal of the Institute, shall also be summarily rejected and no further correspondence will be entertained.

20. Any Vigilance/Disciplinary cases/Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the candidates working in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered.

21. Canvassing in any form / bringing in any influence, political or otherwise will be treated as a disqualification for the post. Interim enquiries will not be entertained. If it is found at any stage that any information given in the application is incorrect / false, the candidature / appointment is liable to be cancelled / terminated.

22. The review of performance of incumbent appointed on the post of Registrar will be carried out by a Committee (to be constituted by the Board) upon completion of one year of service of the incumbent.

23. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of selection, the decision of the Director MNIT Jaipur in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, conduct of examination/ interview will be final and no query or correspondence will be entertained in this connection from any individual.

24. In case of any mistake occurring inadvertently in the process of selection, which may be detected at any stage even after the issue of offer of appointment, the Institute reserves the right to withdraw /cancel / modify any communication made to the candidates.

25. Any Vigilance/ Disciplinary cases / Criminal cases should not be pending/ contemplated against the applicant in any Government Organization. In such cases, application shall not be considered. A Certificate in this regard is to be submitted by the applicant.

26. The pay and conditions of deputation of the Officer selected will be regulated in accordance with the Department of Personnel & Training (DoPT), Govt. of India O.M. No.6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time and other instructions of the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India or Board of Governors of MNIT, Jaipur issued in this regard from time to time. For the meaning of deputation and short term contract, the DoPT, Govt. of India O.M. No.AB.14017/13/2013-Estt. (RR) (1349) shall be taken into reference.

27. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

28. No TA/DA or local conveyance shall be paid to the applicants called for Interview.

29. The candidates will be called for the interview on the basis of information furnished by them. The appointment will be solely subject to fulfillment of all the eligibility conditions for the advertised post.

30. All original documents will have to be produced at the time of interview for verification.

31. Pay of the selected candidate will be fixed as per the recommendations of the selection committee and subsequent approval of the Board of Governors (BoG) of the Institute. No request for higher pay/pay protection not recommended by the selection committee will be entertained before or after joining.

32. The decision of the Institute in all matters will be final. No correspondence, whatsoever, will be entertained from the candidates in connection with the process of selection/interview. Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.

33. The applicants are required to visit the Institute website regularly as any subsequent corrigendum/addendum etc. shall be published on the Institute website only.

34. In case the last date of receiving the hard copy of applications falls on a holiday, then the next working day (till 5 PM only) shall be treated as last day.

35. Legal disputes, if any, with Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur will be restricted within the jurisdiction of Jaipur, Rajasthan only.

36. Helpline e-mail ID for any query related to online fee and form submission is [email protected]

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates must apply ONLINE only through the Institute website https://www.mnit.ac.in.
  • Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted and summarily rejected.
  • Every completed online application shall be identified by a unique application reference number, which should be used for all future communication.
  • All the candidates are advised to download the same from Institute website and send hard copy of the downloaded PDF of the filled application form along with the self-attested copies of the relevant testimonials, certificates, enclosures etc. before the last date by speed post/registered post/courier to:
  • The Assistant Registrar, Establishment Section – II, Prabha Bhawan, Malaviya National Institute of Technology, Jaipur JLN Marg, Jaipur, Rajasthan-302017, India Failing which their candidature will not be considered.
  • The envelope containing the application be super scribed as “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF REGISTRAR”.

  • No married candidate shall be eligible for appointment if he/ she had, at the time of his/her marriage, accepted any dowry; Explanation: For the purpose of this sub-regulation, "Dowry" has the same meaning as in the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (Central Act 28 of 1961).

No candidate shall be eligible for appointment who has more than two children on or after 01.06.2002.

Provided that :-

(i) the candidate having more than two children shall not be deemed to be disqualified for appointment so long as the number of children he/she has on 1st June, 2002, does not increase.

(ii) where a candidate has only one child from earlier delivery but more than one child are born out of a single subsequent delivery, the children so born shall be deemed to be one entity while counting the total number of children.

(iii) while counting the total number of children of a candidate, the child born from earlier delivery and having disability shall not be counted.

(iv) any candidate who performs remarriage which is not against any law and before such the remarriage he is not disqualified for appointment under this sub-regulation, he shall not be disqualified if any child is born out of single delivery from such remarriage.

(v) the provisions of this sub-regulation shall not be applicable to the appointment of a widow and divorcee women.

(vi) if a candidate has adopted a child following the necessary legal requirements, as a result of which the number of children he/she had on 01.06.2002 has increased above two, such adopted child shall not be counted while calculating number of his/her children. However, a child given on adoption shall be counted in total number of children.

The candidates applying for the above position shall ensure that, they maintain a healthy credit history at the time of joining. The candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks / NBFCs/ Financial Institutions including credit card dues and have not regularized / repaid their outstanding thereunder till the date of issuance of letter of offer of appointment by the Rajasthan Financial Corporation, shall not be eligible for appointment to the post. However, candidates who have regularized / repaid such outstanding on or before the date of issuance of offer of appointment, but whose CIBIL status has not been updated till then, shall, on or before the date of joining, shall have to either get the CIBIL status updated or produce the NOCs from lender to the effect that there is no outstanding with respect to the accounts adversely reflected in the CIBIL, failing which the letter of offer shall be withdrawn / cancelled. Thus, the candidates with record of default in repayment of loans / credit card dues and / or against whose name adverse report of CIBIL or other external agencies are available are not eligible for appointment. Candidates are advised to check / confirm CIBIL score / status before applying.

The applicant should be willing to work at any of the Branch office or Head office of the Corporation as directed by the Management of Rajasthan Financial Corporation. The recruited officers may be posted to any Department/ section of Rajasthan Financial Corporation, irrespective of their stream.

Note:1) Candidates must possess working knowledge of Hindi written in Devnagrik script. All the educational qualifications mentioned should be from a University / Institution / Board recognized by Govt. of India / approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies and the result should have been declared on or before 01/12/2025.

Proper document from Board / University for having declared the result on or before 01/12/2025 has to be submitted at the time of verification of original documents. The date of passing the examination which is reckoned for eligibility will be the date of passing appearing on the mark- sheet / provisional certificate.

2) Candidate should indicate the percentage obtained in qualification calculated to the nearest two decimals in the online application. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, the same should be converted into percentage and indicate the same in online application.

3) Calculation of Percentage: The percentage marks shall be arrived at by dividing the marks obtained by the candidate in all the subjects in all semester(s) / year(s) by aggregate maximum marks in all the subjects irrespective of honours / optional / additional optional subject, if any. This will be applicable for those Universities also where Class / Grade as decided on basis of Honours marks only.

The fraction of percentage so arrived will be ignored i.e. 59.99% will be treated as less than 60% and 49.99% will be treated as less than 50%.

4) A candidate can apply for only one post and not more than one application should be submitted by any candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained and the application fee / intimation charges paid for the other multiple registration(s) will stand forfeited.

There will be penalty for wrong answers marked in the Objective Tests. For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate one fourth or 0.25 of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty to arrive at corrected score. If a question is left blank, i.e. no answer is marked by the candidates; there will be no penalty for that question.

The Descriptive Test of 30 minutes duration with 50 marks will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay). The candidates are required to qualify in the Descriptive Test by securing passing marks, to be decided by the Rajasthan Financial Corporation.

Descriptive Test paper of only those candidates will be evaluated who have scored qualifying marks in the Objective Tests and are placed adequately high as per total marks in objective test.

Rajasthan Financial Corporation reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination which will be intimated through its website. Other detailed information regarding the examination will be given in an Information Handout, which will be made available for the candidates to download along with the call letters from the authorized Rajasthan Financial Corporation website Rajasthan Financial Corporation.rajasthan.gov.in

Please note that candidates will not be permitted to appear for the online examination without the following documents:

a. Valid Call Letter for the respective date and session of examination.

b. Photo-identity proof(as specified) in original bearing the same name as it appears on the call letter / application form

AND

c. Photo copy of photo-identity proof (as mentioned in (b)above)

Candidates reporting late i.e. after the report time specified on the call letter for examination will not be permitted to take the examination.

The reporting time mentioned on the call letter is prior to the start time of the test. Though the duration of the examination is 3 hours, candidates may be required to be at the venue for about 4 hours or more including the time required for completion of various formalities such as verification and collection of various requisite documents, logging in, giving of instructions etc. and including disruptions beyond control.

Note :- Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid ID proof.

The examination will be conducted online in venues given in the respective call letters.

No request for change of center for examination shall be entertained.

  • The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers.

  • Skill Test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill Test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of vacancies are subject to change. Further, the employer has the right to cancel or modify notification without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Abbreviations used: UR - Un-reserved
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given age relaxation and other concession meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • The age relaxation will be applied only in case of those candidates who produce valid certificate(s) of Caste/Category.
  • Date of Birth filled in by the candidate in application form and the same recorded in the matriculation examination certificate will be considered for determining the age and no subsequent request will be accepted.
  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability rules". Candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on the Organisational interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Candidates are allowed to apply only for one trade and applications once submitted cannot be modified under any circumstance. No application will be received by hand.
  • Persons working in Central Govt./State Govt/PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority of his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admi Cards will be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection/late receipt of applications. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/illegible application will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without correct advertisement reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents along with application form. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents or providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates at any stage of recruitment/ selection will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature. The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard.
  • Date & Place of Bio-metric, Document Verification, Written Examination and Skill Test (where applicable) for each trade will be intimated via admit card which will be sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate along with the application form and through Electronic means. Candidate to ensure that correspondence address, E-mail ID and telephone number provided in the application form remain valid for the future communication.
  • Candidates should bring their pen, pencil and clipboard for Written Examination.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/rejection will be final.
  • No Transportation Allowance/Dearness Allowance will be admissible. Examination including Written /Skill Test (where applicable) will be for TWO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangement for Lodging/ Boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence) for confirmation while reporting for the bio metric, document verification, written test and skill test (where applicable), which should have same name as given in the application form.
  • Capturing of Bio-metric details will be done on first day of documents verification and Bio-metric verification will be carried out on subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for written test/skill test (where applicable) and on reporting to unit by selected candidates.
  • The recruitment process including any part of examination can be cancelled/ postponed/ suspended/ terminated without any prior notice/ assigning any reasons at any stage.
  • Provisionally selected candidates have to produce original and photocopy of the following documents/certificates duly self-attested on the date and time intimated by the recruiting establishment:
  • (a) Matriculation certificate/Municipality Birth Certificate in support for date of birth.
  • (b) Aadhar Card.
  • (c) Mark Sheet of the educational qualification mentioned against the post applied for.
  • (d) Any certificate for the desirable qualification.
  • (e) Discharge certificate in case of Ex-serviceman.
  • (f) NOC in original from their present employer/competent authority in case of Government servant including serving Armed Forces Personnel if applicable.
  • (g) In case of widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husband, a certified copy of judgement/degree of the appropriate court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case may be.
  • (h) Address proof (Passport/Ration Card/Voter Card/Driving Licence).
  • Candidates on selection are liable to be transferred anywhere across India including field services liability and not necessarily at the choice of location given at time of application.
  • Any representation for redressal of grievances with regard to the recruitment will be subject to the jurisdiction of the District Court of Delhi Cantonment Area where candidate has submitted the application.
  • The unit will not be liable/responsible for paying any compensation in case of any injury/death suffered by the candidate during the recruitment process.

Candidates are requested to superscribe the words "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF......................." on the top of the envelope while sending the application form. Candidate to ensure that valid E-mail ID and Aadhaar linked Telephone number are mentioned in the application form.

IIM Bangalore Associate Manager 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for IIM Bangalore Associate Manager – Finance and Accounts Recruitment 2026 is 02 posts. The vacancy distribution is as follows:

  • Position 1: Focus on compliance matters along with regular F&A operations
  • Position 2: Focus on UG Campus operations along with compliance & audit function

Eligibility Criteria for IIM Bangalore Associate Manager 2026

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess Bachelor's Degree in Commerce and should be a CA / ICWA Inter from a recognized institution to apply for IIM Bangalore Associate Manager – Finance and Accounts positions.

Experience Required

Candidates must have a minimum of 7 years of experience handling the roles and responsibilities mentioned in the job description. Prior experience in managing statutory compliance within an industry, PSU, government organization, or similar autonomous institutions of higher education is highly preferred.

Nationality

Candidates must be Indian citizens as per the eligibility norms specified in the official notification.

About the Job Role

The incumbents are expected to contribute to strengthening the systems and processes in Direct and Indirect Tax Compliances, Monthly Closure, MIS, budget and budgetary controls, financial analysis & projections, planning etc.

Principal Roles & Responsibilities

  • Handle accurate and timely preparation and filing of all applicable Direct Tax returns (Form 10, 10B, 10AB, 10BD, 15CA / 15CB, Income Tax Return, e-TDS returns, etc)
  • Prepare, review and ensure timely filing of all required monthly and annual GST Returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-9) in a timely manner; Maintain accurate and organized records of all GST Related transactions
  • Monitor and respond to tax notices from various tax authorities
  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline tax processes and leverage technology to improve efficiency, accuracy and risk management within the tax function
  • Manage UG Campus financial activities – which includes cash flow, reconciliations, ledger accuracy, compliance and risk management, budgetary support, MIS, etc
  • Ensure accurate verification, compliance checks and timely processing of RA bills related to construction projects at the UG campus
  • Handle Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes and related compliances (procure to pay and record to report)
  • General Ledger controlling and reconciliations
  • Compilation of budgets, variances and preparation of related MIS reports
  • Support in the finalization of accounts and in handling CAG audits and other audits
  • Support the proposed ERP implementation for student modules
  • Support to Payroll function
  • Any other work assigned from the department/institute from time to time

Key Skills and Ability Requirements

  • Proven experience of handling GST and Income Tax compliances is mandatory
  • Keep abreast of changes in regulatory requirements and update Institute's policies to maintain compliance
  • Strong Analytical and Planning skills for Audit and compliance processes across the Institute
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines
  • Experience in working in an ERP environment-preferably Oracle Fusion/People Soft and possesses advanced excel skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and have strong people management skills
  • Supervise, mentor and provide guidance and training to junior staff
  • Knowledge of public procurement policies, GFR, GeM etc.
  • Ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders and should have ability to work effectively with members of the staff and faculty

How to Apply for IIM Bangalore Associate Manager 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for IIM Bangalore  Associate Manager – Finance and Accounts 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.iimb.ac.in
  2. Look for the "Associate Manager – Finance and Accounts Recruitment 2026" notification
  3. Read the official notification carefully
  4. Click on the "Apply Online" link provided in the notification
  5. Register with your email ID and mobile number
  6. Fill in the application form with correct and accurate details
  7. Upload the required documents as specified
  8. Review your application and submit it
  9. Take a printout of your submitted application for future reference

Eligibility Criteria

  • Sr. Consultant (Finance): Passed in the final examination of CA / ICWA from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India / Institute of Cost Accountants of India respectively. Should have at least 16 years of post-qualification experience in Finance and Accounts. Preferably in Corporate Financial Management and Planning, Financial Analysis & Reporting Project Appraisal, Project Financing & Monitoring, Capital Budgeting, Costing, Budgetary Control, Treasury Management, Direct & Indirect Taxation, Foreign Exchange Management Exposure of working in ERP package like SAP, Oracle etc would be an added advantage.   • Consultant (Finance): Passed in the final examination of CA / ICWA from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India / Institute of Cost Accountants of India respectively OR Bachelor’s Degree (in First Class) with MBA (Finance)from a recognized Institute/ University [in First Class or Equivalent CGPA in both Graduation and Post- Graduation] [with documentary proof for equivalent to MBA]. Should have at least 2 years post qualification of experience in Satcom related field viz. realization and maintenance requirement of different satellite earth / stations, satellite data processing systems and communication links. Preparation and technical evaluation of different techno commercial documents / agreements / contracts.
  • Consultant (HR & ADMIN): Full Time Bachelor's Degree [in First Class or equivalent CGPA] with Full Time PG Degree / MBA/ MSW/ MA [in First Class or equivalent CGPA] with specialization in Human Resources/ Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations/ Labour Management / Organizational Development/ etc., from recognized Institutes / Universities.   • Consultant (Purchase & Store): Bachelor’s Degree [in First Class or equivalent CGPA] with MBA [In First Class or equivalent CGPA] in Operations/ Materials Management/International Business.   • Young Consultant (Electronics & Communication): BE/B. Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering from Government recognized University. Should have at least 2 years of post-qualification experience in relevant field (higher experience is preferable). Experience in satellite communication/RF Engineering/Semi-Conductor related field will be added advantages.
  • Young Consultant (Mechanical): BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from Government recognized University. Should have at least 2 years of post-qualification experience in relevant field (higher experience is preferable). Experience in design/analysis/fabrication/testing of satellites and aerospace hardware and related fields will be an added advantage.
  • Consultant (SATCOM): BE / B Tech (Electronics & Comm)/MTech in Electronics/ communication or training programme on SATCOM Certificates credentials or licenses related to Satellite communication. Should have at least 4 years post qualification experience for BE/ B Tech or 2 yrs for MTech/ PG Diploma in SATCOM related field.
  • Consultant (EO): M. Tech/Post Graduate Diploma in Remote Sensing & GIS or equivalent. Should have at least 2 years’ experience in relevant field.
  • Consultant - Cyber Security: 1st class Full Time B.E./ B.Tech. from recognized University/Institute in Computer Science/ Computer Engineering/ Information Technology discipline with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA. AND Specialization in Cyber Security at M. Tech or PhD level or certifications in anyone of CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)/ Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) / CISSP/ Comp TIA CySA + / GSEC/ OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)/ CISM. Should have minimum 04 years of post-qualification experience in the following areas: 1. Possess and maintain broad technical and business knowledge of all aspects of IT Infrastructure security and management technologies including end-point security, mobility management, client operating systems, Sandboxing, Firewall, DLP, VDI, WAF, PAM, Active Directory, Application whitelisting, File Integrity Monitoring, Network Access Control, CDR, Infrastructure and endpoint security solutions including Anti-malware, EDR, MDM, Network Access Control, Proxy etc. 2. Should have experience on Core security technologies (Next Gen firewalls, IDS/IPS, SIEM/SOAR, SNMPv3, EDR, Syslog) and technical knowledge on SOC. 3. Should have experience on handling of security threats/threat Intelligence tools and framework/threat attack methods/cyber forensics. 4. Should have experience on VAPT tools (Burp Suite/ Metasploit/ (Ryby)/ Accunetix/ Open VAS/ Nessus/ ZAP/ CommandoV, Wireshark, NMAP) 5. Knowledge on monitoring and managing Threat Intelligence Platform, consume and manage threat feeds, detecting Cyber threats and alerting and work on cyber threats, indicators of compromise (IoCs), and MITRE, kill chain methodologies. 6. Knowledge of conducting digital forensic analysis using Forensic and Log analysis Tools (Commercial and Open-source tools) such as EnCase, Forensic Toolkits (FTK), ELK, The Sleuth Kit (TSK) etc.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2025

Candidates willing to apply for the UCSL Graduate & Technician (Diploma) Apprentice posts must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility conditions specified in the notification. The criteria mainly cover educational qualification, age, domicile and previous apprenticeship status.

Educational Qualification

The educational qualifications for various apprentice categories are given below.

For Category I – Graduate Apprentices (Mechanical Engineering):
Candidates must possess a Degree in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline granted by a Statutory University, by an Institution empowered by an Act of Parliament, or by professional bodies recognized by the Central/State Government as equivalent. Where universities issue grades (CGPA/OGPA/CPI etc.) without percentage, the percentage will be calculated as per the university formula or, if not defined, by multiplying aggregate grade points by 10.

For Category II – Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Electrical Engineering):
Candidates must have a Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant discipline granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education, or by a recognized University, or by an Institution recognized as equivalent by the Central/State Government. Candidates possessing qualifications declared equivalent must upload an Equivalency Certificate issued by the competent authority, failing which their candidature will not be considered.
