Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules and apprenticeship provisions.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Selection Process 2025

The UCSL Apprentice selection is primarily based on shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by certificate verification and medical fitness. Only candidates who are domicile of Karnataka are considered, as clearly mentioned in the notification.

The UCSL apprenticeship selection process is carried out broadly in the following stages.

1. Screening & Shortlisting of Candidates:
Candidates are shortlisted based on the details furnished in the NATS portal such as educational qualification, marks, year of passing, and domicile criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for certificate verification, where original documents for age, qualification, percentage of marks, caste, disability etc. along with self-attested copies must be produced; failure to produce originals results in rejection.

2. Certificate Verification & Provisional Selection:
Candidates who successfully complete certificate verification are provisionally considered for selection against notified seats in the order of merit and reservation, subject to medical fitness. The final engagement is confirmed only after meeting minimum physical standards prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules 1992 and other general conditions.

Final Merit: The final merit list for apprenticeship seats is prepared based on eligibility, merit and reservation after certificate verification and medical fitness; there is no written test or interview mentioned for this notification.

Graduate & Technician Apprentice Application Fee 2025

Candidates applying for the UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025 are not required to pay any application fee. The notification clearly mentions that the application fee is Nil for all categories.

Category Application Fee
General/OBC/EWS Rs. 0 (Nil)
SC/ST Rs. 0 (Nil)
PWD Nil
Female Candidates Nil

Application fee is fully waived and candidates only need to complete registration and application on the NATS portal within the specified dates.

UCSL Apprentice Salary 2025

Candidates selected as Graduate and Technician (Diploma) Apprentices at UCSL receive a fixed monthly stipend along with meals allowance during the one-year training period. There is no mention of pay level or permanent post salary in this notification as the engagement is purely apprenticeship.

Component Details
Post Graduate Apprentice (Mechanical) / Technician (Diploma) Apprentice (Electrical)
Pay Level Not applicable (Apprenticeship stipend only)
Graduate Apprentice Stipend Rs. 15,000 per month + Meals allowance
Technician (Diploma) Apprentice Stipend Rs. 13,200 per month + Meals allowance
Training Duration One year Apprenticeship training as per Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973
Allowances & Benefits Meals allowance; no boarding/lodging provided by UCSL; no travel expenses during training.

The notification clearly states that boarding or lodging will not be provided by UCSL and no travel expenses are admissible during the apprenticeship training period.

How to Apply for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the UCSL Graduate & Technician Apprentice Recruitment 2025 through the NATS portal only. The step-by-step application procedure differs slightly for candidates already registered in the old portal and for new users.

Step-by-Step Process:

For candidates already registered in old apprentice portal (portal.mhrdnats.gov.in):

  1. Visit https://nats.education.gov.in and go to the student login page
  2. Use the “Forgot password” option to activate your account in the new NATS portal.
  3. Login and complete your application/profile form ensuring all details are correct.
  4. After migration/activation, login again and search for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Click on “Apply”; the status will change to “applied”.

For candidates without registration in old apprentice portal:

  1. Go to https://nats.education.gov.in.
  2. Click on “Student” and then on “Student Register”.
  3. Complete the registration form; a unique enrolment number will be generated for each student.
  4. Login with the new credentials and search for “UDUPI COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED” under “Apply against advertised vacancies”.
  5. Click on “Apply”; the status will show “applied”.

For any issues related to the NATS portal, candidates can contact Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Southern Region, Chennai via email at [email protected].

Official Notification PDF: Available on www.cochinshipyard.in > Career > UCSL (Malpe) and www.udupicsl.com > Career Page
Apply Online (NATS): https://nats.education.gov.in
Official Website (UCSL): www.udupicsl.com

Important Instructions for Apprentice Recruitment 2025

  • Ensure that all eligibility conditions, including qualification, age, domicile and previous apprenticeship status, are satisfied before submitting the application.
  • Make sure marks and other details are entered correctly; any mismatch with uploaded mark sheets may lead to summary rejection.
  • No application fee is required, but applications must be submitted within the prescribed dates through the NATS portal only.
  • Call letters for certificate verification will not be sent by post; candidates must regularly check their registered email ID and the UCSL/CSL websites for updates.
  • Submission of application will be treated as unconditional acceptance of all terms and conditions mentioned in the vacancy notification.
  • Candidates who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship under the Apprentices (Amendment) Act 1973 in any organisation are not eligible to apply.
  • Upon completion of apprenticeship period, UCSL has no obligation to offer employment and apprentices cannot claim right to employment on this basis.
  • Any suppression of facts or furnishing of false information at any stage will lead to cancellation/rejection of candidature without further notice.
  • All legal proceedings related to this selection will fall under the jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals at Udupi only.
  • Any amendment, modification or addition to the advertisement will be published only on CSL/UCSL websites.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) - UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025

Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A1. The last date to apply online through the NATS portal is 21.01.2026.

Q2. What is the age limit for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A2. Candidates must be above 18 years of age as on 22 December 2025, with upper age relaxation applicable as per Government of India apprenticeship rules.

Q3. How many vacancies are available in UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A3. A total of 5 apprenticeship seats are available, including 3 Graduate Apprentices (Mechanical) and 2 Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Electrical).

Q4. What is the selection process for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A4. Selection is through shortlisting and certificate verification in the order of merit and reservation, followed by medical fitness; no written test or interview has been mentioned.

Q5. What is the application fee for UCSL Apprentice Recruitment 2025?
A5. There is no application fee (Nil) for all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, PwBD and female candidates.

Q6. Is there any negative marking in the UCSL Apprentice exam?
A6. No written examination is specified in the notification, so negative marking is not applicable.

Q7. Can I edit my application form after submission?
A7. The notification does not mention a separate correction window; candidates should fill the NATS application carefully before final submission.

Q8. What is the stipend for UCSL Apprentices?
A8. Graduate Apprentices receive Rs. 15,000 per month plus meals allowance, while Technician (Diploma) Apprentices receive Rs. 13,200 per month plus meals allowance during training.

Q9. Is domicile of Karnataka mandatory for this recruitment?
A9. Yes, the notification clearly states that only candidates who are domicile of Karnataka are eligible for selection.

Q10. Where will the apprenticeship training be conducted?
A10. The apprenticeship training will be conducted at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe in Karnataka State.

Disclaimer: Candidates must refer to the original UCSL notification and the official websites of UCSL/CSL and NATS for any subsequent updates or changes before applying.

General Information / Instructions

Reservation of Person with Benchmark Disability (PWD) will be as per prevailing guidelines of Government of India. In case candidates in these categories are not available, then the vacancies will be filled from the panel of candidates who attend the walk-in-interview in view of essential services of the Medical College and for fulfillment of NMC Norms.

NOTE:

  1. A. In case of Non-availability of candidates for faculty positions in a particular reserved category, the available meritorious candidate may be given offer of engagement for a period of 44 days at the sole discretion of the Appointing Authority. B. In the Departments of Anatomy, Physiology, Biochemistry, non-Medical teachers may be appointed to the extent of 15% of the total number of posts in the department subject to non-availability of medical teachers. The eligibility criteria, in this regard, would be in accordance with NMC Norms.
  2. Number of vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual number of Vacancies without any intimation.
  3. ESIC reserves right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage at its discretion and such decision will be binding on all concerned.
  4. Candidates intending to apply for multiple cadres may submit separate applications including fee.
  5. Candidates applying in OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PWD Category must possess the certificate issued by competent authority, valid for appointment in Central Govt. Institutions issued before the date of interview, failing which he/she shall not be allowed to appear in interview for the reserved category. However, he/she can be treated as UR Candidate.
  6. Candidates claiming reservation on grounds of OBC should submit the community certificate in updated original, as prescribed vide Govt. of India, Dept. of personnel and training O.M No 36036/2/2013 Estt. (Res.) dated 30.05.2014 failing which benefits of reservation will not be given and their application shall be rejected. Certificate issued in other format will not be accepted and candidate will be treated as general category for all purpose (format enclosed).
  7. PAY & ALLOWANCES: a) ESIC has adopted Consolidated Remuneration structure for Contractual Faculty as per Headquarters Letter No. letter No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med-IV (Pt. file), dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-MEDVI, dated. 08.12.2022 (updated from time to time). b) In addition to the above no other allowances like D.A, N.P.A, HRA etc. would be payable. c) No Private Practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC. d) Retirees from Central/State Govt./PSU from the equivalent posts are eligible to apply. Persons working in recognized / approved private Medical Institutions fulfilling eligibility criteria for the post may also apply.
  8. TERMS OF CONTRACT: a) Selected candidates shall be appointed purely on contractual basis for a period of one year, which may be extended for another one/two years on satisfactory performance subjected to approval of the Competent Authority. The contract would be terminated in case regular incumbent joins. b) The contractual engagement can be terminated/discontinued on either side after giving one-month notice. c) Barring serious misconduct/irregularity, continuation of the incumbent would be based on satisfactory annual appraisal and approval of the Competent Authority. Other terms and condition will be applicable as issued by competent authority from time to time. d) This being One-year contract, absence for period beyond 15 days without prior permission/approval of Competent Authority will be treated as abandonment of duty and the contract will be terminated without any notice and security deposit will be forfeited. e) The absence from work for a period of fifteen days without proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and automatic termination. The Medical Officers are required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadhar Enabled Bio- metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily during scheduled working days. f) On selection, candidate has to open an SB Account in the State Bank of India (Any branches) [This is applicable to cases where SB account is not held in State Bank of India]. g) The Teaching Faculty so engaged will be required to enter into a contractual agreement for the purpose on a stamp paper of Rs.500/- h) Selected candidates will have no claim for regularization of services in ESIC Hospital/Medical Institution. i) The appointment is subject to Medical Fitness. j) Official selected will be required to submit acceptance/consent letter in writing before appearing for medical examination. k) The doctors at any time found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of his/her duties shall be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu of notice period. l) Selected candidates have to report for joining within the date indicated in the offer of appointment to be issued after release of results, failing which the offer will be treated as cancelled. m) Official has to wear his/her own white coat with name badge during the duty hours. n) The engagement will be for a period till the joining of regular incumbent. The contract would initially be for one year, to be extended for another one year on satisfactory performance, with a minimum term of one year in respect of Teaching Faculty.
  9.  CAUTION DEPOSIT: a) He/ She will be required to deposit a Security Deposit of above mentioned amount for the post mentioned through Demand Draft in favor of ESI Corporation payable at Kalaburagi at the time of joining which is refundable after completion of contract period and production of “No Dues Certificate”. b) The Caution Deposit will be appropriated towards the ESI Fund in case the appointed candidate terminates his/her contract within six (06) months of the date of reporting towards Administrative cost. General Instructions: (i) Mere submission of application does not confer any right to the candidate to be eligible for interview unless they report on the scheduled date and time. (ii) Application should be submitted in the prescribed format only. The applications submitted in any other for- mat OR incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. (iii) The candidates may ascertain their eligibility and report for interview on the scheduled date and time for in- terview. Candidates reporting after scheduled time will not be allowed to attend the interview process. (iv) Wrong declarations/submission of false information or any other action contrary to law shall lead to cancel- lation of the candidature at any stage in addition to suitable legal action. (v) Opportunity for appearing in the interview given to the candidates is purely on provisional. Joining of the candidates will be subject to detailed scrutiny of eligibility conditions/production of prescribed certificates in case of reservation. (vi) On the day of Walk-in-Interview, the candidates should produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) from present employer. (vii) Equivalent Teaching Experience Certificate issued by DGAFMS for retired Army Medical Teachers at the time of Interview. (viii) The candidates who have applied for higher post may opt for lower post during the interview in the same de - partment. (ix) The interview shall be conducted at the Office of the Dean, ESIC Medical College, Kalaburagi. However, ESIC reserves the right to change the venue and dates, if needed. (x) Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. (xi) Rules of reservation will be implemented as per Government of India’s instructions. (xii) No TA/DA will be admissible for interview or joining. (xiii) No claim for any services like PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical allowances, Seniority, Promotion and Leave will be admissible. (xiv) He/She will be entitled to Earned Leave and Half Pay Leave as admissible to temporary Govern - ment servant under Central Civil Services (Leave rules), 1972.
  10. CRITERIA OF INCOME & ASSETS (For Economically Weaker Section or EWS) Persons who are not covered under the scheme of reservation for SCs, STs and OBCs and whose family has gross annual income below Rs.8.00 Lakh (Rupees Eight Lakh only) are to be identified as EWSs for the benefit of reservation. Income shall also include income from all sources i.e. salary, agriculture, business, profession, etc. for the financial year prior to the year of application. Also persons whose family owns or possesses any of the following assets shall be excluded from being identified as EWS, irrespective of the family income: - I. 5 acres of agricultural land and above; II. Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. and above; III. Residential plot of 100 sq. yards and above in notified municipalities; IV. Residential plot of 200 sq. yards and above in areas other than the notified municipalities. The property held by a “Family” in different locations or different places/cities would be clubbed while applying the land or property holding test to determine EWS status. The term “Family” for this purpose will include the person who seeks benefit or reservation, his/her parents and siblings below the age of 18 years as also his/her spouse and children below the age of 18 years.
  11. INCOME AND ASSET CERTIFICATE ISSUING AUTHORITY AND VERIFICATION OF CERTIFICATE: The benefit of reservation under EWS can be availed upon production of an Income and Asset Certificate issued by a Competent Authority. The Income and Asset Certificate issued by any one of the following authorities in prescribed format as given in Annexure- I shall only be accepted as proof of candidates claim as belonging to EWS: i. District Magistrate/ Additional District Magistrate/Collector/Deputy Commissioner/ Additional Deputy Commissioner/ 1st Class Stipendiary Magistrate/Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Taluka Magistrate/Executive Magistrate/Extra Assistant Commissioner. ii. Chief Presidency Magistrate/Additional Chief Presidency Magistrate/Presidency Magistrate. iii. Revenue Officer not below the rank of Tehsildar and iv. Sub-Divisional Officer or the area the candidate and/or his family normally resides.

If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after appointment, his/her services are liable to be terminated.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification for State Service Posts: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University or equivalent qualification recognized by the Government.
  • Educational Qualification for Maharashtra Police Service: Candidates must have a Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University. Preference will be given to candidates with degrees in Law, Science subjects, or specialized qualifications relevant to police administration.
  • Essential Requirements: All educational qualifications must be obtained from institutions recognized by appropriate statutory bodies and must be valid as on the closing date of application (20/01/2026).
  • Desirable Qualifications: Post-graduate degrees, diplomas in relevant fields, and experience in administration or related sectors will be given preference during final selection.
  • Computer Knowledge: Basic knowledge of computer operations and MS Office applications is desirable for all posts.
  • Language Requirements: Knowledge of Marathi language is mandatory. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Marathi fluently.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years for all posts
  • Maximum Age for State Service (General Category): Varies by post (ranges from 33 to 40 years)
  • Maximum Age for Maharashtra Police Service: 33 years for unreserved category
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST Candidates: 5 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation beyond upper age limit
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD Candidates: 10 years for unreserved, 13 years for OBC-NCL, 15 years for SC/ST candidates
  • Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen: As per Government of Maharashtra rules
  • Age Relaxation for Women Candidates: Special relaxation applicable for widows, divorced women as per government norms
  • The crucial date for determining age will be 01-08-2026

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount Payment Mode
General/OBC/EWS Category (Male Candidates) As per MPSC Fee Structure Online Payment - Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI
Female Candidates (All Categories) Reduced Fee as per MPSC Rules Online Payment - Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI

Interview/Personality Test Date To be announced later

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination: Computer Based Test (CBT) or Written Examination of objective type questions covering General Studies, General Aptitude, and relevant subjects based on the post applied
  • Stage 2 - Mains Examination: Descriptive type written examination testing in-depth knowledge of subjects relevant to the service/post. The paper will be of conventional essay type covering specialized subjects
  • Stage 3 - Interview/Personality Test: Candidates who qualify in Mains Examination will be called for Interview to test their personality, communication skills, general awareness, and suitability for the post
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum qualifying marks for Preliminary Examination - General Category: 40%, OBC: 35%, SC/ST/PwBD: 33%
  • Negative Marking: For objective type questions in Preliminary Examination, 1/4th mark will be deducted for each wrong answer
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared based on marks obtained in Mains Examination and Interview combined
  • Physical Standards Test (for Maharashtra Police Service): Candidates must meet prescribed physical standards including height, chest measurements, and physical efficiency tests
  • Medical Examination: All shortlisted candidates must undergo medical examination as per standards prescribed by the Government
  • Document Verification: Original documents will be verified at the time of Interview stage

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian Citizens
  • Candidates must possess requisite educational qualifications on or before the last date of application submission
  • Only online applications will be accepted. Applications submitted through any other mode will not be entertained
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile number which should remain active throughout the recruitment process
  • Recent passport size photograph and signature in prescribed format must be uploaded during online application
  • Multiple applications by the same candidate will lead to rejection of all applications
  • SC/ST candidates of Maharashtra State only are eligible for fee exemption
  • Reservation will be provided as per Maharashtra State Government rules
  • Knowledge of Marathi is compulsory and candidates may be tested for Marathi language proficiency
  • Candidates serving in Government/Semi-Government organizations must submit No Objection Certificate at the time of Interview
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • The decision of MPSC will be final in all matters related to eligibility, selection, and appointment
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check MPSC website for updates and announcements

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official MPSC website https://mpsconline.gov.in
  • Step 2: Click on "Apply Online" link for the relevant recruitment notification
  • Step 3: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, mobile number, and create password
  • Step 4: Login with credentials and complete Part-I of the application form with personal details
  • Step 5: Upload scanned photograph and signature as per specifications mentioned in the notification
  • Step 6: Fill Part-II of application form with educational qualifications, experience, and other relevant details
  • Step 7: Select preferences for posts and examination centers carefully
  • Step 8: Pay application fee through online mode using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI
  • Step 9: After successful payment, submit the application form
  • Step 10: Take printout of the submitted application form for future reference
  • Step 11: Note down the application number/registration number for tracking application status
  • Important: Ensure all information filled is accurate. No corrections will be allowed after final submission
  • Required Documents for Upload: Recent photograph (JPG format, 50KB-100KB), Signature (JPG format, 20KB-50KB), SC/ST Certificate (if applicable), PwBD Certificate (if applicable)

MRVC Project Engineer (MEP) Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Category No. of Posts
Project Engineer (MEP) UR 2

Eligibility Criteria

  • Project Engineer (MEP): BE/B.Tech (Civil/Electrical/Mechanical) with not less than 60% marks from recognised (AICTE) University.
  • Where percentage of marks is not awarded by the university but only CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded, the same shall be converted into percentage in terms of conversion norms of the university.
  • Rounding off percentage will not be acceptable for considering eligibility; e.g. 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in MEP in Government organization/Public Sector Undertaking or Public Limited Company as Project Engineer or equivalent as on date of issue of the vacancy notification.
  • An in-depth understanding of MEP System is crucial, including expertise in HVAC components like air distribution and renewable energy systems, electrical systems such as power distribution, and plumbing knowledge for water system, storm drains, and gas piping.
  • Knowledge of tools like AutoCAD, Revit MEP software, MATLAB, and Simulink to create precise system designs and models.
  • Experience certificate issued by Public listed company having average annual turnover of Rs 500 Crore and above in last 3 Financial years (excluding current financial year), listed on National Stock Exchange or Bombay Stock Exchange, incorporated/registered at least 5 years prior to the date of issue of experience certificate, shall also be considered, provided the experience certificate has been issued by a person authorized by the Public listed company.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: IDA Equivalent E1 grade Rs.40,000-1,40,000.
  • Basic Pay: Rs.40,000/- per month.
  • Pay and perks include Basic Pay, Dearness Allowance, Cafeteria of Allowances, House Rent Allowance, Consolidated Travelling Allowance, Provident Fund (employer's share) etc.
  • Other entitlements like mobile phone, laptop, sodexo etc. are as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Pay protection will be given to candidates working in IDA E1 grade as Project Engineer or equivalent in the relevant field.
  • PF, Income Tax and any other incidental recovery will be deducted from Gross Salary as per extant rules.
  • Medical facility as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Leave: 8 days Casual Leave per annum, 2 days Restricted Holidays per annum, 10 days sick leave for six months (like Half pay leave with provision for commutation), and 12 days special leave per annum.

Age Limit

  • The upper age should not exceed 30 years as on the date of issue of Vacancy Notification (05.01.2026).

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Issue of Vacancy Notification 05/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application by Mail 04/02/2026
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 05/01/2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidates will only be called for document verification and interaction.
  • In case of more number of eligible applications received, candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interaction based on their engineering marks and experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee, and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the candidate.
  • The candidate must qualify with minimum 60% marks in the personal interview.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • A panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC, and such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel.
  • The period of contract will be initially for a period of two years, extendable on yearly basis on satisfactory performance and mutual consent, and can be renewed as a fresh contract on year-to-year basis if required.
  • The posts notified are not regular establishment posts and the candidates shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational qualification along with mark sheets of all semesters of Degree and experience on the date of document verification and interaction; formula of aggregate percentage calculation of Degree (CGPA/SGPA etc.) to be attached with application.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/restrict/curtail/enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons.
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • Selected candidate will have to pass prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into, for fitness to perform the work awarded.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC; any deviation will be dealt with on case-to-case basis, based on the merits of the case.
  • The selected candidates will have to serve the Corporation for at least two years for which he/she should execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1 Lakh in favour of Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. on Rs.500/- stamp paper to serve the Company for two years.
  • The candidate should have sound health and before joining will have to undergo medical examination and produce the certificate of fitness for job issued by a doctor (at least MBBS).
  • The contract can be terminated on completion of last day of contract period or any extended period, on breach of any terms of contract, or on the last day of one month notice period of termination issued by either side or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Upon premature termination or expiration of contract, the contract appointee shall return to MRVC any property belonging to MRVC, tools and plants, documents, passwords or user IDs etc., and clear all advances or dues.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC, and misuse may result in termination of employment and legal action.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].
  • Last date for submission of application by mail is 04.02.2026.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 05.01.2026.
  • Applications should be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I).
  • Applications not conforming to the prescribed format or having illegible/ambiguous certificates or without certificates or incomplete will be summarily rejected.
  • Candidates employed with Government Departments/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC at the time of document verification, failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification.
  • Mandatory documents to be attached with the filled application include: self-attested copies of certificate in proof of qualification (as per the qualification specified in Notification), self-attested copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), self-attested copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card), self-attested copy of document regarding experience, last served and others, and character certificate from Gazetted Officer/Executive Officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character (not older than six months).
  • Recommended documents include: self-attested copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, self-attested copy of Form 16 issued by previous/present employer, and self-attested document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF) Number/PF Number.

  • The Select List and Wait List shall be valid for a period of two years from the date of its publication and shall stand lapsed thereafter, unless the period of validity is extended by the Honourable the Chief Justice.
  • If a candidate on the Select/wait List fails to join the duty within the period stated in the appointment order, his/her name will be struck off/removed from the Select/wait List without informing the candidate.

The suppression of any material fact will be treated in same manner.
  • No complaint/grievance of any candidate shall be entertained or heard by the High Court in case of failure on his/her part to view/ download/print the Hall Ticket/Admit Card within the stipulated time. A link to view/download/print the Hall Ticket /Admit Card will be provided on the official website of the Bombay High Court
  • No complaint/grievance shall be entertained or heard by the High Court, in case of absence of candidates for the tests or Viva-voce, etc. on scheduled date and time on account of belated receipt of intimation regarding any change so notified or on any other count.
  • The candidates will have to appear for the said Tests and Viva-voce, on scheduled dates, at their own expenses. They shall keep with them printout of Hall Ticket/ Admit Card along-with original photo proof like Adhaar Card/PAN/Election Identity Card/Driving Licence/ Passport etc
  • Merely satisfying eligibility criteria or acceptance of online application for the said post, does not entitle the candidate to be called for the tests/Viva-voce or for appointment.
  • The Bombay High Court reserves the right to make changes in type of examination, number of vacancies, mode of selection process, to postpone the examination, to cancel the examination for any kind of reason

    • Syllabus: Questions pertaining to respective discipline (subject knowledge)

  • Stage-2: Personal Interview
    • Total Marks: 100
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD)
    • Shortlisting: 5 times the number of vacancies
  • Final Selection: Based on overall performance in Online Test and Personal Interview (Weightage 50:50)

For Category-II Stipendiary Trainee (ST/TN) - Operator & Maintainer

  • Stage-1: Preliminary Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 1 hour

  • Stage-2: Advanced Test (Online - CBT)

    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs related to academic/professional/technical qualification
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 30% (UR), 20% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-3: Document Verification/Physical Standard Examination
    • Shortlisting: 3 times the number of vacancies based on Stage-2 marks
  • Both Stage-1 and Stage-2 will be conducted on the same day without any break

    • Duration: 1 hour
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs (General Knowledge: 25, Computer Knowledge: 15, English: 10)
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 40% (UR), 30% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-2: Advanced Test (Online - CBT)
    • Duration: 2 hours
    • Total Questions: 50 MCQs (Quantitative Aptitude: 25, Critical Reasoning: 25)
    • Maximum Marks: 150 (3 marks for correct, 1 negative marking)
    • Qualifying Marks: 30% (UR), 20% (Reserved categories)
  • Stage-3: Document Verification
    • Shortlisting: 3 times the number of vacancies based on Stage-2 marks
  • On selection, candidates will be placed on probation for 1 year
  • Typing Test @ 30 words per minute required after first 6 months
  • 15 days Computer Proficiency Training during probation

General Instructions

  • Online Test will be trilingual (Marathi, Hindi & English) for all posts
  • Candidate must qualify at each stage for final empanelment
  • Tests may be conducted in single/multiple sessions depending on logistics

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals aged 18 years and above are eligible (21 years for Assistant Grade-1 posts)
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before applying
  • Candidature may be cancelled at any stage if found ineligible
  • For multiple posts, separate applications with separate fees required
  • Only latest application will be considered in case of multiple applications for same post
  • Cut-off date for age, qualification and experience is 04/02/2026
  • Only post-qualification experience will be considered; internship period not counted

  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer not entitled for any relaxation

  • The engagement on Fixed Term Contractual Engagement (FTCE) basis shall be for a period of 03 (three) years, which can be extended further, subject to the requirement of the corporation, on the basis of satisfactory performance.
  • The selected candidates shall be engaged on contractual basis, and shall have no claim of regularization in the future.
  • TA/DA would be admissible, if deputed on outstation duty, for which he/she shall be paid TA/DA as per the entitlement applicable for corresponding level of employees.
  • The contract engagee shall be entitled for 08 days Casual Leaves (CL) on pro-rata basis and 18 Earned Leave (EL) (i.e. 1.5 EL for each completed month of service).
  • On expiry of the term mentioned in the engagement order, the engagement shall stand terminated automatically. The engagement can be prematurely terminated by either side by giving one-month notice period, or, remuneration, in lieu thereof.
  • The candidate shall have no claim, whatsoever, for continued engagement, or, for any regular employment in the company, under any circumstances.
  • Fixed term engagement shall be made strictly on the basis of the prescribed norms. In case any particulars/information furnished by the candidate is found to be false, or, incorrect, the fixed term engagement shall be deemed to be void ab-initio and the engagement shall be terminated forthwith.
  • The Consolidated remuneration shall remain fixed throughout the period of Fixed Term Appointment and there shall be no increase in the remuneration on completion of the fixed term period. The remuneration shall be proportionately reduced in case of absence from work.
  • The selection of the candidate shall not confer any right to engagement unless the Corporation is satisfied after such an inquiry, as may be considered necessary, that the candidate having regard to his/her character and antecedents is suitable in all respect for contractual engagement.
  • The candidate selected for the post will have to execute a Surety Bond of Rs.1,00,000/-and cost of Training and shall have to serve the Corporation for a minimum period of two years (exclusive of the period in which one remains on Leave without Pay). One-month prior notice shall be required before seeking resignation from the corporation.
  • All related information shall be available only on the Website: http://www.delhimetrorail.com and candidates must regularly check the website for the updates.
  • Last date of receipt of duly filled in application (along with relevant documents) through Speed Post OR email shall be 27/01/2026. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date shall be summarily rejected. DMRC shall not be responsible for loss/delay in post.
  • While applying for the post, the applicant should ensure that he/she fulfills the eligibility and other norms mentioned above on the specified dates and that the particulars furnished by him/her are correct in all respects. In case, it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms/criteria and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact (s), his/her candidature will stand cancelled. If any of these shortcomings is/are detected even after engagement, his/her services are liable to be terminated.
  • The validity of the panel shall be two years from the date of its approval.
  • The selection of candidate by DMRC does not confer any right to the candidate for engagement.

Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Scientific Officers Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official BARC website. The last date to submit the application form is 21-01-2026. In this article, you’ll find the BARC Scientific Officers Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

The Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) is inviting applications for the Scientific Officer positions through the OCES/DGFS 2026 recruitment. This prestigious program offers engineering graduates and science postgraduates the chance to join the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) through two distinct training schemes: the one-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates (OCES-2026) and the two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates (DGFS-2026). Successful candidates will undergo intensive training, with a stipend of ₹74,000 per month during the training period. Upon appointment, they will be placed in Group-A posts with an attractive pay scale under the 7th CPC, totaling approximately ₹1,35,000 per month, along with various allowances.

This recruitment offers a unique opportunity to contribute to India's nuclear and atomic energy programs in various DAE units, such as BARC, IGCAR, and NPCIL. Candidates must meet specific educational qualifications, including a minimum of 60% marks in engineering or science degrees, and fulfill the age criteria (18 to 31 years). The selection process includes an online examination, GATE score-based shortlisting, and a final interview. Interested candidates can apply online from 22 December 2025 to 21 January 2026. This is an excellent opportunity for aspiring scientists to be part of a prestigious and impactful sector.

BARC OCES/DGFS Scientific Officers Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

Post Name Training Scheme / Discipline Vacancy / Intake Detail
Scientific Officer (through Training School) OCES-2026: One-year Orientation Course for Engineering Graduates and Science Postgraduates Number of posts not specified; selection through OCES-2026 programme for eligible disciplines.
Scientific Officer (through DGFS) DGFS-2026: Two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for Engineering Graduates Number of fellows not specified; DGFS fellowship awarded as per needs of DAE programmes to best performing candidates in OCES selection interview.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifying degrees and academic requirements for OCES/DGFS-2026 include B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc.(Engineering)/5-year Integrated M.Tech. in eligible engineering disciplines such as Civil, Chemical, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Metallurgical Engineering with a minimum of 60% aggregate marks, as detailed in the notification.
  • Eligible science disciplines include M.Sc./Integrated M.Sc. in Physics, Chemistry, Biosciences, Geology and Geophysics with specified subject combinations at B.Sc. level and minimum 60% aggregate marks in qualifying degrees, as per the detailed discipline-wise criteria.
  • For screening based on GATE Score, candidates must have valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in the relevant GATE subjects/papers corresponding to their discipline as mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Only regular educational degrees obtained through full-time/on-campus mode are considered; degrees obtained through correspondence, distance education/learning, by research or part-time modes are not eligible.
  • Applicants must satisfy discipline-specific inclusion and exclusion of degree titles as listed, including ineligible specializations for each engineering and science discipline.
  • Candidates graduating in the academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results may apply, subject to completion of all academic requirements for the qualifying degree before 31 July 2026 and submission of final marksheet by 31 December 2026 (for OCES) or as per DGFS institute requirement.
  • Applicants must be citizens of India and, for those working in Central/State Government units/PSUs/Aided Institutes, a No Objection Certificate from their organization must be produced at the time of selection interview.

Salary/Stipend

  • During training, OCES Trainee Scientific Officers and DGFS fellows are paid a stipend of ₹ 74,000/- per month.
  • OCES Trainee Scientific Officers receive a one-time book allowance of ₹ 30,000/- during the training period.
  • DGFS fellows are reimbursed tuition fee for the M.Tech. programme and receive a one-time contingency grant of ₹ 60,000/- per annum for two years, along with funding up to ₹ 4,00,000 under the BRNS fast track project scheme for project-related equipment/consumables.
  • On appointment, Scientific Officers are placed in Group-A post of Government of India in Level 10 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix with basic pay of ₹ 56,100/-; total monthly emoluments including dearness allowance, house rent allowance and transport allowance are approximately ₹ 1,35,000/- for those posted in Mumbai.
  • Additional allowances include leave travel concession by air (as per conditions), children’s education allowance, annual professional update allowance and Performance Related Incentive Scheme (PRIS) as per government norms, along with a comprehensive Contributory Health Service Scheme for employees and dependent family members.

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2026)

  • Minimum Age Limit: 18 years (Age as on August 1, 2026).
  • Maximum Age Limit for General Category: 26 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 29 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for SC/ST: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Dependents of those who died in the riots of 1984: 31 years.
  • Maximum Age Limit for Persons domiciled in Kashmir Division of Jammu and Kashmir State from 01/01/1980 to 31/12/1989: 31 years.
  • Persons with physical disability with extent of disability 40% or more will be considered for age relaxation and may be permitted a scribe as per rules.

Application Fee

  • A non-refundable Application Fee of ₹ 500/- is chargeable from male applicants belonging to General and OBC categories.
  • Women candidates, transgender candidates, candidates belonging to SC/ST category, Dependents of Defence Personnel Killed in Action (DODPKIA) and physically challenged candidates are exempted from payment of Application Fee.
  • Candidates who have availed fee exemption are required to bring valid relevant proof for verification at the exam centre.

Important Dates

Event Date / Period
Launching of online application portal for OCES/DGFS-2026 22nd December 2025 (tentative)
Last date for online application OCES/DGFS-2026 21st January 2026
Correction window for online application OCES/DGFS-2026 7th February – 14th February 2026
Allocation of online exam venue and generation of hall ticket/admit card 15th February – 20th February 2026
Online Exam for OCES/DGFS-2026 14th and 15th March 2026
Candidates to upload their GATE-2026 score 26th March – 2nd April 2026
Display of list of candidates shortlisted for selection interview on online application portal 2nd week of April 2026
Option to select interview slot for screened-in candidates on online application portal 20th April – 26th April 2026
Selection Interviews 12th May – 12th June 2026
Display of list of candidates finally selected for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme on online application portal Last week of June 2026
Providing details of M.Tech. admission in DGFS institute by selected candidates desirous of DGFS-2026 1st week of July 2026
Declaration of list of applicants selected for DGFS-2026 programme on online application portal 2nd week of July 2026
Pre-employment Medical Test for selected candidates of OCES/DGFS-2026 programme 1st July 2026 and 23rd July – 30th July 2026
Commencement of OCES-2026 programme 31st July 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection to OCES/DGFS-2026 is a two-step process consisting of screening of candidates followed by a Selection Interview.
  • Screening for Selection Interview is conducted through two alternative channels: an online screening examination and GATE-score-based shortlisting.
  • The online screening examination is conducted in eight engineering OCES disciplines (codes 21-28) and five science OCES disciplines (codes 41-43, 45 and 46) at more than fifty cities across India.
  • Candidates meeting eligibility criteria with valid GATE-2024, GATE-2025 or GATE-2026 scores in prescribed papers may be screened in for Selection Interview on the basis of GATE scores.
  • Cut-off GATE scores for Screening Interview are decided after conclusion of the online exam, and candidates are advised to maximize their chances by availing both screening avenues.
  • Selection Interviews for shortlisted candidates in all disciplines except Geology and Geophysics are conducted at BARC Training School, Mumbai; interviews in Geology and Geophysics disciplines are held in Hyderabad.
  • Outstation applicants travelling for Selection Interview are eligible for reimbursement of to-and-fro AC-III tier normal train fare by shortest route or actual fare, whichever is less, upon submission of original tickets.
  • Final selection is solely on the basis of performance in Selection Interview, subject to medical fitness as determined by DAE doctors.

General Information/Instructions

  • OCES-2026 is a one-year Orientation Course conducted at BARC Training Schools at BARC, Mumbai and AMD, Hyderabad for engineering graduates and science postgraduates, leading to appointment as Scientific Officers in DAE units or Atomic Energy Regulatory Board upon successful completion.
  • DGFS-2026 is a two-year DAE Graduate Fellowship Scheme for engineering graduates who secure M.Tech. admission in designated DGFS institutes and specializations, and who perform well in OCES Selection Interviews.
  • On successful completion of OCES/DGFS training, Trainee Scientific Officers are posted as Scientific Officers in various DAE units such as BARC, IGCAR, RRCAT, VECC, HWB, NFC, BRIT, NPCIL, BHAVINI, AMD, UCIL, DCSEM and AERB, based on programme needs and trainee performance.
  • Selected candidates must execute an agreement and personal indemnity bond to serve DAE for at least three years after completion of training; the bond covers stipend, book allowance, tuition fee and contingency grants as applicable.
  • DAE strives to maintain gender balance and encourages women candidates to apply for OCES/DGFS-2026 programmes.
  • Only online applications are accepted, and applicants are advised to regularly visit the online application portal for important updates and information.
  • Records of applicants for BARC Training Schools OCES/DGFS-2026 programme will not be preserved beyond four months from the date of publication of the final selection result.
  • In all matters concerning OCES/DGFS-2026 recruitment, decisions of the competent authority in BARC, Mumbai are final and binding; disputes are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Mumbai, India.

How to Apply

  • Only online applications will be accepted for OCES/DGFS-2026 programme.
  • Candidates are required to visit the website https://www.barcocesexam.in during the period specified in the Important Dates table and submit the online application by following the instructions provided there.
  • Applicants should carefully read the Information Brochure and FAQs available on the online application portal before filling the online application form.
  • Candidates must enter accurate details regarding qualifying degree, discipline, GATE score (if applicable) and other required information as per the advertisement.
  • Candidates graduating in academic year 2025-26 and awaiting final results must ensure that all academic requirements for award of qualifying degree are completed before 31 July 2026 and provide necessary certificates at the time of joining.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Jr. Professional Intern (Hindi): Degree of a recognised University with Hindi and English as elective/compulsory subjects OR Degree of a recognised University in any subject with a diploma in translation (Hindi and English as subject) from any recognised University/Institute; knowledge of typing in Hindi.
  • Jr. Professional Intern (Marathi): Degree of a recognised University with Marathi and English as elective/compulsory subjects OR Degree of a recognised University in any subject with a diploma in translation (Marathi and English as subject) from any recognised University/Institute; knowledge of typing in Marathi.
  • Jr. Professional Intern (HR Associate): Degree of a recognised University and Master of Business Administration (HR); proficiency in computer working/applications (MS-Word, Excel, PowerPoint presentation) through a course of not less than 6 months; knowledge of typing in English/Hindi/Marathi.
  • Desirable Experience: Preference will be given to persons with experience in relevant field supported by field work, policy papers, appraisal and monitoring of projects and schemes.
  • Soft Skills: Eager to learn and work with various departments; excellent verbal and written communication skills; proficiency in Microsoft Office; ability to multitask; ability to cope well under pressure; strong data modelling, research and analytical skills.

Salary/Stipend

  • Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 40,000/- per month for Jr. Professional Interns.
  • Annual increment of 5% on the last drawn remuneration based on satisfactory performance.
  • No entitlement to Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance, Transport Facility, Personal Staff, CGHS, Medical Reimbursement or other allowances.
  • No TA/DA for joining or completion of assignment; for official travel, compensation will be as per MbPA norms at the time of travel.
  • TDS as admissible shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration of Jr. Professional Interns.

Age Limit 

  • Candidate should be less than 35 years of age as on the date of advertisement.
  • The crucial date for determining educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be 01.01.2026.
  • Candidate should be in good health.

Application Fee

  • Details of application fee are not mentioned in the advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement 31.12.2025
Crucial Date for Eligibility (qualification, experience, age etc.) 01.01.2026
Last Date for Receipt of Applications 30.01.2026

Selection Process

  • Applications received will be scrutinized and shortlisted based on qualification, experience and other details provided in the application form.
  • Mere fulfillment of qualification or shortlisting shall not confer any right to be engaged as Jr. Professional Intern.
  • Shortlisted candidates may be called for test/interview before selection.
  • Selected applicants must produce original mark sheets, character certificate and self-declaration certificate at the time of joining; failure to do so will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Engagement is subject to verification of antecedents by the Police; adverse report will lead to termination.
  • Engagement of selected candidates is subject to the service and contract rules of Mumbai Port Authority and medical fitness as per MbPA requirements.

General Information/Instructions

  • Engagement is purely on contract basis; no claim/request for permanent employment will be entertained.
  • The initial period of engagement is 2 years, extendable by an additional 2 years based on performance, with no further extension; performance review will be conducted every 6 months.
  • Jr. Professional Interns will be on full time basis and are not permitted to take up any other assignment during the engagement.
  • Experience certificate will be issued by the concerned Department/Division; interns not completing one year will not be issued experience certificate.
  • Working hours are normally 10.00 AM to 6.00 PM on working days; in case of exigencies, they may be required to work late or on holidays without extra compensation.
  • Jr. Professional Interns are eligible for 20 days Casual Leave in a calendar year on pro-rata basis; absence beyond 20 days in a year leads to deduction in remuneration.
  • Absence of more than 15 days beyond entitled leave may lead to termination; no carry forward or encashment of leave is allowed.
  • Accommodation in MbPA quarters may be provided subject to availability (Class III B quarters); rent payable at 10% of consolidated remuneration plus single licence fee, with electricity and water charges on actual consumption.
  • MbPA hospital/dispensary OPD and IPD facility with medicines is available to contractual personnel; no medical facilities for family/dependents and no outside referral.
  • Jr. Professional Interns may be required to have their own laptops; MbPA shall provide working space, internet facility and other necessities as deemed fit.
  • Interns will receive 1–2 weeks orientation training for acquiring job-related skills and must submit brief reports/papers at scheduled intervals.
  • Interns must conduct themselves in accordance with MbPA rules and demonstrate high moral character, integrity, secrecy of office and dedication to work.
  • They will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923 and must not disclose any information/data acquired during engagement to unauthorized persons.
  • Use of MbPA name, emblem or official seal or its abbreviation for business or otherwise is prohibited without prior written permission.
  • Engagement contract may be terminated by MbPA at any time by giving one month’s notice or proportionate remuneration in lieu; interns must also give one month’s notice to disengage.
  • MbPA may terminate engagement forthwith without notice in cases such as inability to perform assigned work, unsatisfactory quality, failure to achieve milestones, lack of honesty and integrity, adverse police report or incorrect/false credentials.
  • MbPA has the right to cancel the advertisement and not go for engagement at any stage and may accept or reject any or all applications without reasons.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in written examination/interview.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement and application can be instituted only in Mumbai; courts/tribunals/forums at Mumbai shall have sole jurisdiction.
  • Applications received in incomplete format, without relevant documents, or only as CV/Resume, or after due date will be rejected.
  • Jr. Professional Interns must hand over entire records of assignment to MbPA before contract expiry and before final payment.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may submit applications in the prescribed format (Application Form) available on www.mumbaiport.gov.in under “People & Career/Jobs” menu.
  • Download the application format (Annexure), fill it with required details and declaration.
  • Send the filled-in application form along with required documents for determining eligibility to the specified address on or before 30.01.2026.
  • Superscribe the envelope as “Application for engagement of Jr. Professional Intern (Hindi)/ Jr. Professional Intern (Marathi)/ Jr. Professional Intern (HR Associate) on contract basis” as applicable.
  • Merely submitting Resume/CVs or incomplete applications will lead to rejection.
  • Address for sending applications: The Manager (HR), Mumbai Port Authority, Port House, 2nd floor, Shoorji Vallabhdas Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai – 400001.
  • For queries, candidates may contact Shri B.B. Raturi, Sr. Asstt. Secretary, HR Division on Contact No. 022-66564057 or email [email protected].

Diploma in Marketing Management /Foreign Trade from a recognized University /Institute with minimum 60% marks. Or Engineering Graduate (Full Time) with PG Degree/Diploma in Marketing/Foreign Trade with minimum 60% marks.
Manager (Survey) Survey 1. Graduate from a recognized university/ Institute with minimum 60% marks. 2. Surveyor’s Certificate of competency (Unrestricted) Minimum 2 years’ post qualification experience in surveying underground mining out of which 2 years’ experience (1 year for internal candidate) in immediate lower scale (IDA) i.e. Rs. 40000-140000 or equivalent (CDA) For candidates from private sector, CTC should be minimum Rs. 9.70 lakh per annum.

Age Limit

  • The upper age limit as on 20/01/2026 is 30 years for Graduate Trainees / Management Trainees and 35 years for the post of Manager (Survey) for General(UR) & EWS candidates.
  • Upper Age Limit is relaxed by: 3 Years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), 5 years for SC/ST, Persons with disabilities candidates: By 10 years for General(UR), By 13 years for OBC(NCL), By 15 years for SC/ST.
  • Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen category candidates is Service rendered in the Armed forces plus 03 years.
  • The Upper age limit is relaxed subject to the condition that maximum age of the applicant on the crucial date i.e. 20/01/2026 shall not exceed 53 years.

Selection Process

  • Admission to Computer Based Online Test will be purely provisional. Candidature will be subject to verification of details/documents when the candidate reports for interview, if shortlisted or at any stage of the recruitment process/appointment.
  • The duration of Computer Based Online Test will be for 90 minutes (in one sitting) consisting of Objective Type question (MCQ) (85 marks) break-up of which is General Knowledge for 10 marks, Reasoning for 10 marks & General English for 10 marks which will be combined as segment - I and Subject Knowledge will be for 55 marks which will be segment - II.
  • Question paper will be available both in Hindi & English. However, in case of any error in Hindi version the English version of the question shall be valid & final.
  • Candidates are required to appear in the Computer Based Online Test at their own expenses and if shortlisted in the Computer Based Online Test as per the criteria, they will be called for Personal Interview as per their merit in the ratio of 1:6 (6 candidates against 1 vacancy in respective category) keeping in view the provision of reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD/EWS.
  • The personal interview will be of 15 marks. Final merit panel will be prepared based on the consolidated marks of Computer Based Online Test and Personal Interview.

Instructions

  • Detailed instructions available on MOIL website www.moil.nic.in may please be referred at the time of applying online application. Candidates, in their own interest are advised not to wait till the last date & time and register their application well within the time.
  • MOIL will not be held responsible, if the candidates are unable to submit their application due to last minute rush & system failure. Candidates should read the instructions in the advertisement carefully before making any entry of selecting options for filling online applications.

Application Fee

  • Candidates belonging to GENERAL (UR) / EWS/OBC (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) category are required to pay a non-refundable fee of Rs.590/- including GST (Five Hundred and Ninety only).
  • For SC/ST/PwBD/EXS/Employees of MOIL are exempted from the payment of application fee.
  • Application fee will be paid through Online mode only. There will be no other mode of payment of application fee.
  • MOIL will not be responsible, in case a candidate deposits the fee in any wrong account. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Candidates are therefore advised to verify their eligibility before applying.

Salary / Stipend

  • Pay Level: E-01 (during training) / E-02 (after training)
  • Basic Pay: Rs. 40,000/- (initial during training) / Rs. 50,000/- (initial after training)

How To Apply

  1. Visit the MOIL website www.moil.nic.in and click on the Recruitment section to find the Apply Online option. Prepare scanned copies of your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per specifications.
  2. Register by providing your name, contact details, and email ID to receive a Provisional Registration Number and Password. Use the Save and Next facility if you need to complete the form later.
  3. Fill in all personal, educational, and other details accurately in the application form. Verify all information before proceeding to upload documents.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration following the guidelines provided. Ensure all uploads meet the size and format requirements.
  5. Proceed to the payment section if applicable, and make the fee payment using Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or other modes. Wait for confirmation and generate the e-Receipt.
  6. Review the entire application in the Preview tab and make any necessary changes. Click on Final Submit only after ensuring all details are correct.
  7. Download and print the application form and e-Receipt for your records. Keep your registration details safe for future reference.
  8. Monitor your email and the MOIL website for updates on admit cards, test dates, and further instructions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Educational Qualification: Pursuing Engineering Degree (7th/8th semester) or M.Tech (1st/2nd year) or M.Sc (1st/2nd year) full-time course in the respective discipline from a recognised Indian University/Institute.
  • Academic Performance: Good academic track record with ≥60% marks or ≥6.5 CGPA on a scale of 10.
  • Course Category: Pursuing Under-Graduate Engineer / Post Graduate Engineer and Post Graduate Science students in specified disciplines/branch codes.
  • Age Limit: Below 28 years.

  • Brief Bio-data: Candidate must provide brief bio-data <300 words highlighting achievements.
  • Awards/Professional Memberships: Any awards or professional memberships, if any, should be mentioned in the application.

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly stipend of Rs. 5,000/- per month for all internship positions.
  • Stipend and retention of internship training for six months is applicable only if the student has good academic performance and completes a minimum of 15 working days per month of physical attendance at HEMRL.
  • Payment will be made in two installments; first installment is paid after completion of 03 months of training.
  • Stipend will be paid into the bank account of the student after completion of three months.
  • No payment will be made if a student does not complete a tenure of 03 months or leaves in between the program; Certificate of Completion will not be issued in such cases.

Age Limit 

  • Upper age limit: Below 28 years.

Important Dates

Event Date
Last date for Application 20-01-2026
Information to Selected Students 23rd Jan 2026 (tentative)
Date of Start for Internship Training 01st Feb 2026 (tentative)

Selection Process

  • Students must be pursuing 7th/8th semester undergraduate engineering or 1st/2nd year post graduate engineering/science with required academic performance.
  • Principal/Director of institution must send a request letter recommending highly deserving meritorious students for the internship.
  • Shortlisted students will only be notified about joining procedures and regarding undertaking forms and indemnity bond to be filled by them and by the head of the institution.
  • Selection is based entirely on merit basis; no communication will be undertaken for rejected candidates.
  • Incomplete or erroneous applications or those received after due date will be rejected with no further communication.
  • Management reserves the right to change vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during the selection process without assigning any reason.

General Information/Instructions

  • HEMRL is involved in basic and applied research in high energy materials, including formulation, design and development of propellants, high explosives, pyrotechnics, polymeric materials, liners, insulators and related materials.
  • Studies include physiochemical and combustion characteristics of materials, detonation phenomena and development of new systems.
  • The duration of internship/project work is 06 months; completion certificate will be issued after successfully completing 06 months from date of joining.
  • Boarding/lodging expenses are not admissible; selected candidates can obtain lunch, tea, snacks, etc., at subsidised rates in HEMRL canteen.
  • HEMRL/DRDO has no obligation to offer employment to interns/project students; interns cannot claim employment rights based on completion of internship.
  • If a student is unable to complete the internship and leaves mid-way, no certificate of completion will be issued and no stipend will be paid if minimum 03 months are not completed.
  • Students must clearly mention “Application for Paid Internship” and the respective “Branch Code No……” on top of the envelope for easy segregation of applications.
  • Website address: https://www.drdo.gov.in/

How to Apply

  • Applications must be submitted by Speed Post addressed to “The Director, HEMRL, Sutarwadi, Pune – 411021” with “Kind Attn.: To HRD Division”.
  • On top of the envelope, clearly mention “Application for Paid Internship” along with the appropriate “Branch Code No……”.
  • Application should be in the prescribed “Application for Paid Internship Scheme” format provided in the advertisement.
  • Application must include details like CGPA, discipline, branch code, degree, semester/year, achievements, languages known, and referral letter from Principal/Director.
  • Checklist in the application requires enclosing: reference letter issued by Principal/Director, UG/PG marksheet reflecting CGPA, and copy of latest Aadhar card.
  • Selected students at joining must submit NOC from college, police verification acknowledgement, undertakings (Official Secrets Act and IT rules), bank details, medical fitness certificate, original Aadhar & college ID, passport size photographs, and all previous semester mark sheets for verification.
  • Original documents will be returned immediately after verification; any additional required documents will be communicated at the time of selection/joining.

  • The engagement of project staff may be terminated at any time without assigning any reasons, by giving a one-month notice.   • The project staff shall have to make their own arrangement for accommodation during their tenure in the project. However, HRA shall be admissible as per applicable rules.
  • The offer letter shall be issued to the candidate initially for a period for which funds are available.
  • A review committee will assess the performance of the project staff and recommend for their extension, if required, subject to the availability of funds in the project.
  • CSIR guidelines for engagement of project personnel, as made applicable vide CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024/ 18.10.2024 and amended from time to time shall apply.
  • No TA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the interview in case of offline interviews.
  • Other terms & conditions will be governed as per guidelines issued by the funding agency/ CSIR-NEERI for the engagement of the Project Staff as amended from time to time.

How to Apply

  • The candidates shall bring a passport-size photo, Aadhaar card, 10th (SSC), 12th (HSC), Graduate marksheets. Degree, Graduate mark sheets (one set photocopy and original) along with filled application form attached with this advertisement.

Vacancy Details

Post Name Number of Positions
Consultant – Port Operations One
Consultant – Marine Operations & Regulatory One

Eligibility Criteria

Qualification

  • Graduate degree in Engineering / Nautical Sciences / Maritime Studies or equivalent.

Essential Qualification

  • Extensive hands-on experience in port operations at an Indian Major Port
  • Preferably served as Traffic Manager / Deputy Traffic Manager or in equivalent senior operational roles.
  • Strong understanding of port operational regulations, procedures, and statutory requirements.
  • Good exposure to IT systems used in ports (POS/TOS/PCS, planning tools, MIS systems, automation solutions).
  • Ability to work with technical teams and articulate operational needs clearly.
  • Should have work experience in marine operations at an Indian Major Port.
  • Preferably served in senior roles within Marine Division (e.g., Deputy Conservator / Marine Superintendent / Marine Manager) and have:
  • Strong understanding of maritime laws, port marine regulations, safety and environmental compliance.
  • Good exposure to marine IT systems (VTS, AIS, e-Navigation, safety and compliance systems).
  • Ability to bridge regulatory, operational, and technology perspectives.

Desirable Qualification

  • Preferred is Master Mariner or Marine Engineering background or equivalent maritime qualification.

Experience

  • 10+ years, preferably in Major Ports of India

Salary/ Stipend

  • Retired employees will be paid fixed remuneration @ (Last Basic Pay drawn – Basic Pension) as per extant rules.
  • For other candidates, monthly remuneration shall be fixed appropriately within the range of Rs. 2,00,000 to Rs. 3,50,000/- (all inclusive) by the Consultancy Selection Committee based on the evaluation and performance in the interview.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2026)

  • The maximum age for applying against both these requirements shall not exceed 63 years as on 01.01.2026.

Important Dates

Notification Date 07 January 2026
Last Date 30 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Only those Applicants who qualify the Pre-Qualification/Minimum Eligibility Criteria shall be considered for evaluation process. Any application found to be non-compliant to the requirements, shall be rejected and shall not be considered for further evaluation.
  • Applicants are required to submit all the supporting documents (self attested) to prove their qualification, experience, age etc along with the duly filled and signed application. However, C-DAC reserves the right to summarily reject any application which does not contain all the mandatory supporting documents or may ask the applicant to resubmit documents, if found necessary. The decision of C-DAC shall be final and binding in this regard.
  • C-DAC reserves the right to adopt the criteria for evaluation process and disqualify any applicant based on criteria fixed, and its decision shall be final.
  • Only those applicants who qualify the evaluation process shall be called for interview (offline/online).

General Information / Instructions

  • Working hours shall be same as that of C-DAC office i.e. from 9-00 AM to 5-30pm and it may be extended considering the work exigencies.
  • Attendance will be recorded on a monthly basis and there will be proportionate deduction in remuneration w.r.t. attendance of that particular month.
  • TDS and other taxes shall be deducted as applicable from time to time.
  • Travel entitlements on official tour and leave shall be as per the prevailing rules of C-DAC.
  • During the period of Consultancy with C-DAC, the selected Consultant will not be permitted to take up any other assignments.
  • The selected Consultant shall observe the rules and regulations of C-DAC that exists and that may be changed from time to time, unless specifically exempted from any such rule by the Competent Authority.
  • The tenure of the selected Consultants shall be initially for a period of one year from the date of engagement. Further extension if any, will be at the discretion of the Competent Authority subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate and functional need. However, the maximum age up to which a retired employee can be engaged will be 65 years.
  • The engagement shall be of a temporary nature against specific project requirement and can be cancelled at any time by C-DAC without assigning any reasons.
  • The initial place of posting shall be at Mumbai.

How to Apply

  • Prospective candidates are required to submit their application along with necessary documentary proofs in support of their eligibility criteria.
  • The format for submitting application is provided as Annexure 1. Duly filled and signed application form along with self attested copies to prove educational qualifications, experience, age, etc shall be sent to the email [email protected] on or before 30.01.2026.
  • Applications received after 30.01.2026 will not be considered for evaluation process.
  • While sending the application, please mark the respective subject line as "Application for Consultant at C-DAC, Mumbai”.

Selection Process

  • Only candidates who produce all necessary original documents and are found eligible during document verification will be allowed to attend the further selection process (Written Test & Physical Test).
