  • Selection is in three stages for Regular Coaches and Coach - Para, with a total score of 100 (converted from specified components).
Selection Process – Regular Coaches
Level Component Score
Level I Total marks scored in Professional Qualification (as per formula) 25
Medals received in the sporting discipline applied for 15
Coaching Experience (as per structured table) 10
Total Level I 50
Level II Tamil Test (qualifying cum scoring – minimum 40% to qualify) 10
Sports General Awareness (MCQ) 25
Total Level II 35
Level III Discipline-specific Performance Evaluation (including viva voce) 15
Total 100

 

Selection Process – Differently Abled Coaches (Coach - Para)
Level Component Score
Level I Medals received in the sporting discipline applied for 30
Coaching Experience 20
Total Level I 50
Level II Tamil Test (qualifying cum scoring – minimum 40% to qualify) 10
Sports General Awareness (MCQ) 25
Total Level II 35
Level III Discipline-specific Performance Evaluation (including viva voce) 15
Total 100
  • Level II Tamil Language Test is of qualifying cum scoring nature; candidates must secure at least 40% marks to qualify.
  • Level II Sports General Awareness test comprises MCQs on current affairs in sports, welfare schemes, PoSH Act in sports context, anti-doping, Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act (sports context), sports medicine/physiology/first aid (as in NIS Diploma syllabus) and related topics.
  • Level III performance evaluation includes on-field assessment (talent identification and development, coaching skills, tactics and strategy, techniques, psychological training, error correction, biomechanics) and viva voce on training programme formulation, goal setting, nutrition, performance monitoring, rules knowledge and sports science.
  • For computation of NIS marks in Level I, a specified formula using the candidate’s marks, maximum marks and assigned weightage is given in the notification.
  • Medal scoring uses a detailed table with different scores for medals in Olympics/Paralympics, World Championships, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, South Asian Games, National Games, National Championships, All India Inter University, Khelo India, SGFI, and State Games conducted by SDAT/Government or recognized associations.
  • Coaching experience scoring is based on experience (as on 01.01.2026) in Sports Departments/Authorities (State/Union Govt/Sports Universities), accredited sports academies/training centres/government recognized commercial sports arms, and sports departments of other universities/colleges/schools.
  • Merit list is prepared based on total score and reservation policy; tie-breaking is done by Level III score, then Level I score, then date of birth (older candidate preferred).

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited through online mode only from eligible candidates who wish to join SDAT as Coach by direct recruitment; candidates registered with Employment Exchange are also eligible to apply online.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply, and candidates must carefully read the notification and ensure they satisfy all eligibility conditions before applying.
  • Selected candidates will undergo a two-year probationary period as per applicable rules.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of character and antecedents, marital status conditions, age compliance and production of physical fitness certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner not below the rank of Assistant Civil Surgeon.
  • If no qualified suitable women applicants are available for reserved women vacancies, they will be filled by male applicants of the respective communal categories.
  • For vacancies reserved for Arunthathiyars on preferential basis, unfilled posts may be filled by other Scheduled Castes as per prevailing reservation rules.
  • Candidates must furnish correct information regarding arrests, convictions, debarment/disqualification, criminal or disciplinary proceedings, participation in agitations or political organizations, or candidature in elections, if any.
  • Applications with wrong claims relating to basic qualification, eligibility, age or educational qualification will be liable for rejection.
  • SDAT’s decision regarding eligibility, documents, mode of selection, schedule and all recruitment matters is final; announcements/details will be published only on https://www.sdat.tn.gov.in/.
  • Only the latest valid application will be retained if multiple applications are submitted; any attempt to exert undue influence results in disqualification.
  • Candidates must upload a recent recognizable photograph and ensure identical signatures in all documents; they must appear for performance tests at their own expense and final appointment is subject to medical fitness and other requirements.
  • Information/Intimations will be sent by email to the primary email ID provided; candidates must keep email and mobile valid and monitor the SDAT website for updates.
  • Selection is provisional and subject to final orders in any Writ Petitions pending before competent Courts related to this recruitment.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply only through online mode via the SDAT website: https://www.sdat.tn.gov.in/ within 05.01.2026 to 25.01.2026 till 5.00 PM.
  • Candidates must register and fill the online application with accurate personal details, educational qualifications, professional qualifications, sports achievements and coaching experience as required.
  • Candidates must upload a recent passport size photograph and necessary scanned documents as per instructions in the online portal.
  • Copies of documents to be kept ready for upload/verification include: 10th mark sheet, 12th mark sheet, community certificate, special category certificate (if applicable), UG/PG degree certificate, NIS Diploma certificate, experience certificates/pay slips/IT returns and medal certificates.
  • All original documents must be produced for verification as per schedule intimated by SDAT after online application and during subsequent stages.

  • Ex-Servicemen: Age relaxation up to the extent of service rendered in Defence forces (Army, Navy & Airforce) plus 3 years, subject to production of required certificate.
  • Departmental candidates with three years continuous service in Central Government: 5 years age relaxation (additional to other applicable cases) for eligible Central Government / Autonomous / PSU / Centrally Funded Research Institute employees.
  • Regular staff of NIT Tiruchirappalli appointed before 2012 are allowed to participate in the selection process irrespective of age and percentage of marks, as per No.F.35-5/2018-TS.III dated 20th February 2019 – point 4.b.(iii).

Application Fee

  • UR, EWS, OBC (Non-creamy layer) & Ex-servicemen: Rs. 1,000/- (non-refundable); however, Rs. 500/- shall be refunded to Ex-servicemen candidates subject to appearing for the Screening Test.
  • SC/ST/Women applicants: Rs. 500/- towards online application.
  • PwBD candidates: Exempted from Application & Processing Fee.
  • The application fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances (except the specified refund condition for Ex-servicemen).

Important Dates

Details Date
Date of advertisement 02.01.2026
Opening date for online application 02.01.2026
Closing date for submission of online application 30.01.2026
Closing date for submission of hardcopy of the applications 06.02.2026

Selection Process

  • Screening of online applications may be done to restrict the number of applicants to be called for the selection process.
  • The Institute may conduct a selection process comprising multiple stages of selection.
  • Selection process may consist of Screening Test (only for the purpose of shortlisting of applicants), Skill Test (qualifying in nature) and Main Written Test.
  • List of shortlisted applicants to be called for the selection process will be published on the Institute website and may also be intimated on registered email ID; no hard copy communication will be issued.
  • Screening of applications will be done on the basis of requirements mentioned in the Recruitment Rules and as per conditions laid down by the duly constituted Screening Committee.
  • Canvassing in any manner would entail disqualification of the candidature.
  • Request for change in examination centres will not be entertained at any stage of the recruitment process.

General Information / Instructions

  • Applicants must satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility for the post applied for and must be fulfilling the eligibility criteria as on the closing date of online applications; failing this, their application is liable for rejection at any stage.
  • Applicants would be allowed to appear in the selection process based on information furnished in the application form; if found ineligible at any stage, candidature may be cancelled and, if selected, appointment may be cancelled.
  • Hiding information or submitting false information may lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage and removal from service with possible penal action.
  • The Institute will retain data of online applications received for non-shortlisted applicants only for three months after completion of recruitment process.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online mode only; applications in any other form will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • Incomplete applications or applications without relevant supporting enclosures may be rejected without correspondence.
  • NIT Tiruchirappalli strives to have a workforce reflecting gender balance and eligible female applicants are especially encouraged to apply.
  • The Institute has the right to set higher norms than minimum prescribed in the advertisement and its decisions on recruitment shall be final and binding.
  • Institute reserves the right to reject or accept candidature at any stage and to cancel/restrict/modify/alter the advertisement or recruitment process without notice.
  • The Screening Test / Skill Test / Main Written Test will be conducted in the premises of NIT Tiruchirappalli only; no request for change of venue/date will be considered.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee being called for Screening Test / Main Written Test / Skill Test.
  • Persons serving in Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Bodies / PSUs / PSBs must furnish a No Objection Certificate at the time of verification.
  • No vigilance/disciplinary cases should be pending against applicants working in any Government / Semi-Government / Autonomous Organizations.
  • Original documents with one set of self-attested copies must be produced at the time of certificate verification prior to skill test; without originals, candidature shall be rejected.
  • Applicants are advised to visit the Institute website http://www.nitt.edu regularly for addendum/corrigendum and lists of shortlisted applicants; no separate communication will be issued.
  • The Institute reserves the right not to fill the posts and to cancel the advertisement in whole or in part.
  • Applicants should not have been convicted by any Court of Law.
  • Applicants must be in sound health and, if selected, be prepared to undergo medical examination and produce fitness certificate from the District Medical Board.
  • All appointments are subject to verification of academic qualifications, experience, conduct, community certificates, medical fitness and police verification.
  • Photograph must be recent (not earlier than three months from the date of application) colour passport size with clear front view without cap, scarf or sunglasses; identical extra photograph should be kept for verification.
  • Applicants must carry an original photo identity proof (Driving Licence, Voter ID Card, Aadhaar Card or Passport) to the examination centre.
  • No educational qualification shall be considered unless supported by Degree/Provisional Degree Certificate along with mark sheets; grade card/mark sheet alone will not be treated as proof of degree.
  • Selected candidates will be covered under the New Pension System as notified by Government of India, Ministry of Finance vide notification No.5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22nd December 2003.
  • No TA/DA shall be paid to candidates attending Screening test / Certificate Verification / Skill Test / Main Written Test, except PwD candidates who may avail reimbursement as per norms.
  • All correspondence will be made through e-mail only; schedule and details of selection process will be published on the Institute website.
  • Any dispute with regard to the selection process will be subject to court/tribunal having jurisdiction over Tiruchirappalli.
  • No correspondence will be entertained from not-shortlisted candidates.
  • Applicants are warned not to furnish false particulars or suppress material information, or tamper with documents; such actions may lead to cancellation/debarment and other actions listed in the notification.

How to Apply

  • Applicants are required to apply online through SAMARTH portal (https://nittnt.samarth.edu.in/index.php/site/login) of the Institute website www.nitt.edu from 02.01.2026 to 30.01.2026.
  • Applicants should click on the online application link, read the instructions carefully and fill in the online application form with accurate information.
  • If the online application is not successfully completed, the applicant is required to register again.
  • After successful submission of online application, applicants must keep a copy of the finally submitted online application for production during the selection process.
  • Incomplete applications or applications received through any mode other than online will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • No request for change in any data entered will be entertained once the online application is submitted successfully.
  • Applicants need to upload scanned copy of recent passport size colour photograph and signature while applying online.
  • Applicants called for selection process must produce original certificates, a copy of the same photo and other relevant documents as mentioned in the online application form.
  • The Institute will not be responsible if an applicant is unable to submit the online application within the last date due to system error or other reasons.
  • Application without payment of application fee will be incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Applicants must upload the following documents: SSLC Certificate; HSC Certificate; ITI / Diploma / UG / PG Degree Certificate (whichever is applicable); Certificate for typewriting / Shorthand / Computer skill from specified Government institutes for certain posts as per RR; Community Certificate (if applicable); recent passport size colour photograph; scanned copy of signature.

Eligibility Criteria

Accounts Officer Class III (Post Code 2093):

  • Qualifications: Must have passed the Final Examination conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants / Cost Accountants

Assistant Director of Agriculture (Extension) (Post Code 3202):

  • Qualifications: A degree of M.Sc. in Agricultural Extension or Agricultural Economics
  • Desirable: Preference shall be given to those who possess the M.Sc. degree in Agricultural Extension

Assistant Manager (Accounts) (Post Code 3335):

  • Qualifications: Should have qualified CA/ICWA course i.e. Must have passed the Final Examination conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India / Institute of Cost Accountants of India or its equivalent qualification

  • Qualifications: Must be either Chartered Accountant or Cost Accountant

  • Essential Qualifications: Must possess a degree in Law awarded by a recognized University (B.L.)
  • Experience: Must have sound knowledge of Corporate Laws, Labour Laws, and experience on the original side in City Civil Courts or Mofussil courts for a period not less than five (5) years and must have good knowledge and practice in Motor Accidents Claims/Tribunal, Labour Courts, etc.

  • Experience: Minimum of 15 years of experience in the field of Marketing preferably in Cement Industry with 5 years of service in middle managerial position

  • Age relaxable for Ex-Servicemen

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Notification 22/12/2025

Paper II Examination Date (Subject Papers) Will be informed through Commission's website
Age Limit Reckoning Date 01/07/2025

Selection Process

  • The Combined Technical Services Examination (Interview Posts) comprises of two stages: Written Examination and Interview
  • Candidates shall be admitted to the written examination based on the claims made in the online application
  • Onscreen certificate verification will be conducted before admission to the physical certificate verification and interview
  • Candidates will be admitted to onscreen certificate verification in the ratio of 1:3/1:4 (posts not requiring experience) and 1:10 (posts requiring experience)
  • After onscreen certificate verification, based on the marks obtained in the written examination and subject to the rule of reservation of appointments, candidates shall be admitted to physical certificate verification and interview
  • The objective of the Interview is to assess the suitability of the candidate for the post by judging the candidate's personality, bearing, aptitude, general knowledge, technical knowledge etc.
  • Marks obtained by the candidates in the Written Examination (Part B and Part C of Paper I and Paper II) and Interview would determine final ranking
  • Appearance in Paper I, Paper II and the Interview is compulsory

General Information/Instructions

  • The number of vacancies and distribution of vacancies are tentative and liable for modification before the publication of results
  • The Commission reserves the right to include additional posts with different nomenclature and having similar eligibility conditions
  • Candidates should possess adequate knowledge in Tamil on the date of notification
  • Candidates not belonging to SCs, SC(A)s, STs, MBCs/DCs, BC(OBCM)s, and BCMs, who have put in 5 years or more of service are not eligible to apply (except for posts requiring experience and Accounts Officer Class-III)
  • Persons with benchmark disabilities are not eligible for Deputy Manager (Mechanical), Deputy Manager (Electrical), and Deputy Manager (Materials) posts
  • Candidates selected for appointment will be required to submit a certificate of physical fitness to the Appointing Authority at the time of joining
  • The admission to all stages of examination will be purely provisional, subject to satisfying eligibility conditions
  • The Commission reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage after due process
  • All recruitments by TNPSC are purely merit-based
  • Candidates are solely responsible for their claims in the online application
  • Mobile phones, pagers, electronic equipment, programmable devices, or any banned items are not allowed in the examination hall

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Candidates are required to apply online using the Commission's website www.tnpscexams.in
  • Step 2: Register at the One Time Registration (OTR) platform by paying Rs. 150 as registration fee (valid for five years). If already registered, proceed to fill online application
  • Step 3: Fill in the online form with all relevant correct details. Choose the subject paper(s) in which you have obtained educational qualification
  • Step 4: Upload recent colour photograph (20KB-50KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) and signature (10KB-20KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) as per specifications
  • Step 5: Upload all required documents including educational certificates, community certificate (if applicable), experience certificates (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents
  • Step 6: Choose two district centres as preference for Written Examination (candidates with benchmark disability can choose only one)
  • Step 7: Pay examination fee of Rs. 200 through online mode (Net Banking/Credit card/Debit card/UPI) unless exemption is claimed
  • Step 8: Preview the application carefully and make necessary corrections if required
  • Step 9: Finally submit the application by clicking the 'SUBMIT' button
  • Step 10: Take printout of the application for future reference
  • Important: Candidates need not send the printout of online application or any supporting documents to the Commission by post unless specifically asked
  • Note: Linking the Aadhaar number with One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for candidates

  • Coimbatore (Code: 0201)
  • Tiruchirappalli (Code: 2501)

  • Tirunelveli (Code: 2601)

TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination Recruitment 2025 - FAQs

1. What is the last date to apply for TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination 2025?

Ans: Last date to apply is 20/01/2026 at 11:59 PM.

2. How many total vacancies are available in TNPSC CTS Examination 2025?

Ans: Total 76 vacancies are available across 14 different posts.

3. What is the application fee for TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination 2025?

Ans: The application fee is Rs. 200. Fee exemption is available for special categories including SC/ST/PwBD/Destitute Widow.

4. What is the age limit for TNPSC CTS Examination 2025?

Ans: Minimum age is 21 years. Maximum age varies from 32 to 34 years for general category candidates. No maximum age limit for SC/ST/MBC/BC candidates (should not exceed 60 years).

5. When will the written examination be conducted?

Ans: Paper I will be conducted on 07/03/2026 and 08/03/2026. Paper II dates will be informed through the Commission's website.

6. Is One Time Registration (OTR) mandatory for applying?

Ans: Yes, candidates need to register at OTR platform by paying Rs. 150 (valid for 5 years) before applying for the examination.

7. What is the qualification required for Assistant Director of Agriculture (Extension)?

Ans: M.Sc. in Agricultural Extension or Agricultural Economics. Preference will be given to those with M.Sc. in Agricultural Extension.

8. Is there any negative marking in the examination?

Ans: The notification does not mention negative marking. The examination is Computer Based Test (CBT) with objective type questions.

9. What is the selection process for TNPSC CTS Examination 2025?

Ans: Selection process consists of Written Examination (Paper I and Paper II), Onscreen Certificate Verification, Physical Certificate Verification, and Interview.

10. Can I apply for multiple posts in this recruitment?

Ans: Yes, candidates can apply for posts for which they meet the eligibility criteria. However, separate applications and fees are required for each post.

  • Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall not be treated or deemed to be an employee either in the Madras High Court Service or in the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy.
  • Any Research Fellow / Research Assistant intended to leave within one year shall give prior notice of three months.
  • No Research Fellow / Research Assistant shall practice as an Advocate in any Court during the assignment and must inform the Bar Council accordingly.
  • Shall not take up any employment or engagement on full-time or part-time basis during the assignment.
  • The decision of the High Court of Madras in respect of all matters pertaining to this Recruitment Process would be final and binding.
  • Candidates are required to keep visiting the websites of the Tamil Nadu State Judicial Academy[](https://www.Madras High Court.tn.nic.in) / Recruitment Portal of the Madras High Court[](https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in) for latest updates.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited through online mode only.
  • Applicants must visit https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/recruitment_rf/login and register as new applicants (previous registrations are invalid).
  • Enter details: E-mail ID, Mobile No., Name (as in SSLC or Gazette if changed), Create Password, Retype Password, Captcha Code.
  • After successful registration and OTP activation, login and fill the application in 5 steps: Personal Information (upload photo & signature), Educational Qualification details, Additional information (upload required certificates), Declaration, Confirm details & Submit.
  • Photograph: Recent passport size colour .jpg (20-50 KB, 230x200 pixels), white background, no selfie, no dark glasses/hats.
  • Signature: .jpg (<20 KB, 60x140 pixels).
  • Upload certificates (SSLC, HSC, Degrees/Marksheets, Enrolment, Experience, etc.) below 115 KB each.

As a leading organization in energy and mining sectors, NLCIL is seeking experienced professionals to manage airport operations, ensuring compliance with aviation standards and statutory requirements. This opportunity is for one unreserved vacancy, offering a consolidated monthly pay of Rs. 90,000/-, along with benefits like Provident Fund, Gratuity, medical facilities, leave entitlements, TA/DA for official tours, and accommodation or House Rent Allowance subject to availability.

The upper age limit is 62 years as on 01/12/2025, with the engagement period fixed at two years from the date of joining, and selection based on Personal Interview.

  • Selected Senior Resident candidates have to deposit security amount of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand)
  • In favour of ESI Fund A/C No. 1 payable at State Bank of India, Ashok Nagar, Chennai-78

  • If candidate resigns/services are terminated within one year, security deposit shall be forfeited

Contractual Agreement

  • Senior Resident so engaged will be required to enter into contractual agreement on stamp paper of Rs. 100/-
  • Contract is liable to be terminated at any time without assigning any reason after giving one month's notice on either side or on payment of one month's emoluments in lieu thereof

Medical Examination and Joining

  • Joining of candidate is subject to medical fitness
  • Senior Resident so selected will be required to submit acceptance/consent letter in writing before appearing for medical examination
  • Selected candidates will have to join duty on or before the date indicated in offer of appointment/engagement

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Required to attend emergency, floor duty and other clinical duty as assigned by Competent Authority
  • Required to perform duties in other departments as assigned by competent authority
  • Medical Officers required to mark attendance manually as well as on Aadhar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily

Attendance and Discipline

  • Absence from work for period of fifteen days without proper permission will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and automatic termination alongwith forfeiture of Security Deposit
  • Doctors at any time found guilty of any gross misconduct or negligence of duties shall be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu of notice period

Reservation Policy

  • Reservation of posts is applicable as per Government of India Guidelines
  • Rules for Reservation will be implemented as per Govt. of India instructions
  • Presidential Directives on reservation will be followed
  • Seventeen Posts are horizontally reserved for PwD category in identified posts
  • Candidates appointed under PWD quota will be adjusted against vacancy of respective categories of SC/ST/OBC and UR quota

Category Certificate Requirements

  • Candidates applying in OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PWD Category must possess certificate issued by competent authority, valid for admission/job in Central Govt. Institutions issued before date of interview
  • Candidates claiming reservation on grounds of belonging to OBC (non-creamy layer) should submit community certificate in prescribed format vide Govt. of India, Department of Personnel and Training O.M No. 36036/2/2013-Estt (Res) dated 30.05.2014

  • Age relaxation upto the age of 35 years (upto 40 years for Members of Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes).

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application 21 days (including Sundays and holidays) from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News and 28 days (including Sundays and holidays) for those in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of Jammu & Kashmir State, Lahaul and Spiti Districts and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep. First date of this advertisement in the Employment News will be taken into account for calculating 21/28 days. If closing date falls on holidays, then next working day will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

Selection Process

  • Written test will be offline (Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) based) and "Objective type" for 150 marks with Negative Marking of 0.25 mark for each wrong answer.
  • Duration of examination is two hours.
  • Question paper will be in bilingual i.e English and Hindi and the syllabus will be in accordance to minimum qualification prescribed for each post at para 2.
  • Question paper will be "Multiple Choice Question".
  • Written test will be conducted for all Trades.
  • The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers.
  • Skill test (wherever applicable) will be conducted for candidates who pass the written test and come in merit.
  • Skill Test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill Test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of vacancies are subject to change. Further, the employer has the right to cancel or modify notification without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Abbreviations used: UR - Un-reserved
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given age relaxation and other concession meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • The age relaxation will be applied only in case of those candidates who produce valid certificate(s) of Caste/Category.
  • Date of Birth filled in by the candidate in application form and the same recorded in the matriculation examination certificate will be considered for determining the age and no subsequent request will be accepted.
  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability rules". Candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on the Organisational interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Candidates are allowed to apply only for one trade and applications once submitted cannot be modified under any circumstance. No application will be received by hand.
  • Persons working in Central Govt./State Govt/PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority of his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admi Cards will be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection/late receipt of applications. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/illegible application will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without correct advertisement reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents along with application form. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents or providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates at any stage of recruitment/ selection will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature. The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard.
  • Date & Place of Bio-metric, Document Verification, Written Examination and Skill Test (where applicable) for each trade will be intimated via admit card which will be sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate along with the application form and through Electronic means. Candidate to ensure that correspondence address, E-mail ID and telephone number provided in the application form remain valid for the future communication.
  • Candidates should bring their pen, pencil and clipboard for Written Examination.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/rejection will be final.
  • No Transportation Allowance/Dearness Allowance will be admissible. Examination including Written /Skill Test (where applicable) will be for TWO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangement for Lodging/ Boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence) for confirmation while reporting for the bio metric, document verification, written test and skill test (where applicable), which should have same name as given in the application form.
  • Capturing of Bio-metric details will be done on first day of documents verification and Bio-metric verification will be carried out on subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for written test/skill test (where applicable) and on reporting to unit by selected candidates.
  • The recruitment process including any part of examination can be cancelled/ postponed/ suspended/ terminated without any prior notice/ assigning any reasons at any stage.
  • Provisionally selected candidates have to produce original and photocopy of the following documents/certificates duly self-attested on the date and time intimated by the recruiting establishment:
  • (a) Matriculation certificate/Municipality Birth Certificate in support for date of birth.
  • (b) Aadhar Card.
  • (c) Mark Sheet of the educational qualification mentioned against the post applied for.
  • (d) Any certificate for the desirable qualification.
  • (e) Discharge certificate in case of Ex-serviceman.
  • (f) NOC in original from their present employer/competent authority in case of Government servant including serving Armed Forces Personnel if applicable.
  • (g) In case of widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husband, a certified copy of judgement/degree of the appropriate court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case may be.

  • I. Physical Attendance - 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For above 90% of physical attendance in a year- 5 Marks, b) For 80% to 90% of physical attendance in a year - 3 Marks, c) For 70% to below 80% of physical attendance in a year - 2 Marks, d) For less than 70% of physical attendance in a year - 0(Zero) Marks
  • Note (b):- i. Physical Attendance would mean the actual attendance put in by an applicant employee excluding all forms of absence from work such as leave, sick etc. However, would include absence from duty by virtue of ‘on-duty’ approved on account of PME, VTC, other Training and release from duty on account of official tour/company events. ii. Percentage would be computed by taking the total number of days of working of the respective mine, including Sundays and holidays in a year, as denominator.
  • II. Annual Confidential Report (ACR) – 15 Marks for 3 years (5 Marks per year) a) For ‘Outstanding’/‘Excellent’ grade in a year- 5 Marks b) For ‘Very Good’ grade in a year- 3 Marks
  • Note (c):- i. ‘Year’ for the selection criteria mentioned above would mean a Financial Year for the calendar month of April to March. ii. The data of physical attendance and ACR earned will be taken from the official record of the employee concerned.
  • III. Other selection/eligibility criteria shall be as provided in the guidelines of CIL for availing the services of superannuated non-executive employees.
  • IV. In cases where more than one applicant secures equal marks for the post, the tie will be resolved by applying the following methods one after another: (i) Marks scored in the ACR (Higher grade will be given preference) (ii) Date of Birth (Younger will be given preference) (iii) Date of Appointment (Junior would be given preference)
  • V. Provisional merit panels of shortlisted applicants for different Posts, who are fulfilling the eligibility criteria, will be derived in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie as prescribed and by giving reservation as applicable.

General Information/Instructions

  • Before submitting the application, the applicant must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in this Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Caste Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same. The basic details such as date of birth, date of appointment, date of superannuation, caste etc. will be considered as recorded in the service record of the candidate.
  • The decision of NCL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection to the post etc. shall be final and binding on all applicants. No correspondence will be entertained from the applicants found ineligible.
  • Applicants should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC-(NCL) in their Application form.
  • All correspondences with the applicants shall be done either through Speed Post / Registered email id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through NCL website. Applicants are advised to check/ visit NCL website (www.nclcil.in) regularly for further updates.
  • NCL will not take any responsibility for the applicants not being able to submit their applications within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons.
  • Selected applicants could be posted in any of the Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL and transferred to other Area/Unit/Hospital of NCL during the engagement period.
  • No TA/ DA will be paid for joining on being selected.
  • NCL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the engagement process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the NCL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Jabalpur M.P.
  • Reservation of SC/ST/OBC (NCL) CENTRE LIST will be applicable as per Govt. of India rules and guidelines, notifications and amendments from time to time issued in this regard.
  • Applicant(s) who wish to be considered against reserved vacancies and seek other concessions applicable to the reserved categories must submit requisite certificate(s) issued by Competent Authority for availing such reservation.
  • SC/ ST/ OBC (NCL) applicants who are selected on their merit will not be adjusted against the reserved vacancies. Such applicant (s) will be accommodated against the un- reserved vacancies earmarked for UR category. The reserved vacancies will be filled up separately from amongst the eligible SC/ST/OBC (NCL) applicants.
  • Provisional offer of Engagement will be issued, subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination (IME) as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • The candidates offered provisional offer of engagement shall have to report within 7 days from the date of receipt of the letter with all the original and valid educational and technical qualification certificates along with caste certificate, as applicable.
  • The initial engagement of the selected candidate would be for a period of one year from the date of joining subject to the upper age limit of 65 years as provided in the CIL guidelines. It is extendable for another term of one year subject to his performance during the initial term of engagement, medical fitness, mutual consent, norms and other terms and conditions stipulated in the guidelines of CIL mentioned above and also subject to the upper age limit of 65 years. In either case, the engagement period will be limited to the age of 65 years.
  • The engagement of a candidate on the selected post shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the initial period of engagement unless and otherwise it is extended for the second term as provided in this notification. In the event of extension for a second term, the engagement shall stand terminated automatically on the expiry of the second term so extended.
  • During the course of engagement, if it is found that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria, in any respect, his/her offer of engagement shall be cancelled.
  • Remuneration, Deductions, Medical Facilities and Working Days, Hours of work, Leave, Holidays & Rest Days etc. shall be governed as per the guidelines of CIL issued vide CIL/C-5B/MP & IR/Non Ex./Guidelines/268 dated: 12/10/2020.

How to Apply

  • Candidates will be bound to follow all rules and regulations made by Gandhisagar Hydropower House (MPPGCL) Gandhisagar for selection and to be made in the future
  • During the apprenticeship period, candidates will be eligible for 13 days casual leave and 10 days medical leave and weekly holidays
  • In case of selection of trainees, they must submit a "Character Certificate" issued by the police station of their residence
  • In case of accident, Workmen's Compensation Act 1923 will apply
  • Gandhisagar Hydropower House (MPPGCL) Gandhisagar will have the right to cancel/restrict/extend the selection process or change the allocation of posts without prior notice or reason
  • In case of non-selection, no correspondence or inquiry by candidates will be accepted
  • Candidates note that as per Section 22 (1) of the Apprenticeship Act 1961, this advertisement is for apprenticeship training, not for job or employment. After training, Gandhisagar Hydropower House (MPPGCL) Gandhisagar will not be obliged to provide employment to any candidate nor will any consideration be given in this regard

How to Apply

  • For ITI candidates application process - Before applying, candidate's registration on the Apprenticeship Portal https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ is mandatory, if the candidate has not registered, they can register as per the following process
  • First, on the website of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/ click on Apprentices → Candidate Registration in the Toolbar
  • You will see the link http://apprenticeshipindia.org/register/candidate, clicking on it will open a new page
  • Click on Register button in Toolbar. Select "Register as Candidate" option
  • In Personal Details Section, enter Aadhaar number, category (General/OBC/SC/ST) name, father/mother's name, date of birth, gender
  • In Contact Details section, enter your full address, mobile number and E-mail ID and password. Use this E-mail ID and password to login to the Apprenticeship Portal
  • In Qualification section, enter your technical and academic qualification information and upload related certificates
  • In Preference section, select your preference for sector/trade for apprenticeship training
  • In the fourth stage, upload your photo, date of birth certificate and scanned signature and click on Continue
  • On the final page, you will get a preview of the information filled by you. You can change the information by clicking on Edit button, if all information is correct, complete the registration process by clicking on Confirm button
  • After completing Candidate Registration process, you can login to the Apprenticeship Portal using the E-mail ID and password given in your Contact Detail
  • After candidate registration, go to “Establishment Search” and select Gandhisagar Hydropower House (MPPGCL) Gandhisagar option and apply according to eligibility in the vacancies shown in the institute's advertisement

  • NIL

Notification Dated 10 November 2025
Last Date for Sending Application 25 January 2026
Date and Time of Written Test/Interview 30 January 2026

Selection Process

  • Depending upon number of applications received and the post applied for, the candidates will be shortlisted for Interview or written test/skill test followed by Interview.

General Information / Instructions

  1. It is candidates’ responsibility to ascertain and ensure their eligibility as per the prescribed qualification and experience. Any misinformation detected at any stage will make the candidate liable for legal action. Permission to appear in the selection process does not approve the eligibility of the candidate. Even after qualifying the selection process, the candidate may be rendered disqualified at the time of document verification if he/she does not fulfil the essential eligibility criteria.
  2. Age Concession: Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates, retrenched Government employees, departmental candidates (including projects), and ex-servicemen, in accordance with the instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time, will be applicable as per rules. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in research projects will also be admissible for experienced and skilled persons as per the decision of the competent selection committee. The effective date for fulfilling eligibility criteria (including qualifications and experience, etc.) and the upper age limit shall be the date of walk-in/written examination.
  3. Tenure: The assignment will be governed as per the rules/instructions received from the CCRYN/competent authority from time to time. This appointment will not vest any right in the candidate to claim regular appointment or permanent absorption in AIIMS Bhopal or CCRYN, nor for continued contractual appointment.
  4. Expiry of Contract: The contractual appointment can be terminated at any time by either side by giving 30 days’ notice or salary in lieu thereof.
  5. Leave: The leave entitlement of the appointee shall be governed in terms of the CCRYN leave policy governing extramural research projects as amended from time to time.
  6. Accommodation: No hostel or any other accommodation will be provided by the Institute / Principal Investigator.
  7. The candidate who is already in government services shall submit “No Objection Certificate” from the present employer at the time of walk-in-Interview.
  8. The prescribed qualification is minimum and mere possessing the same does not entitle any candidate for selection.
  9. The candidate should bring along original certificates in support of his/her age, educational / professional qualification, experience etc., two recent passport size colour photographs and one set of self-attested photocopies of the relevant documents failing which he/she will not be allowed to participate in the walk-in-written test.
  10. The candidate applying in response to this advertisement should satisfy themselves regarding their eligibility in all respects.
  11. No travelling or other allowances will be paid to the candidate for appearing in written examination or for joining the post.
  12. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification.
  13. Private practice of any type is prohibited.
  14. He / She can be posted at any place as per the requirement of the project including rural areas / field sites.
  15. He / She is expected to conform to the rules of conduct and discipline as applicable to the institute employees.
  16. The decision of the competent authority regarding the selection of the candidate will be final and no representation will be entertained in this regard.
  17. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law.
  18. In case any information given or declaration by the candidate is found to be false or if the candidate has willfully suppressed any material information relevant to his appointment, he/she will be liable to be removed from the service and any action taken as deemed fit by the appointing authority.
  19. Applications incomplete in any aspect will be summarily rejected.
  20. The Competent Authority reserves the right of any amendment, cancellation and changes to this advertisement as a whole or in part without assigning any reason or giving notice.
  21. All information / updates pertaining to this advertisement including date of Interview, result, joining etc. will be displayed on the AIIMS Bhopal website which is www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in
  22. It will be the responsibility of applicants to keep abreast of the developments regarding the written / interview / change in date of the exam / result etc. by visiting institute website regularly.
  23. All disputes will be subject to jurisdiction of Court of Law at Bhopal.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates have to send scanned copy duly filled application form (which can be downloaded from https://aiimsbhopal.edu.in/index_controller/career#SHTM) and email to :[email protected] latest by 25 January 2026. No hard copy or print needs to be sent.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written examination/interview.
  • All shortlisted candidates shall report for written test and interview on 30 January 2026, no later than 09:30 AM.
  • The venue is Nursing college, All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal, Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh.
  • When called, the candidates shall report for appearing in the written test and interview with:
  • 1. Duly Filled Application Form
  • 2. Covering letter and detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) along with passport size photographs (2).
  • 3. Self-attested photocopies of proof of date of birth (class 10th certificate / school leaving certificate), eligibility qualification, mark-sheets, degrees, experience certificate, caste certificate, qualifying degree registration with statutory council (if applicable) and other relevant testimonials which the candidate may wish to bring to the knowledge of the selection committee.

    • Graduate in any discipline with minimum 55% marks with one year experience, knowledge of IT application, MS Office will be given preference.

  • Desirable Experience (Young Professional-I): Knowledge of IT applications, virtual meeting platforms and computer skills (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.)

Salary/ Stipend

  • Consultant Finance & Consultant Technical (Non-Medical): Rs. 1,00,000-1,80,000/- per month (Consolidated) - This will be decided by the Selection Committee on the basis of Educational Qualification, Experience and performance in the interview

  • The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project requirements.
  • ICMR is not obligated to fill all advertised positions and may withdraw, cancel, or modify the process at any time.
  • The working hours will be same as regular employees of ICMR. No extra benefit will be allowed for working beyond office hours. Unauthorized absence for a continuous period of 08 days without valid reasons shall lead to automatic termination of the engagement.
  • Leave Entitlement: Consultant - Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Young Professional-I - Eligible for 08 days leave in a calendar year on pro-rate basis. 02 Restricted Holidays as per the rules of Government of India / ICMR.

  • Incomplete / unsigned applications or submission of false / incorrect information will result in rejection.

  • Candidates in regular service under any Central / State Government, Autonomous Body, Department or PSU are not eligible to apply.

The number and employability of female candidates will be decided as per service requirement. Vacancies are allocated state-wise and the final selection will be based on state-wise merit.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

For Science Subjects:

  • Candidates should have passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent examination with Mathematics, Physics and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Passed Three years Diploma Course in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Automobile/Computer Science/Instrumentation Technology/Information Technology) from Central, State and UT recognised Polytechnic institute with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English in Diploma Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation, if English is not a subject in Diploma Course).
  • Passed Two years Vocational Course with non-vocational subject viz. Physics and Mathematics from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English in Vocational Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation, if English is not a subject in Vocational Course).

For Other than Science Subjects:

  • Passed Intermediate/10+2/Equivalent Examination in any stream/subjects from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.
  • Passed two years Vocational Course from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English in Vocational Course (or in Intermediate/Matriculation if English is not a subject in Vocational Course).

Essential Requirements:

  • Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT as on date of registration shall only be considered.
  • Exact aggregate percentage of marks before decimal as written in the marks sheet shall only be considered (For example 49.99% should be taken as 49% and not to be rounded off to 50%).
  • Candidates eligible for Science Subjects examination are also eligible for Other than Science Subjects and would be given an option of appearing in both examinations in one sitting.

Salary/Stipend

  • 1st Year: ₹30,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹21,000/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹9,000/-)
  • 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹23,100/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹9,900/-)
  • 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- per month (In Hand: ₹25,550/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹10,950/-)
  • 4th Year: ₹40,000/- per month (In Hand: ₹28,000/- + Contribution to Corpus Fund: ₹12,000/-)
  • Additional Benefits: Risk and Hardship allowances (as applicable), Dress and Travel allowances, Ration, Clothing, Accommodation and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per existing rules.
  • Seva Nidhi Package: Approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs after four years (₹5.02 lakh candidate contribution + ₹5.02 lakh Government contribution, excluding interest).
  • Insurance Cover: Non-contributory Life Insurance cover of ₹48 Lakhs for the duration of engagement period.
  • Note: No entitlement to gratuity and any kind of pensionary benefits. No contribution to Provident Fund required.

Age Limit (as on Date of Birth Block)

  • Minimum Age: Born on or after 01 January 2006
  • Maximum Age: Born on or before 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive)
  • Upper Age Limit on Enrolment: Should not exceed 21 years on date of enrolment
  • Note: In case a candidate clears all stages of the Selection Procedure, the upper age limit as on date of enrolment should be 21 years.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: ₹550/- plus 18% GST (Total: ₹649/-) - Non-refundable
  • Payment Mode: Online via Payment Gateway through Net Banking, Debit Cards, Credit Cards, UPI
  • Appeal Medical Board Fee: ₹40/- (if required) - To be deposited in Government Treasury/RBI/SBI through Electronic Military Receivable Order (e-MRO)/Military Receivable Order (MRO)
  • Refund Policy: Application fee and other charges once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances and neither the same be held reserved for any other recruitment or selection process.
  • Multiple Payments: If multiple payments are received from a candidate against single application, the excess amount will be refunded back to the originating account after closing of registration.

Important Dates

Event Date/Time
Online Registration Start Date 12 January 2026 at 1100 Hr
Online Registration End Date 01 February 2026 at 2300 Hr
Phase-I Online Exam Date 30 March 2026 / 31 March 2026
Admit Card for Phase-I 48-72 hours prior to examination
Provisional Select List Display 14 November 2026
Enrolment List Publication 01 December 2026
Validity of Provisional Select List Six months from date of display (Only for Intake 01/2027)

Selection Process

  • Phase-I - Online Test: Objective type test (bilingual - English & Hindi except English paper)
    • Science Subjects: 60 minutes - Physics, Mathematics and English as per 10+2 CBSE syllabus
    • Other than Science Subjects: 45 minutes - English and Reasoning & General Awareness (RAGA)
    • Both (Science & Other than Science): 85 minutes - Physics, Mathematics, English and RAGA
    • Marking Pattern: +1 mark for correct answer, 0 for unattempted, -0.25 for wrong answer
  • Normalisation of Marks: Marks will be normalised to account for variation in difficulty levels across different sessions
  • Phase-II Testing at ASC: State-wise shortlisted candidates will be called for:
    • Document Verification
    • Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I & PFT-II)
    • Adaptability Test-I (Objective type written test)
    • Adaptability Test-II (As per policy in vogue)
  • Physical Fitness Test Details:
    • PFT-I: 1.6 Km run (Male: within 7 minutes, Female: within 8 minutes)
    • PFT-II for Male: 10 Push-ups (1 min), 10 Sit-ups (1 min), 20 Squats (1 min)
    • PFT-II for Female: 10 Sit-ups (1 min 30 sec), 15 Squats (1 min)
  • Phase-III - Medical Examination: Conducted by Air Force Medical Team as per IAF medical standards including baseline investigations (Blood tests, Urine tests, X-Ray, ECG, USG for females, etc.)
  • Appeal Medical Board: Available for candidates declared medically unfit (Fee: ₹40/-)
  • Final Selection: Based on state-wise merit, medical fitness, availability of vacancies, and meeting all eligibility criteria

General Information/Instructions

  • Marital Status: Only unmarried candidates (male & female) are eligible. Candidates shall undertake not to marry during the four-year engagement period. Marriage during service will result in discharge.
  • Pregnancy Policy: Female candidates shall undertake not to get pregnant during engagement period. Pregnancy will result in discharge and debar from Regular Cadre selection.
  • Medical Standards:
    • Height: Minimum 152 cms for male and female (relaxation for North East/hilly regions/Lakshadweep)
    • Weight: Proportionate to height and age
    • Chest: Male - minimum 77 cms with 5 cms expansion; Female - minimum 5 cms expansion
    • Vision: 6/12 each eye correctable to 6/6, Colour Vision: CP-II
    • Hearing: Normal - able to hear forced whisper from 6 meters
    • Dental: Minimum 14 dental points with healthy gums
    • No history of LASIK/PRK surgery
  • Body Tattoo: Permanent body tattoos not permitted except on inner forearms, back of hand/palm, and tribal tattoos as per custom. Offensive tattoos prohibited.

  • Regular Cadre Opportunity: Up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in regular cadre based on performance and organisational requirements
  • Leave Entitlement: 30 days annual leave per year plus sick leave as per medical advice
  • Medical & CSD Facilities: Available at Service Hospitals during engagement period
  • No ESM Status: Agniveervayu will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status after completion of four years
  • NDA/AFCAT Attempts: Permitted to appear (maximum three attempts) during engagement period subject to conditions
  • Identification Requirements: AADHAAR Card mandatory (exemption for J&K, Ladakh, Assam, Meghalaya candidates)
  • Examination Centres: Candidates to indicate five choices but CASB reserves right to allot any centre
  • No TA/DA: No travel allowance or daily allowance admissible for any stage of selection
  • Mobile Phones Prohibited: Mobile phones/smart watches/electronic devices prohibited in testing areas. Possession will result in permanent debarment.
  • Malpractices: Candidates found indulging in malpractices/unfair means shall be debarred permanently
  • Disclaimer: IAF reserves the right to cancel entire selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons

How to Apply

  • Application Mode: ONLY Online applications accepted
  • Website: https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in
  • Registration Process:
    • Step-I: Register with personal details and contact details. User-ID will be email ID and password will be sent via email/SMS
    • Step-II: Re-login to complete personal details, communication details, qualification details, declaration and upload documents
    • Enter OTPs sent to mobile and email for verification
    • Fill all required details carefully
  • Required Documents for Upload:
    • Passport size recent colour photograph (100-200 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) - taken within one month holding black slate with name and date
    • Candidate's signature image (80-150 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format) - black ink on white paper
    • Parent's/Guardian's signature (if below 18 years)
    • Left thumb impression image (50-100 KB in .jpg/.jpeg format)
    • Live image capture via web camera during registration
  • Payment: Pay examination fee of ₹550 + 18% GST via Payment Gateway (Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI)
  • Print Application: Take printout of submitted application form and retain for future reference
  • Important Notes:
    • Valid email ID and mobile number mandatory
    • Apply only once - multiple applications will result in rejection
    • Data entered during registration will be final - no changes permitted later
    • Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn
    • Candidates advised to register at earliest as no extension will be accommodated
  • Admit Card: Will be sent 48-72 hours before exam on registered email ID
  • For Queries: Contact CASB at 011-25694209/25699606, Email: [email protected] or [email protected], Mobile: +91-9513253233 (0900-1800 Hrs, Monday to Saturday)

Eligibility Criteria

Salary/ Stipend

Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave.   • Desirable Qualification: National Council for Training in the Vocational Trades Certificate from Directorate General of Employment and Training, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Govt. of India.
  • Essential: Pass in 10+2 with a certificate from a recognized Industrial Training Institute in the fitter trade or grade. OR Armed forces personnel or Ex-servicemen from the appropriate trade and minimum at grade I.
  • Desirable Qualification: National Council for Training in the Vocational Trades Certificate from Directorate General of Employment and Training, Ministry of Labour and Employment, Govt. of India.

  • Desirable Qualification: Conversant with the duties of the respective trades with one year experience in the trade.

  • Posts at Serial No. 2(a) to 2(b) - Pay Matrix Level-4 [ Pay Band -1, Rs. 5200-20200 (Grade Pay Rs. 2400/-)].
  • Posts at Serial No. 2(c) - Pay Matrix Level-1 [ Pay Band -1, Rs. 5200-20200 (Grade Pay Rs. 1800/-)].

Age Limit

  • 18 to 25 Years.
  • For ESM, resultant age after deducting period of service from actual age should not exceed prescribed age limit by more than 3 years. Calculation of age shall be as per the category for which the application has been made.
  • Departmental candidate with three years continuous service in Central Govt. will be given age relaxation up to 40 years of age (45 years for SC/ST)
  • Age relaxation upto the age of 35 years (upto 40 years for Members of Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes).

Important Dates

Last date for receipt of application 21 days (including Sundays and holidays) from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News and 28 days (including Sundays and holidays) for those in Assam, Meghalaya, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim, Ladakh Division of Jammu & Kashmir State, Lahaul and Spiti Districts and Pangi Sub-Division of Chamba District of Himachal Pradesh, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep. First date of this advertisement in the Employment News will be taken into account for calculating 21/28 days. If closing date falls on holidays, then next working day will be taken as closing date for receipt of application.

Selection Process

  • Written test will be offline (Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) based) and "Objective type" for 150 marks with Negative Marking of 0.25 mark for each wrong answer.
  • Duration of examination is two hours.
  • Question paper will be in bilingual i.e English and Hindi and the syllabus will be in accordance to minimum qualification prescribed for each post at para 2.
  • Question paper will be "Multiple Choice Question".
  • Written test will be conducted for all Trades.
  • The selection committee has discretion to fix minimum qualifying marks in any or all parts of papers.
  • Skill test (wherever applicable) will be conducted for candidates who pass the written test and come in merit.
  • Skill Test (wherever applicable) will be qualifying in nature and the candidates who fail to qualify Skill Test shall not be eligible for selection.

General Information / Instructions

  • The number of vacancies are subject to change. Further, the employer has the right to cancel or modify notification without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Abbreviations used: UR - Un-reserved
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates who apply against unreserved post will not be given age relaxation and other concession meant for SC/ST/OBC.
  • The crucial date for determining the age limit shall be the last date of receipt of application.
  • The age relaxation will be applied only in case of those candidates who produce valid certificate(s) of Caste/Category.
  • Date of Birth filled in by the candidate in application form and the same recorded in the matriculation examination certificate will be considered for determining the age and no subsequent request will be accepted.
  • Posts mentioned above are subject to "All India Transfer Liability and Field Service Liability rules". Candidates selected may be posted to any "Unit or Location" depending on the Organisational interest. No representation will be entertained.
  • Candidates are allowed to apply only for one trade and applications once submitted cannot be modified under any circumstance. No application will be received by hand.
  • Persons working in Central Govt./State Govt/PSUs must provide the "NOC" document obtained through the competent authority of his/her present organization to Recruitment Agency at the time of selection.
  • Application(s) will be shortlisted on the basis of Essential Qualification referred at Para 2 and Admi Cards will be issued accordingly. No weightage will be given for additional/higher qualification.
  • Merely fulfilling the essential qualification does not automatically entitle a person to be called for test.
  • Admit card will NOT be issued in case of rejection/late receipt of applications. Candidates will not be intimated in case of rejection of their application and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
  • Incomplete/illegible application will be deemed invalid and rejected without intimation to the candidate.
  • Application(s) without correct advertisement reference number will not be accepted.
  • No man who has more than one wife living and no woman who has more than one husband living, shall be eligible for appointment.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature. No enquiry or correspondence will be entertained.
  • Candidates are responsible for providing all factually correct data and correct certificates/documents along with application form. Providing factually incorrect data, fake certificates/documents or providing incomplete certificates/documents by the candidates at any stage of recruitment/ selection will result in automatic rejection of his/her candidature. The selection board shall not be responsible for any lapse on the part of the candidate in this regard.
  • Date & Place of Bio-metric, Document Verification, Written Examination and Skill Test (where applicable) for each trade will be intimated via admit card which will be sent through ORDINARY POST in the envelope provided by the candidate along with the application form and through Electronic means. Candidate to ensure that correspondence address, E-mail ID and telephone number provided in the application form remain valid for the future communication.
  • Candidates should bring their pen, pencil and clipboard for Written Examination.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation and re-checking of the scores. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained. The decision of appointing authority regarding selection/rejection will be final.
  • No Transportation Allowance/Dearness Allowance will be admissible. Examination including Written /Skill Test (where applicable) will be for TWO (02) to FIVE (05) days or more days and may spread across different dates. Candidates will have to make their own arrangement for Lodging/ Boarding during conduct of all types of examination.
  • Candidates are required to carry "Admit Card" along with identity proof (either Passport, Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Driving Licence) for confirmation while reporting for the bio metric, document verification, written test and skill test (where applicable), which should have same name as given in the application form.
  • Capturing of Bio-metric details will be done on first day of documents verification and Bio-metric verification will be carried out on subsequent days of reporting of the candidate for written test/skill test (where applicable) and on reporting to unit by selected candidates.
  • The recruitment process including any part of examination can be cancelled/ postponed/ suspended/ terminated without any prior notice/ assigning any reasons at any stage.
  • Provisionally selected candidates have to produce original and photocopy of the following documents/certificates duly self-attested on the date and time intimated by the recruiting establishment:
  • (a) Matriculation certificate/Municipality Birth Certificate in support for date of birth.
  • (b) Aadhar Card.
  • (c) Mark Sheet of the educational qualification mentioned against the post applied for.
  • (d) Any certificate for the desirable qualification.
  • (e) Discharge certificate in case of Ex-serviceman.
  • (f) NOC in original from their present employer/competent authority in case of Government servant including serving Armed Forces Personnel if applicable.
  • (g) In case of widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husband, a certified copy of judgement/degree of the appropriate court to prove the fact of divorce or the judicial separation, as the case may be.
  • (h) Address proof (Passport/Ration Card/Voter Card/Driving Licence).
  • Candidates on selection are liable to be transferred anywhere across India including field services liability and not necessarily at the choice of location given at time of application.
  • Any representation for redressal of grievances with regard to the recruitment will be subject to the jurisdiction of the District Court of Delhi Cantonment Area where candidate has submitted the application.
  • The unit will not be liable/responsible for paying any compensation in case of any injury/death suffered by the candidate during the recruitment process.

How to Apply

  • Candidates to forward application duly typed in A4 size paper as per prescribed format given in the advertisement alongwith a self-addressed envelope (size - 10.5 cm x 25 cm) with postal stamp of Rs. 5/- properly sealed in an envelope to the address mentioned against the post applied for through ORDINARY POST. Candidates are requested to superscribe the words "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF......................." on the top of the envelope while sending the application form. Candidate to ensure that valid E-mail ID and Aadhaar linked Telephone number are mentioned in the application form.
