Post Name UR OBC SC EWS ST Total
Manager/ Electrical 15 08 04 03 02 32

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications: Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade from recognized University/ Institute approved by AICTE/UGC
  • Essential Post Qualification Experience As on 01.12.2025: Minimum Five years of experience in Electrical construction, Procurement, Installation, Testing and commissioning/TRD Maintenance in Railways, Metro Rail, Power Transmission/Distribution utilities
  • Desirable: Experience in Railway OHE /Power Supply/SCADA. E&M, Electrical utility Diversion shall be preferred.

Salary/Stipend

  • Fixed consolidated Pay: Rs. 60,000/- per month.
  • In addition to above emoluments, the candidates would also be provided annual increment of 5% on Fixed Consolidated Pay after each completed year of service.
  • For Medical Coverage, the Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for self with the ceiling of premium of Rs 4000/- per annum shall be taken by the Contract Employees themselves covering Covid-19 and other diseases. The premium amount shall be reimbursed to the contract employees subject to submission of copy of health insurance policy and original receipt of premium paid.
  • Minimum PF as prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 will be deducted from the salary and a matching contribution will be made by IRCON. The accumulations will be paid at the time of cessation of contract.
  • There are no allowances over and above the fixed pay.
  • No other perks or benefits would be admissible except the above.

Age Limit (as on 01-12-2025)

  • Maximum Age As on 01.12.2025: 50 Years
  • Age Relaxations as per Government of India's guidelines subject to fulfillment of the requisite qualification & experience.

Important Dates

Notification Date 26.12.2025
Last Date for receipt of Application alongwith complete documents at Corporate Office 19.01.2026
Cutoff Date for Age, Qualification, Experience 01.12.2025

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through written Exam and /or interview of shortlisted candidates.
  • The list of shortlisted candidates invited for interview shall be displayed on the website and the interview call letters would be sent by e-mail only.

General Information/Instructions

  • The above posts are contractual posts and not for the regular establishment of IRCON. The appointment will be initially for a period of two years subject to satisfactory performance of the selected candidate. The contract may be further extended, for another one year if the services of the candidates are found to be satisfactory and as per the requirements of the Project. However, the appointment is co-terminus with the Project for which candidate is selected and will not confer any right to claim absorption in regular establishment of the company or for appointment in other projects of the company.
  • One leave for each calendar month of service can be availed during the contract period. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated but no leave encashment for un availed leave is allowed during the contract or on resignation or termination of contract. No other type of leave would be admissible.
  • One weekly off and other public holidays when the project office remains closed would be available.
  • Working hours/days and off will be the same as for the Project.
  • TA/DA would also be admissible if deputed on outstation duty.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of interview. If any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • The ex-contract employees of IRCON, whose services were terminated due to closure of projects, can also apply for these posts if they fulfil the required qualifications and experience. A copy of the termination letter should be sent along with the application. Appointment against this advertisement shall be treated as fresh appointment without any linkage to previous employment in IRCON.
  • Candidates either working or not working as on cutoff date can apply if they possess essential qualification and post qualification experience as mentioned above.
  • The no. of posts indicated above may vary based on further assessment of requirement. The company reserves the right to increase, decrease, cancel, restrict & modify the requirement at any point of time without assigning any reason thereof.
  • Teaching/training/consultancy/Freelancing experience shall not be treated as relevant experience.
  • Medical Standards: Candidates should be in sound health and free from color blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed.
  • Note: In case of Doubt/ Query/ Clarification, please mail us at [email protected].
  • All modifications/amendments shall be displayed on IRCON official web-site only at www.ircon.org under career@HR. Therefore, candidates are requested to keep checking the web-site for modifications/ amendments, if any.
  • Once applied, the applicants are advised to keep checking the web site as well as their registered e-mail regularly for any updates.

How to Apply

  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Eligible candidates have to apply in prescribed format through off line mode only. It is advisable that the candidates have a valid e-mail id in order to facilitate faster communication.
  • Application neatly typed on A-4 size paper in the prescribed format should be sent to Joint General Manager/ HRM, IRCON INTERNATIONAL LIMITED, C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017 accompanied with the copy of following documents: i. Experience Certificate in chronological order. In case of Present Employment, offer letter alone will not be considered as proof of experience, the candidate should also submit last Two Months’ salary slip of present employer for proof of experience. ii. Date of Birth/ class X passing certificate as proof of DOB. iii. Caste certificate/EWS Certificate/Age relaxation. Certificate issued should be in prescribed format as per Government of India's guidelines. iv. Qualification Degree/Diploma and All semester/year Mark sheets for calculation of percentage in qualifying degree. Candidates, who have been awarded CGPA/OGPA/DGPA in place of marks in degree, should submit proof of conversion factor as applicable to percentage as prescribed by the University/Institute.
  • If the candidate belongs to OBC category, a caste certificate issued by competent authority as applicable for appointment to the services in Govt. of India in proper format as per Annexure-A will be accepted. Please note, that OBC certificate issued in the current financial year only will be accepted as a current proof of your not belonging to “creamy layer” in the OBC category.
  • Candidates should mention percentage in the fields where percentage is required without rounding off. Percentage obtained in Essential qualification as mentioned in consolidated mark sheet issued by University/Institution will be considered. However, in case consolidated mark sheet is not being issued by University/Institute, final percentage will be calculated by taking average of all semesters/years.
  • In case CGPA/OGPA/DGPA is mentioned in mark sheets, following criteria may be applied: i. In case where conversion into percentage is not provided by university/institutes: "if university/institute do not have the provision for conversion of CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or letter grade into percentage than minimum 6 on 10-point scale will be considered as 60%. On any scale different from 10-point scale the score will be prorated accordingly. ii. In case where conversion into percentage is provided by university/institutes: Wherever CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or letter grade in degree is awarded, equivalent % of marks should be indicated in the application as per norms adopted by concerned university/institute. A certificate to this effect may be obtained by the candidate from the university/institute, which shall be required to be produced at the time of verification
  • Applicants will have to send their application form alongwith requisite enclosures to reach us by 19.01.2026 as per address given in the table below.
  • Application should be sent in an envelope super scribed – “Application for the post of < name of post > - Advt. No.- C-27/2025.

The Indian Air Force invites applications from male Indian/Gorkha (a subject of Nepal) citizens from all States and UTs for Airmen Group Y Medical Assistant trade. Vacancies will be determined based on organizational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

For Medical Assistant Trade (10+2 Candidates):

  • Candidate should have passed 10+2/Intermediate/Equivalent Examination with Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards recognised by Central, State and UT with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and with 50% marks in English.
  • Should have passed two years Vocational Course with non-vocational subjects ie, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English from Education Boards/Councils recognised by Central, State and UT with minimum 50% marks in aggregate and 50% marks in English.

Selection Process

  • Step 1 - Online Application: Candidates must apply online through www.joinindianarmy.nic.in (Offline application for widows of defence personnel to be sent to Directorate General of Recruiting)
  • Step 2 - Shortlisting: Applications will be shortlisted based on cumulative percentage of marks obtained by candidates upto final semester/year. Cut-off will be applied for each Engineering stream based on vacancy to call up ratio.
  • Step 3 - Allotment of Selection Centre: After shortlisting, centre allotment will be intimated via email. Candidates will select their SSB dates on first come first serve basis.
  • Step 4 - SSB Interview: Two-stage selection procedure conducted at one of the Selection Centres - Prayagraj (UP), Bhopal (MP), Bengaluru (Karnataka) and Jalandhar Cantt (Punjab). Duration is five days.
  • Step 5 - Medical Examination: Candidates who get recommended after Stage-2 of SSB will undergo medical examination. Validity of SSB medical examination is 270 days.
  • Step 6 - Merit List: Merit list will be prepared engineering stream/subject wise based on SSB interview marks.
  • Step 7 - Joining Letter: Candidates in merit list who come within stipulated stream-wise vacancies and are medically fit will be issued joining letters for pre-commissioning training at PCTA, subject to meeting all eligibility criteria.

Date of issue of admit card for Practical Examination 10th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-I) 25th & 26th April 2026
Practical Examination (Batch-II) 2nd & 3rd May 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-I) 26th April 2026
Declaration of Practical Examination results (Batch-II) 3rd May 2026
Two Weeks Food Analysts mandatory training 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
Issuance of certificate after training completion 5th June 2026

Selection Process

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination will be conducted in two stages: Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by Practical Examination
  • Only candidates who qualify the Computer Based Test (CBT) as per the laid down criteria and fulfil the eligibility requirements will be allowed to appear in Practical Examination
  • Dates of Practical examination will be intimated separately to qualified candidates
  • The examination comprises both theoretical knowledge assessment through CBT and practical skills evaluation through hands-on practical examination
  • Upon successful completion of both CBT and Practical Examination, candidates must complete a two-week mandatory Food Analysts training from 25th May 2026 to 5th June 2026
  • Certificates will be issued to successful candidates after completion of the mandatory training on 5th June 2026
  • Candidates successfully completing all stages will be certified as Food Analysts by FSSAI

General Information/Instructions

  • The 11th Food Analyst Examination is conducted under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Food Safety and Standards (First Amendment) Rules, 2022
  • This is a certification examination and not for employment purposes
  • There is no reservation in whatsoever form since this is not for employment
  • Candidates must have relevant educational qualifications from universities established in India by law
  • Three years of mandatory experience in food analysis is essential after obtaining the required educational qualification
  • Junior Analysts who have acquired 3 years of mandatory experience can appear only in the Practical Examination after qualifying CBT
  • The opportunity for Junior Analysts to appear in Practical examination after acquiring 3 years of experience will be provided only once in a lifetime
  • All application fees are non-refundable once submitted
  • Candidates must complete the registration and application process online through the official portal only
  • Admit cards will be available for download from the official website on the specified dates
  • Answer key will be published after the CBT examination and candidates can submit challenges during the specified window period

How to Apply

Step 1: Registration Process

  • Visit the official Food Safety and Standards Authority of India Portal at https://fssai.formsubmit.in
  • Click on the "Register" menu on the homepage
  • Enter your full name as per official documents
  • Create and set your username for profile login
  • Provide a valid and active email ID
  • Enter your mobile number during registration
  • Set a strong password for profile login
  • Click on the "Sign Up" button to proceed
  • Enter the OTP received on your registered email and mobile number to complete the registration process
  • Once registration is successful, you will receive a user ID and password via email
  • After successful verification of email ID and mobile number, you will be redirected to the login page

Step 2: Login to Portal

  • Click on the "Login" menu on the homepage of FSSAI Portal at https://fssai.formsubmit.in
  • Enter the user ID and password received via email after successful registration
  • Click on the "Login" button to access your dashboard
  • If you forget the password, click on the "Forget Password" button and follow the password recovery steps

Step 3: Fill Application Form

  • After successful login, you will see the candidate dashboard
  • In the dashboard, you can view current exam openings, previous/incomplete applications, and admit card details
  • To apply for 11th Food Analyst Examination (11th FAE) 2025-26, click on the apply button in the corresponding examination row

Step 4: Complete Application Steps

  • Fill Personal Details accurately as per your official documents
  • Enter Details of Academic Qualification with proper certificates
  • Provide complete Work Experience Details with supporting documents
  • Select your preferred Examination Centre Choice
  • Upload all required Document Details in the specified format
  • Read and accept the Declaration by Candidate
  • Make Payment for Application Form through online payment gateway
  • Download and save the completed Application form for future reference

Important Points While Applying

  • Ensure all information entered is accurate and matches your official documents
  • Keep scanned copies of all required documents ready before starting the application
  • Complete the application process before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues
  • Take a printout of the completed application form for your records
  • Note down your application number for future correspondence

MEA Senior Policy Specialist in MER Division Recruitment 2025 Vacancy Details 

S. No. Post Name Total Posts
1 Senior Policy Specialist in MER Division 2

Eligibility Criteria

  • The applicant should only be an Indian national.
  • The applicant should possess a higher qualification (Masters’ and above) from a reputed Indian or International Institution/University in Economics, Development Cooperation, Development Partnership, International Relations, International Law, International Development, Strategic Studies, Public Administration, International Trade, Environment and Climate, Trade, Agriculture, Labour Economics, Energy, Health, Disaster Management, Anti corruption or a related subject.
  • The applicant should have at least five years of experience in handling multilateral work in UN agencies or International Organizations or International consultancy organizations or Government of India, in relevant fields.
  • The applicant should preferably have experience of participating in international meetings.
  • The applicant should possess good writing and analytical skills and have experience in policy making or advocacy, including experience in speech writing, analytical writing and preparing negotiation strategy.
  • The applicant must be proficient in the use of computers (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
  • The applicant should not be more than 45 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

Salary/Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 2.75 lakh per month each, with deduction of applicable taxes.
  • The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.
  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidates, and no HRA shall be admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.

Age Limit (as on last date of submission of application)

  • The applicant should not be more than age of 45 years as on the last date of submission of application.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Advertisement Date (Advertisement No. Q/PF/575/55/2025) 24/12/2025
Last date for receiving applications 16/01/2026 (up to 17:30 Hrs)

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test.
  • The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to applicants for attending interview.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/Instructions

  • The period of consultancy is 01 (one) year; the contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and requirement.
  • The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof; unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • The selected consultants will be attached to dedicated BRICS Working Groups like Trade, Industry, Finance, Agriculture, Energy, Environment, ICT, Labour etc., and will develop concept notes, analytical notes and background documents for India’s BRICS Chairship.
  • They will assist in preparing draft outcome documents for BRICS meetings, help with negotiation process including drafting documents during negotiations, and keep track of country positions on relevant subjects.
  • They will keep track of the state of play on issues discussed in BRICS Working Groups and work towards proposals that may garner consensus in BRICS.
  • They will cover meetings and perform liaison duties with various Line Ministries/Departments of Government of India, Think Tanks, International Organizations and BRICS member and invitee countries, and perform any other task assigned by the Head of Division.
  • Job location will be Ministry of External Affairs (South Block/Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan/Sushma Swaraj Bhawan/Patiala House/ISIL Building/CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis; normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs, subject to change, with Saturdays/Sundays as weekend off.
  • In exigencies, the Consultant may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays; no extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible.
  • The Consultant shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise, in government or private sector or in any other organization of any kind during the term of engagement with the Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service, subject to conditions in the advertisement; leave encashment will not be permissible and unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format with effect from the actual date of engagement.
  • Applications received after the closing date and time or without the prescribed documents or otherwise found incomplete or not in the prescribed proforma will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.

How to Apply

  • Applicants who fulfil the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents/certificates in support of educational qualifications and experience in Government service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either offline or online mode.
  • Offline mode: By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Senior Policy Specialist in the MER Division of Ministry of External Affairs”, sent to: Under Secretary (PF&PG), Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011.
  • Online mode: Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the position against which the application is being submitted, to email address: [email protected].
  • Incomplete applications and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

Post Name Pay Scale (Rs.) No. of Vacancies Nature of Employment
Deputy General Manager (Human Resource) E4 Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 (IDA) 01 Deputation

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential qualification (for both modes): M.B.A. (HR) / P.G Degree / P.G. Diploma in Management (HR) or its equivalent (Full Time).
  • Experience for DGM/HR on Deputation: Minimum 06 years of post-qualification experience in the case of Organized Group ‘A’ Services, OR minimum 08 years of post-qualification experience at the Executive Level (E2/ L9 or above) in Central/ State Govt./ CPSE/ Autonomous Bodies/ Govt. Instrumentalities etc.
  • Experience for DGM/HR on Immediate Absorption: Minimum 08 years of post-qualification experience at the Executive Level (E2/ L9 or above) in Central/ State Govt./ CPSE/ Autonomous Bodies/ Govt. Instrumentalities etc.
  • Job related requirements (for both modes): Functional capabilities should include thorough knowledge of labour laws and service regulations, disciplinary matters, and application of HRM concepts, tools and practices such as manpower planning, performance management, career planning, succession planning, competency modelling and competency appraisal; exposure in industrial relations with multiple trade unions scenario is desirable; experience in latest HR practices and policies including dealing with retention and attrition aspects.
  • Required Pay Scale – Deputation: Working in CDA pay scale Rs. 78,800–2,09,200 (L12) or above; OR working in IDA pay scale Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 (E4) or above; OR last 3 years of service in pay scale Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 (E3).
  • Required Pay Scale – Immediate Absorption: For CDA: in pay scale Rs. 78,800–2,09,200 (L12) or above OR last 3 years of service in pay scale Rs. 67,700–2,08,700 (L11); for IDA: in pay scale Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 (E4) or above OR last 3 years of service in pay scale Rs. 60,000–1,80,000 (E3).
  • Nationality: Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Scale: E4 Level IDA pay scale Rs. 70,000–2,00,000 (IDA).
  • Deputation – Emoluments: Pay and allowances regulated as per DoPT rules; in addition, HRA/Lease, Transport, Laptop, Mobile Phone, Headset, Uniform, Briefcase etc., subject to limits and other allowances as per Company policy.
  • Immediate Absorption – Emoluments: Basic Pay as applicable in the grade, HRA/Lease, Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA) at applicable rates and Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach; other benefits like Transport, Laptop, Mobile Phone, Headset, Uniform, Briefcase etc. as per extant Company Rules.

Age Limit (as on 24-12-2025)

  • Maximum age for the post of Deputy General Manager (Human Resource) is 45 years as on 24/12/2025.
  • Only Indian Nationals above 18 years of age are eligible to apply.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is mentioned in the vacancy notice.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Vacancy Notice Date / Notification Date 24/12/2025
Opening of website link for applying online 24/12/2025
Closing date for applying online 23/01/2026
Last date for receipt of printed application and supporting documents by hand / post 23/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Based on the eligibility, candidates meeting the criteria will be called for Interview.
  • The venue, date and time of Interview will be informed in advance.
  • Any request for change in date or venue shall not be entertained.
  • Document verification will be done before the Interview; candidates must carry their original certificates for verification, failing which they will not be allowed to attend the Interview.
  • Merit list will be prepared based on score of Interview.
  • The minimum qualifying marks/percentage for determining suitability shall be 60%.

General Information/Instructions

  • The eligibility criteria for Deputation of Central/State Govt. employees shall be as per DoPT guidelines.
  • Before applying, candidates must ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria mentioned in the Vacancy Notice; eligibility will be verified with original documents at the time of interview.
  • Applicants who do not fulfil the age and minimum education qualification as on closing date of receipt of applications need not apply.
  • Essential educational qualifications as indicated are mandatory; only full-time regular courses will be considered, and all essential qualifications must be from UGC recognized Indian University/Deemed University or AICTE approved courses/concerned statutory councils.
  • Candidates claiming equivalence in qualification must produce an equivalence certificate; in case of dual specialization in Management, one specialization must be function specific for which the post has been advertised.
  • Wherever CGPA/OGPA/CPI/grade is awarded, equivalent percentage must be indicated as per norms of University/Institute and documentary proof must be produced at interview.
  • Experience will be counted from date of assumption of charge; for combined Government and Private sector experience, private sector experience will carry 80% weightage and Government sector 100% for overall experience computation.
  • Candidates once selected but not joining for any reason shall be debarred from applying for any positions in NCRTC for two years from date of Offer of Appointment.
  • No person previously dismissed, removed or compulsorily retired from service of a Government department/PSU/autonomous body/Corporation, or previously convicted for an offence involving moral turpitude, shall be eligible.
  • Conditions regarding more than one spouse and marriage shall follow Central Government rules; teaching or freelancing experience shall not be considered as qualifying experience.
  • The prescribed qualification/experience criteria are minimum and mere possession does not entitle a candidate for participation; NCRTC’s decision is final.
  • Candidates from Government entities/CPSEs/SPSEs will be considered for pay protection; candidates on contract in regular pay scales will not get pay protection and their pay will be fixed at minimum of the pay scale.
  • NCRTC reserves the right to raise minimum eligibility standards, to fill or not to fill positions, and to cancel/modify the recruitment/selection process without notice.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum or time extension will be hosted only on Career section of www.ncrtc.in; candidates should visit website regularly.
  • Canvassing directly or indirectly will result in disqualification; disputes will be settled under jurisdiction of Delhi High Court only.
  • In case of query, candidates may write to [email protected] mentioning “POST–DGM(HR) (Post Code ) - 63/2025” in subject line or contact 011-24666700 (10:00 AM to 4:30 PM).

How to Apply

  • Candidates shall apply online through NCRTC website (www.ncrtc.in) under ‘Career Section’ as per eligibility criteria.
  • Separate application shall be filled for Deputation and Immediate Absorption.
  • Before registering/applying online, candidates should go through detailed instructions and keep ready: valid E-mail ID and Mobile Number, scanned self-attested recent passport size colour photograph (3.5 x 4.5 cm, up to 100 kb, .jpg/.jpeg) and scanned signature (up to 100 kb, .jpg/.jpeg).
  • While applying online, candidates need to upload self-attested copies of: 10th Certificate/Birth Certificate; Degree Certificate of Graduation and/or Post-Graduation highlighting stream/specialization; appointment letter, joining order and latest salary slip of present organisation; experience certificates and duty allocation orders; copies of APARs of last three years; office orders indicating promotions; experience/service/relieving orders from previous organisations; last three months’ salary slips.
  • Applications without supporting certificates/documents will be summarily rejected.
  • After submitting online application, candidate must download the system-generated Application Form with Unique Registration Number, take a print, attach supporting documents and send to the specified address by hand/post latest by 23/01/2026.
  • The envelope containing printed application and supporting documents should be superscribed as: “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER (HUMAN RESOURCE) ON DEPUTATION BASIS – 63/2025” OR “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DEPUTY GENERAL MANAGER (HUMAN RESOURCE) ON IMMEDIATE ABSORPTION BASIS – 63/2025”. Candidates applying for both modes must submit separate applications.
  • For Deputation: Application should be routed through Administrative Officer (HQ/Board etc.) for forwarding to NCRTC with No Objection, Vigilance/DAR clearance etc. as per prescribed proforma (Annexure-I).
  • Candidates must have valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number active during entire recruitment process; all communications will be sent to registered e-mail ID.
  • Candidates should take utmost care to furnish correct details; they can edit information before submission, but once submitted, the form cannot be edited.
  • Printed applications with documents are to be sent to: Career Cell, HR Department, Gatishakti Bhawan, National Capital Region Transport Corporation, INA Colony, New Delhi – 110023.

Selection Process

  • The selection criteria will be based on the merit of final percentage of marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying examination.

  • Candidates have to upload their final marks in percentage (%) only and not in CGPA/CPI or Grades.
  • If marks are in CGPA/CPI or Grades, candidates must convert them into percentage as prescribed by the respective University/College/Institution, and proof of conversion will be checked/verified during Document Verification.
  • Applications where marks are entered in CGPA/CPI/Grades without conversion will be summarily rejected.
  • The shortlisted/selected candidates will be informed through e-mail and/or NATS portal for document verification/joining.
  • Schedule of document verification/joining will be intimated separately.
  • Medical fitness certificate from Government authorized doctor (Gazetted) not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon of Central/State hospital is mandatorily required before joining.
  • The required documents in original along with one set of self-attested photocopies (10th/12th certificates & marksheets, qualifying exam degree & marksheets, proof of date of birth, valid caste certificate if applicable, passport size photographs, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card) are to be produced for verification.
  • Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not ensure engagement as an apprentice.
  • Reservation for SC/ST, OBC and PwBD candidates will be as per rules; in case of non-availability of candidates in particular reserved categories, positions may be filled from other reserved/general categories.
  • For each selected candidate, registration of Contract of Apprenticeship with Board of Apprenticeship Training will be made between the Apprentice & the Company as per provisions of The Apprentices Act, 1961 (amended till date) and existing procedure of NATS.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who fulfill all the conditions can apply and are advised to carefully read the full advertisement for details of eligibility criteria and selection modalities before submission of application.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility criteria shall be 20.01.2026.
  • The number of candidates to be engaged is indicative and may undergo changes without any further notification.
  • Those applicants who have passed the qualifying examination on or after 01.01.2023 shall only be eligible for applying against the apprenticeship position.
  • If the date of declaration of result is not mentioned in the Mark Sheet, the candidate must submit a certificate mentioning the date of publication of result from the Principal of the College/Institute at the time of verification.
  • The candidature of applicants will be provisional and subject to subsequent verification of certificates.
  • If at any stage it is detected that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility criteria or has furnished incorrect/false information, his/her candidature will stand cancelled.
  • Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence will attract immediate disqualification.
  • No Travel Expenses (TA/DA) will be provided to the candidates for document verification or joining or thereafter during the period of apprenticeship training.
  • No boarding or lodging facility will be provided to the apprentices engaged for apprenticeship training.
  • IREDA has no obligation to give regular employment to the Apprentices and they shall have no right to claim regular employment from IREDA on the basis of apprenticeship training.
  • This apprenticeship training shall not create any liability on IREDA for providing any job to the Apprentice and IREDA Management does not take any responsibility for any sort of employment/placement.
  • The decision of IREDA Management will be final and binding on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process either in part or full, etc.
  • No claim will arise for engagement if some vacancies are not filled due to unsuitability/insufficient number of candidates.
  • IREDA will not communicate to any applicant with respect to their non-selection.
  • IREDA has not entrusted/authorized any individual or organization to co-ordinate or liaison for apprenticeship training; candidates are advised to beware of touts.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum with regard to this advertisement shall be made available on the website (https://www.ireda.in) and NATS portal; candidates should visit these regularly for updates.
  • For any queries, candidates may contact on e-mail address: [email protected].

How to Apply

  • The candidate must go through and ensure compliance to the Terms & Conditions as mentioned in the notification.
  • The candidate must have a valid mobile number and e-mail ID before applying for the apprenticeship training and should keep them active till the completion of the selection process.
  • Candidates are advised to apply online through the portal of NATS (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme) i.e. https://nats.education.gov.in/ only.
  • Online applications received through the above referred link/mode will only be accepted.
  • No other modes will be entertained for receiving the application in whatever conditions it may be.
  • Incomplete/erroneous applications submitted online will be summarily rejected.

DPSRU Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 Overview

Company Name Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University (DPSRU)
Post Name Senior Project Associate and Project Assistant
No of Posts 03 (Senior Project Associate) 01 (Project Assistant)
Salary ₹57000 +HRA 30% (Senior Project Associate), ₹27000 +HRA 30% (Project Assistant)
Qualification For Senior Project Associate: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sc/BVSc / BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent AND Four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&I organizations and scientific activities and services OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent AND Two year's experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent. For Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in science / Diploma in Engineering or Technology
Walk in date 16/01/2026
Age Limit 50 years
Official Website dpsru.edu.in

Vacancy Details

Position Number
Senior Project Associate (03 UR)
Project Assistant 01

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification for Senior Project Associate: Four years Bachelor's Degree in Natural Sciences / Master's Degree in Natural Sc/BVSc / BPharm or bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent AND Four years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&I organizations and scientific activities and services OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or equivalent AND Two year's experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent
  • Desirable skills with expertise and publications in assay system for Senior Project Associate: 1. Harnessing different chemical libraries like Zinc 15/20, Pubchem etc for virtual screening 2. Analysis of protein-ligand binding interactions using Molegro, Maestro etc 3. Utilizing in-silico tools like Swiss Target Prediction, Swiss ADME to find drug like molecules using Lipinski rule of 5 and further eliminating the toxic molecules from the developed library 4. Synthesis, purification and characterization of novel heterocyclic compounds 5. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 6. Analytical method development & validation HPLC/LC-MS 7. Development & optimization of the conventional & novel formulations (using QbD/Gastroplus) 8. Physicochemical & biological characterization (ex vivo, in vivo) of formulations 9. In vitro studies and analysis of formulations: study of in vitro drug release mechanism (kinetics study) 10. Preformulation studies: solubility studies, permeability assays, solution & solid stability, compatibility studies 11. Sample Tracking & Data collection- clinical metadata entry, Tissue Quality Control, Blood/Fecal Sample Processing: PBMC isolation using Ficoll gradient, Data Coordination. 12. Transcriptomics and Proteomics Profiling : RNA extraction. Library preparation. RNA-Seq workflow. Sample QC. Next-generation sequencing: data visualization. 13. Proteomics (Metaproteomics / Tumor Proteome): Protein extraction, protein quantification, trypsin digestion. Sample prep for LC-MS/MS. GO term enrichment and pathway mapping (e.g., DAVID, Metascape). Maintain sample record. QC records, and experiment run sheets, document SOPs 14. In Vivo Animal Modeling. In Vitro Efficacy Assays. Pharmacokinetics (PK) : Dosing and Sampling, Plasma separation, LC-MS/MS-based assay. Pharmacodynamics-Biomarker Evaluation. Documentation: logbooks with ethics compliance. 16. R package for analysis of biological data, R for meta, PhVID for disproportionality analysis (frequency based and Bayesian methods). GRADE pro for GRADE analysis, Evidence Gap Map Analysis. Genome-wide association analysis with longitudinal phenotypes using fGWAS of R package. GROMAC for molecular simulation studies includes DCCM and PCA analysis, Network creation and analysis.
  • Essential Qualification for Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in science / Diploma in Engineering or Technology

Salary/ Stipend

  • Senior Project Associate: ₹57000 +HRA 30%
  • Project Assistant: ₹27000 +HRA 30%

Age Limit

  • Upper Age Limit for all the manpower positions specified in Table will be 50 yrs. The service duration will not exceed beyond 60 yrs of age.

Important Dates

Walk-in-Interview Date 16 January 2026
Reporting Time 09:00 AM

Selection Process

  • Walk-in-interviews will be conducted
  • Documents will be verified before interview

General Information / Instructions

  1. Age Limit: Upper Age Limit for all the manpower positions specified in Table will be 50 yrs. The service duration will not exceed beyond 60 yrs of age.
  2. Dearness Allowance (DA) & Child Care Allowance (CCA): Manpower in projects are not entitled to DA & CCCA.
  3. House Rent Allowance (HRA): HRA is allowed as per Central Government norms applicable in the city/location where they are working.
  4. Medical Benefits: The Project manpower will be entitled for medical benefits applicable as per DPSRU norms.
  5. Leave and other entitlements: The project manpower is entitled to leave as per rules of DPSRU.
  6. Bonus, Gratuity & Leave Travel Concession: The project manpower will not be entitled to these allowances.
  7. Remuneration is taxable as per norms.
  8. All manpower positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

Eligibility Criteria

Associate Director (IT) (On Contract)

  • Qualification: BCA/BE/B.Tech. (Computer Science Engineering (CSE)/Information Technology (IT)) /M.Tech (CSE/IT)/ MCA or equivalent from a recognized university.
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years of post-qualification experience in Information Technology, of which preferably at least 3 years should be in a Team Lead / Managerial / Supervisory role, managing teams of 20 or more professionals.
  • Essential: Strong hands-on experience as a developer in Frontend (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and React.js), Backend (Laravel (PHP), Python (Django / Flask preferred), and node JS), Databases (PostgreSQL and Oracle).
  • Essential: Good working knowledge of Linux-based environments, including server configuration, deployment, logs analysis, and basic shell scripting.
  • Essential: Sound understanding of SEO, Waterfall & Agile Methodology.
  • Essential: Proven experience in end-to-end management of web portal and application development projects—from requirement analysis and architecture design to development, deployment, and post-production support, GIT source code management and configurations of CI / CD pipelines. Experience in controlling IT budget.
  • Essential: Experience in testing websites for web security like handling CSRF, XSS requests, SQL injections along with quality control. Hands-on experience as a web developer (Front End and/or Back End) is a must.
  • Desirable: Sound knowledge of data visualization and reporting tools. Experience in coaching Agile teams. Prior Experience with Product Development. Work experience in the Finance and Manufacturing domain.

Associate Director (On Contract)

  • Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) holding membership from the ICAI or B. Tech./B.E (Full time) with MBA(Finance) (Full-time)/equivalent from a recognized University. For candidates who joined Public Sector Banks (PSBs)/Public Sector FIs as Probationary Officer/Scale I/II or equivalent posts and worked there for minimum duration of 15 Years, the required Qualification would be Graduate in any Discipline.
  • Experience: Should have at least 15 years of experience in Public Sector Banks/Financial sector/Consulting/dealing with Government Departments/Ministries.
  • Desirable: Candidates having substantial experience in Consulting/Advisory services shall be preferred.

Senior Associate - Technical (Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC)) (On Contract)

  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Chemical/Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering or Master's degree in Sciences/Technology/Engineering in related field.
  • Experience: For Bachelor's degree in Chemical/Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering- 06 years. For Master's degree in Chemical/Electrical/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering or Master's degree in Sciences- 04 Years.
  • Essential: Experience should be including Advanced Chemistry Cell, Energy storage, manufacturing/research in the field of emerging technologies of batteries, energy storage, batteries, electric mobility, or similar activities.
  • Essential: Sound understanding on entire ecosystem of Advanced Chemistry Cells (ACC) including expertise in innovative solutions in the related field.
  • Essential: Basic understanding of chemistry, materials science, electrochemical engineering principles.
  • Essential: Well versed with the complete manufacturing process flow especially in battery field.
  • Essential: Well versed with plant facility / machinery & equipment required for manufacturing of cells.
  • Essential: Good knowledge of the constituent components (cathode, Anode, Electrolyte, separator, etc.) of batteries and its properties.

Senior Associate – Technical (Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (REPM)) (On Contract)

  • Qualification: B.E/B.Tech in Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Science/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognised University. M.Tech/ME and PhD in aforesaid streams shall be preferred.
  • Experience: Should have at least 6 years of experience in Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (REPM) or similar advanced material technologies.
  • Desirable: Should have preferably worked in companies/entities which are engaged in manufacturing of or providing consultancy in the rare earth permanent magnets manufacturing or related sectors.
  • Essential: Deep understanding of the midstream process, including the conversion of Rare Earth Oxides (REO) to metals, metals to alloys, and alloys to finished magnets.
  • Essential: Exposure to carrying out analysis and review of capital expenditure items, including specialized plant & machinery, utilities, etc.
  • Essential: Ability to evaluate Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), technology tie-ups, Research & Development (R&D) or Transfer of Technology (ToT) agreements, etc.

Associate (Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (REPM)) (On Contract)

  • Qualification: B.E/B.Tech with MBA(Finance)
  • Experience: Should have at least 2 years of experience in Financial Sector/Consulting etc.
  • Desirable: Experience in credit function; dealing with Government Departments/Ministries regarding Consulting/Advisory assignments, managing Government Scheme(s) shall be an added advantage.
  • Essential: Knowledge of Project Appraisal, Project Management, Monitoring, Finance, Credit.

Age Limit (as on 31/12/2025)

  • Associate Director (IT): Maximum 45 years
  • Associate Director: Maximum 55 years
  • Senior Associate - Technical (ACC): Maximum 35 years
  • Senior Associate – Technical (REPM): Maximum 35 years
  • Associate (REPM): Maximum 30 years
  • Age Relaxation: Age relaxation in maximum age limit to Persons with Disabilities (PwD) will be provided as per Govt. of India guidelines.

Selection Process

  • Candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted based on qualifications and experience higher than the minimum prescribed.

Selection Process

  • The Applications for empanelment of Advocates will be received in prescribed format along with supporting documents within the stipulated time.
  • The list of empanelled candidates will be uploaded on the CPCB website after the screening process is completed by the Screening/Scrutinising Committee formed and approved by Competent Authority, CPCB.
  • The initial empanelment will be for three years or until further orders, whichever is earlier, and performance of empanelled Advocates shall be reviewed periodically.
  • The Board reserves the right to renew the empanelment on completion of the term and satisfactory performance of the Advocate.
  • The Board reserves the right to terminate the empanelment of any Advocate at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Fulfilment of criteria for empanelment does not give the right to the applicant for empanelment.
  • Successful empanelment does not give the right for entrustment of cases/court matters to empanelled Advocates.
  • The existing Advocates on panel of CPCB need to re-apply for empanelment.

General Information/Instructions

  • The eligible practicing Advocates may send their application in the prescribed format along with all supporting documents (scanned) through email to the Member Secretary, Central Pollution Control Board at [email protected].
  • The hard-copy of the Application shall also be forwarded to the Member Secretary, Central Pollution Control Board, Parivesh Bhawan, East Arjun Nagar, Delhi-110032 within the stipulated time and date.
  • The Application form may be downloaded from the website of CPCB.
  • The initial empanelment will be for three years or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
  • Professional fee will be as per CPCB norms and terms and conditions for payment of professional fee to empanelled Advocates.
  • The note in the application form states that all proofs attached should be self-attested by the applicant.
  • Self-declaration in the application form requires that all information submitted by the applicant in the application form is correct and valid.

How to Apply

  • Download the Application form for empanelment as CPCB Panel Advocate from the CPCB website.
  • Fill the prescribed Application form addressed to The Member Secretary, Central Pollution Control Board, Parivesh Bhawan, East Arjun Nagar, Delhi-110032.
  • Provide particulars such as Name, Father's Name, Date of Birth, Address for correspondence, Telephone numbers (mobile, landline) and email.
  • Furnish details of Educational Qualification with proof attached.
  • Provide Date of enrolment and Bar Council details with proof attached.
  • Mention the Court/Forum for which empanelment is sought (Supreme Court of India, Delhi High Court, National Green Tribunal Principal Bench, District Courts (Delhi Jurisdiction), Central Administrative Tribunal Delhi Bench, Other Tribunals and Commissions (Delhi Jurisdiction)).
  • Indicate field specialisation and number of cases in which the applicant appeared as counsel with details of case and proof attached.
  • Provide details of empanelment with Pollution Control Boards or Commission, Central/State Government, MoEF&CC, other Government Ministries, Statutory Organisations, PSUs and Central/State Government Departments, if any.
  • Provide Aadhaar Number with proof attached.
  • Indicate knowledge of computers and participation through video-conferencing (Yes/No).
  • Confirm knowledge of CPCB norms and the Terms & Conditions for Payment of Professional Fee to Empanelled Advocates (Yes/No).
  • Sign the self-declaration stating that all information submitted in the application form is correct and valid.
  • Send the scanned copy of the duly filled application form along with all supporting documents through email to [email protected].
  • Forward the hard copy of the application form along with supporting documents to the Member Secretary, CPCB, Parivesh Bhawan, East Arjun Nagar, Delhi-110032 so as to reach on or before 23/01/2026 till 06:00 PM.

  • At any stage of Recruitment process or later, if a candidate is or has been found guilty of any misconduct such as: Using unfair means during the Written test/Interview/DV/Medical. Impersonating or procuring impersonation by any person. Resorting to any irregular means in connection with his/her candidature during selection process. Using undue influence for his/her candidature by any means. Submitting of false certificates/ documents /information or suppressing any information at any stage. Giving wrong information regarding his/her Community/Category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen). Misbehaving, intimidating or threatening in any manner to the Supervisor, Scrutiny Member, Security Guard, RVNL's representatives or any other staff of RVNL etc. Making statements which are incorrect or false, suppressing material information, submitting fabricated documents, etc. Damaging venue related infrastructure/equipment(s). Possession of fire alarms/ weapons during the interview Assault, use of force, causing bodily harm in any manner to the interview functionaries. Such candidate will be liable to legal/criminal prosecution, as well as the following actions: Disqualification from the Recruitment Process and /or. Debarment of either permanently or for a specified period from any Exam/Recruitment conducted by RVNL and /or. Discharge/removal/dismissal from service, if the act of misconduct comes to notice after appointment to the service of RVNL.
  • Matriculation Certificate (for age proof).

In case of Degree/ Diploma in Management qualifications where there is a mention of Dual Specialization, one of the specializations necessarily needs to be function specific for which the post has been advertised.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Citizenship: A candidate must be a citizen of India.
  • Age Limit: A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years as on 1st January 2025; he/she must not have been born earlier than 2nd January 1983 and not later than 1st January 2004. Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST/SEBC/Women/Ex-Servicemen and by 10 years for PwD with permanent disability of 40% or more, with cumulative benefit for PwD of SC/ST/SEBC categories.
  • Educational Qualification (Essential): A candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree from any University incorporated by an Act of the Central or a State Legislature in India or an Educational Institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed to be a University under Section-3 of the UGC Act, 1956 or a Foreign University approved by the Central Government from time to time.
  • Odia Language Requirement: The candidate must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must have passed Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject OR passed High School Certificate or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subjects OR passed Odia as a language subject in final examination of Class-VII from a recognised school OR passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the Government of Odisha.
  • Marital Status Condition: A candidate who has more than one spouse living or, in case of a woman candidate, is married to a person having one spouse living, shall not be eligible unless exempted by the State Government.
  • Government Servants: Government servants (temporary or permanent) are eligible, provided they possess requisite qualifications and are within the prescribed age limit and obtain No Objection Certificate from the competent authority.
  • Character & Health: A candidate must have good moral character and be of sound mental and physical health and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with the discharge of duties.

Salary/Stipend

  • For Odisha Police Service, Group-A (Junior Branch) – Group-A Service: Rs. 56,100/- in Level-12, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.
  • For Group-B Services (Odisha Taxation & Accounts Service, Odisha Co-operative Service, Odisha Skill Development & Employment Service, Odisha Labour Service, Odisha Excise Service, Odisha Tourism Service): Rs. 44,900/- in Level-10, Cell-1 in the Pay Matrix under Rule-3 of ORSP Rules, 2017.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 21 years.
  • Maximum Age: 42 years.
  • The candidate must not have been born earlier than 02/01/1983 and not later than 01/01/2004.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC, ST, SEBC, Women and Ex-Servicemen candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Disabilities having permanent disability of 40% or more; PwD candidates of SC/ST/SEBC categories are eligible for cumulative age relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay examination fee of Rs. 700/- (Rupees Seven hundred only).
  • Payment Mode: Online mode while filling the Online Application Form (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallet, etc.).
  • The examination fees paid shall be refunded only to those candidates who actually appear in both the papers of the Preliminary Examination.
  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the Online Application Form for refund where required.

Important Dates

Event Date

Selection Process

  • The Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination shall comprise:
    • Preliminary Examination (Objective type) for selection of candidates for Main Examination.
    • Main Examination (Written) and Interview for Personality Test for selection to various services and posts.
  • Preliminary Examination: Two compulsory papers of Objective Type (Multiple Choice Questions), General Studies Paper-I (200 marks) and General Studies Paper-II (200 marks), each of 2 hours duration.
  • General Studies Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks of 33; selection to Main Examination is based on marks in General Studies Paper-I and qualifying the Paper-II as per rules.
  • There shall be negative marking: for each wrong answer, one-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to a question shall be deducted; multiple answers to a question are treated as wrong.
  • Main Examination: Written examination consists of nine papers – two qualifying language papers (Odia and English) in Part-I and seven papers in Part-II (Essay, General Studies-I, II, III, IV and two Optional subject papers).
  • Marks obtained in Part-II papers and Interview (Personality Test) are counted for ranking; language papers in Part-I are qualifying in nature.
  • Interview (Personality Test) carries 250 marks; final ranking is based on total marks of Main Written and Interview.
  • Candidates are allotted to various Services based on ranks and service preference.

General Information/Instructions

  • The provisions of the Odisha Conduct of Examinations Act, 1988 are applicable; any violation or malpractice will attract disciplinary action and possible criminal prosecution.
  • Penalty provisions under Rule-18 of Odisha Civil Services Combined Competitive Recruitment Examination Rules, 1991 shall apply.
  • Reservation and relaxation benefits for SC, ST and SEBC are admissible only to those categories of Odisha.
  • Community/caste status once mentioned in the online application shall be treated as final and cannot be changed later.
  • The advertisement does not bind the Government to make appointment; the number of vacancies is subject to change without notice depending on public service requirements.
  • Misrepresentation or suppression of information in the online application will result in cancellation of candidature and penalty as decided by the Commission.
  • Mere empanelment in the select list does not confer any right to appointment unless the Government is satisfied about suitability after necessary enquiry.
  • No request for withdrawal of candidature or change of category will be entertained.
  • Candidates must carefully fill service/post preference; change of preference after submission of online application will not be allowed.
  • Candidates must answer papers in their own handwriting; only PwD candidates with specified disabilities may use a scribe as per rules.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must go through the detailed advertisement available on the website of OPSC before filling the Online Application Form.
  • Candidates must apply online through the OPSC website (https://opsc.gov.in).
  • The link for registration and payment of examination fee will be available from 20/01/2026 to 20/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • The last date for submission of registered online application is 27/02/2026 (5.00 P.M.).
  • Applications received through any mode other than online shall not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
  • After declaration of result of the Main Written Examination, candidates called for Interview/Personality Test will be required to submit print-out/hard copy of online application along with photocopies of documents as stated in the advertisement on the day of document verification.

Selection Process

  • Stage - I: Preliminary Examination- 150 marks
  • Stage - II: (a) Main Written Examination: Technical paper(s)- 200 Marks.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must possess a valid e-Mail ID and Mobile number while applying for the post and keep the same active till the completion of this recruitment process to receive important messages from the Commission.
  • The appointment will be only against one of the posts carrying the corresponding pay as indicated in the above table and candidates need to give option for the posts/services.
  • The candidates other than SC, ST and PwD category shall have to pay the Examination fee of Rupees Five Hundred (₹ 500/-) only. The examination fee paid shall be refunded to the candidates who actually appear in the recruitment examination.
  • Appointments shall be on a regular basis, carrying the level of pay as mentioned in the table above.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill all the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post as laid down in the advertisement. Admission of a candidate to the written examination and other tests shall be provisional and based on the information furnished by her/him in the Online Application Form.
  • Online applications submitted to OSSC found to be incomplete in any respect are liable for rejection without entertaining any correspondence with the applicants on that matter.
  • If at any stage of recruitment or thereafter, it is found that any information furnished by the candidate in her/his Online Application Form is false/incorrect or the candidate has suppressed any relevant information or the candidate otherwise does not satisfy the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post, her/his candidature for the posts shall be cancelled. She/ He may further be debarred either temporarily or permanently from the recruitment examination(s) conducted by the Commission.
  • Commission will adopt a “Normalisation Formula” published in Commission’s website vide Notice No.2444/ OSSC dated 02.09.2021 for processing the result if any examination is conducted through CBRE (Computer Based Recruitment Examination)/OMR in multiple batches using different sets of question papers so as to offset the difficulty level that may arise in such use of multiple sets of question papers in the said examination, and such normalized score will be used to determine the last selection marks of different categories. The Commission at its discretion will conduct the examination either through OMR or through CBRE mode.
  • No Admission Letter for recruitment at any stage shall be sent by post. The candidates are therefore advised to be in touch with the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in regularly to know updates regarding the status of application, downloading of Admission Letter and the date of examination etc.
  • The candidates are advised to submit the Online Application Form well in advance without waiting for the closing date to avoid the last-hour rush.
  • As regards the candidates applying for more than one post/ service as per their eligibility, the Commission will make the final allotment to a post/ service on the basis of merit-cum-preference of post/ service given by the candidate. Once a post is allotted, no change of posts will be made by the Commission due to non-fulfilment of any post-specific requirements of Physical/medical/educational standards, etc. Candidates thus must ensure that they fulfil all the requirements of the posts before giving their preference/options for any post/ service.
  • The candidate has to fill/confirm in the OMR answer sheet or CBRE Screen, as the case may be, correct Roll Number and other data as required in the place(s) indicated therein and darken the appropriate circles properly in Blue or Black Ball Point Pen only in case of OMR-based examination. If the information so furnished is incomplete or different from the application form or if appropriate circle is not darkened properly, then zero marks will be awarded.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/ re-checking of scores in the Examination. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Sharing of marks with the candidates: Marks obtained by an applicant in Preliminary Examination and Main Examination are proposed to be shared with her/him after final merit list is published.
  • All the posts are State Cadre posts. The candidate, on selection, may be asked to serve anywhere in Odisha.
  • If a candidate scoring more than the last selection mark at any stage of the examination is not qualified for the subsequent stage/ final selection due to any reason, he must represent to the Commission within 05 days of the declaration of the said result through e-mail [email protected].
  • Applicants who are Government servants or working under PSUs of the State Govt. or Central Govt. should obtain a “No Objection Certificate” from their controlling authority and upload the same with the Online Application form. In case a standing order of NOC is issued by any Department of Govt the same should be uploaded. At the certificate verification stage they must produce the “No Objection certificate” or “Standing order of NOC issued by the concerned Department of Govt.”. Those who are not Government Servants/working in PSUs at the time of submission of application but became Government Servants subsequently should have to submit “No Objection Certificate” or “Standing order of NOC” at the stage of certificate verification. If any candidate hides her/ his Govt. servant/PSU Employees status, and found to be a Govt. servant or a PSU Employee during Certificate Verification may not be considered for recommendation.

How to Apply

  • The applicants should go through the detail advertisement before filling up the online application form.
  • The candidate may apply for the post as per her/his eligibility as per terms of the advertisement.
  • All eligible candidates have to register themselves by clicking on "APPLY ONLINE" button on the home page of the Commission's website www.ossc.gov.in.
  • Those candidates who are applying for the first time have to register for the post by clicking on "NEW USER" button shown on the screen. On submitting the registration form a User Id and Password will be generated.
  • On clicking "New user" or "Registered User", instruction for filling up the Online Registration/ Re-registration and Application Forms shall appear on the computer screen. These instructions should be read carefully before proceeding with filling up the Application Form.
  • Step-by-step procedure for registration/ re-registration can be viewed by clicking on "Instruction to fill up Online Application Form".

  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Passed +2 Science or +2 Vocational course in Agriculture related subject in Crop Production (CP) / Horticulture (HORT) / Repair and Maintenance of Power Driven Farm Machinery (PDFM) from a recognized Board/Council/Institution; Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic under OUAT is desirable and carries 5% extra marks in Written Test.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Passed +3 in Arts / Science / Commerce or equivalent with knowledge of Computer Skill.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Passed Higher Secondary Examination (10+2) conducted by CHSE, Odisha or equivalent, or Diploma in Engineering from Institution under State Council for Technical Education & Vocational Training, Odisha affiliated to AICTE, having knowledge in computer application.

  • Village Agricultural Worker (VAW): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Junior Assistant (JA): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI): Over 20 years and below 42 years.
  • Amin: As per post-wise age and educational qualification table, within 21–42 years.
  • Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS): Minimum 21 years and maximum 42 years.
  • SC/ST/SEBC: Upper age relaxed by 5 years.

  • RI, ARI & Amin: Age relaxation up to five years for candidates having actual work experience in settlement/consolidation organisations.

  • Written Test pattern: Mathematics (20 questions, 20 marks), General Studies (20, 20), English (20, 20), Odia (15, 15), Computer (15, 15), Logical Reasoning (10, 10); duration 1½ hours.
  • Negative marking: One-fourth (0.25) of marks assigned to a question deducted for each wrong answer; multiple answers treated as wrong; no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • Minimum qualifying marks (Written): 30% for ST, SC, PwDs, Ex-Servicemen and Sportspersons; 35% for others. VAW candidates with Diploma in Agriculture Polytechnic (OUAT) get 5% extra marks (capped at total marks).
  • Stage-II: Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills – 50 marks, 1 hour; qualifying in nature with minimum 40% for all candidates.
  • Number of candidates shortlisted for Practical Skill Test: not less than 3 times the number of vacancies, category/special category wise, as per merit and availability; Commission may vary as per requirement.
  • Merit Lists: Provisional Master Merit List based on marks / normalized score in Written Test; Provisional Screening List for Practical Skill Test; Provisional Merit List of Practical Skill Test; Screening List for Document Verification; Provisional Select Lists post-wise / district-wise.
  • Document Verification & Counselling: Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification by District Level Board and then counselling for choice of post and Department/District/Range; allotment based on merit-cum-choice and availability.
  • Commission reserves right to conduct additional/re-test for Written/Skill Test, reschedule tests, and cancel part or whole of recruitment at any stage.

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must apply online only through OSSSC website; applications other than online / incomplete shall be summarily rejected.
  • All eligibility conditions (except age) must be fulfilled as on the last date of submission of online application.
  • No Admission Letter shall be issued to candidates whose application is incomplete or who do not fulfil prescribed eligibility criteria.
  • Provisional Admission Letters / Intimation Letters for Written Test and Practical Skill Test shall be uploaded on www.osssc.gov.in only; no hard copy will be sent by post.
  • Candidates must regularly visit the Commission’s website to track notices, exam dates, and download Admission / Intimation Letters using User ID and Password.
  • Information uploaded on website will not be supplied separately under RTI Act, 2005 and will remain available for a specific period only; candidates should download and preserve it.
  • Candidature remains purely provisional and is liable to rejection at any stage for deficiency / misrepresentation / use of unfair means.
  • Multiple application forms by a candidate are not permitted and will lead to cancellation of result and other penalties as per rules.
  • In CBRE mode, appearing in more than one shift/date by furnishing false information is treated as unfair means and penalised.
  • Commission’s decision on eligibility, acceptance/rejection of applications, penalties, mode of selection, exam conduct, test centre allotment, preparation of merit list, allocation of post, and debarment is final and binding.

How to Apply

  • Visit OSSSC website www.osssc.gov.in and click on “Apply Online”.
  • Registration (New User): Fresh candidates who have not registered earlier for any recruitment of OSSSC must complete Registration by providing required details and uploading full specimen signature and passport-size photograph in prescribed formats and sizes.
  • Re-registration (Registered User): Candidates already registered for any other OSSSC post must login using existing User ID and select “Re-registration” option for this post.
  • Mere Registration / Re-registration does not mean filing of online application; candidates must login again and fill and submit the detailed Online Application Form as per instructions on the screen.
  • Fill in all data and information as per certificates/records, upload required documents, and make Examination Fee payment (if applicable) through available online payment modes.
  • Ensure that the photograph and signature uploaded are clearly identifiable/visible; otherwise registration/application is liable to rejection.
  • Use own valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number with validity till completion of recruitment process for receiving Activation Key, alerts, and for downloading Admission Letters; do not share or change this contact during the process.
  • Submit online application well in advance without waiting for the last date to avoid last-hour rush.
  • Take printout of Confirmation Page after successful submission and fee payment (where applicable).
