Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Qualification & Experience (for Sr. Medical Officer – Orthopaedics): MBBS + Post Graduate Degree / DNB in relevant specialization with 0 year post-qualification experience; OR MBBS + Post Graduate Diploma in relevant specialization with 1 year post-qualification experience.
  • Essential Qualification & Experience (for Sr. Medical Officer – General Medicine): MBBS + Post Graduate Degree / DNB in relevant specialization with 0 year post-qualification experience; OR MBBS + Post Graduate Diploma in relevant specialization with 1 year post-qualification experience.
  • Post-qualification experience refers to experience after acquiring the professional qualification (in relevant specialization) only and not otherwise.
  • If applicants possess MBBS + PG Diploma and are working in CPSUs / State or Central Govt organizations, they should have minimum one-year experience in the next below grade or in equivalent post.
  • All qualifications must have been acquired from Indian Universities/Institutes recognized by appropriate statutory authorities.
  • The candidate should have registered his/her qualification with any State Medical Council under National Medical Commission (NMC), formerly known as Medical Council of India.
  • Candidates possessing Basic and Qualifying Degrees acquired through Regular/Full-Time courses only will be considered; qualifications acquired through Correspondence/Distance Education/Part Time/E-learning are not eligible.
  • The percentage of marks in the essential qualification shall be aggregate of all semesters/years and no rounding-off will be done; candidates with CGPA/OGPA/letter grade must provide equivalent percentage as per norms of the University/Institute.

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay: Grade-III – Rs. 50000 - 3% - 160000.
  • Dearness Allowance (IDA pattern): Payable as a percentage of Basic Pay; current DA is 51.8% of Basic Pay.
  • Perquisites & Allowances under Cafeteria system: 35% of running Basic Pay.
  • Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA): 20% of running Basic Pay.
  • Special Compensatory Allowance (SCA): 10% of the pre-revised Basic Pay.
  • Annual Increment: 3% of Basic Pay.
  • Performance Related Pay (PRP): Up to 20% of Annual Basic Pay, as per company rules.
  • Other emoluments / benefits include Rent-free accommodation; Provident Fund; Payment of Gratuity; HAL Defined Pension; Casual Leave; Vacation Leave; Medical facilities for self and dependent family members; uniform, shoes, jacket/jerkin, sweater etc., as per company rules.
  • Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Employees provides assured regular monthly financial support to dependent beneficiaries to enable them to lead a normal life.
  • Group Insurance Scheme (GIS), Group Personal Accidental Insurance (GPAI), Employees Group Life Insurance (EGLI) and Employees Benevolent Fund with assured sum to beneficiaries are available as per company rules.

Age Limit (as on 31-01-2026)

  • Upper age limit is 35 years for Un-Reserved (UR)/General category candidates as on 31-01-2026.
  • Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years in respect of SC/ST candidates, subject to caste/tribe name appearing in the Central List of SC/ST of respective State as notified by Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, with proper caste/tribe certificate.
  • Upper age limit is relaxable by 3 years in respect of OBC (NCL) candidates, subject to caste name appearing in the Central List of OBC of respective State for appointment to posts under Government of India and Central Govt. PSUs; OBC (NCL) certificate should not be older than 6 months as on 31-01-2026.
  • In respect of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs), upper age limit is relaxable by 10 years over and above the relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBDs and disability is 40% or more as per RPWD Act 2016 and RPWD Rules 2017.
  • Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years in respect of candidates who had ordinarily been domiciled in the State of Jammu & Kashmir during the period 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.
  • Relaxation in age limit in respect of Ex-Servicemen and Serving Officers of Armed Forces will be extended as per company rules, subject to post(s) reserved.
  • Upper age limit with all relaxations shall not exceed 55 years, except for PwBD candidates; for PwBD candidates, upper age limit with all relaxations shall not exceed 56 years.
  • Age and Post Professional Qualification Experience will be reckoned as on 31-01-2026.

Application Fee

  • Application fee is exempted in the case of SC and PwBD candidates.
  • Application fee of Rs.500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only), bank charges extra as applicable and non-refundable, is to be paid by candidates belonging to OBC (NCL) category.
  • Applicable convenience fee/transaction fee and taxes, if any, over and above the application fee will be borne by the candidates.
  • Online Mode (SBI Collect): Candidates shall access the payment link via HAL website career page, choose GOVT/PSU/COURTS, filter by State Odisha, select HINDUSTAN AERONAUTICS LTD as payee, choose payment category “EMD SD EMPLOYEES DEPOSIT GUEST HOUSE HOSPITAL”, fill in required details including Advertisement No. KPT/IHC/SRD/2025-01 as tender/ reference, and pay Rs.500/- using Net Banking / Card / UPI etc., noting down the SBI Collect Reference Number and saving the transaction details.
  • Offline Mode (Demand Draft): Candidates may pay the application fee through Demand Draft drawn in favour of “Hindustan Aeronautics Limited” payable at State Bank of India, Sunabeda-2, SBI Branch Code 1304; the Demand Draft should not be obtained prior to this notification.

Important Dates

Event Date
Date of Advertisement 06-01-2026
Age & Post Professional Qualification Experience reckoned as on 31-01-2026
Last Date for receipt of applications by Post/Courier 31-01-2026

Selection Process

  • Eligible candidates will be short-listed based on initial screening, relevance of experience and other credentials possessed, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview.
  • Candidates are required to meet the stipulated criteria with respect to qualification and Post Professional Qualification Experience (PPQE) as an Executive or in the capacity of an Executive, and must produce requisite documents during document verification prior to interview.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted and called for interview in the ratio of 1:10 (maximum) as per company rules; if candidates fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria exceed the 1:10 ratio, those with more relevant experience will be considered first.
  • In case of tie in relevant experience, candidates who secured more marks in the qualifying examination will be considered first; if marks are also the same, the elder candidate in age will be considered first.
  • The selection process, including qualifying marks, will be governed by the extant Recruitment Rules (Recruitment Manual) of the company as amended from time to time.
  • Date, time and venue of the interview will be intimated only to shortlisted candidates via email and the list of shortlisted candidates will also be hosted on HAL website.
  • The suitability of shortlisted candidates will be assessed by a Selection Committee through interview on parameters such as knowledge of the job, general knowledge particularly in spheres allied/connected with the post, personality, educational qualifications and PPQE.
  • Merely meeting the qualification and/or PPQE requirements does not entitle candidates to be shortlisted for interview.

General Information/Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Mere submission of application will not entail right for claiming appointment; candidates should satisfy themselves regarding eligibility criteria before applying.
  • HAL reserves the right to restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the requirements advertised and also reserves the right to raise eligibility criteria to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview.
  • The number of vacancies indicated is provisional and may increase, decrease or even become NIL depending upon actual requirements; HAL reserves the right to cancel notified vacancies at its discretion and such decision will be final and binding.
  • Candidates possessing qualifications acquired through Correspondence/Distance Education/Part Time/E-learning will not be considered and are not eligible to apply.
  • Candidates must submit original documents supporting percentage conversion from CGPA/OGPA/letter grade to percentage at the time of interview, if applicable.
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen categories must submit valid certificates in prescribed format issued by Competent Authority at the time of interview/document verification.
  • For OBC (NCL) reservation benefits, candidates must belong to Non-Creamy Layer, caste/community name must appear in Central List of OBC, and OBC (NCL) certificate must be in prescribed format and not older than six months as on 31-01-2026.
  • Candidates employed in Central/State Government Departments, PSUs, Autonomous Organizations, Quasi Government Organizations, Armed Forces or Para-Military Forces must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) or applicable document at the time of document verification; failure to do so will result in disqualification from interview and ineligibility for TA reimbursement.
  • Candidates found eligible to appear for interview will be reimbursed/paid train/bus fare from contact/mailing address to venue of interview by shortest route on production of proof of journey as per company rules.
  • Post Professional Qualification Experience (PPQE) in PSUs/Central/State Government/Private Organizations must be supported by experience certificates on official letterhead and will be subject to scrutiny regarding nature of experience, responsibilities and assignments.
  • Candidates who have left a PSU after availing VRS benefits, if selected, will be required to return the VRS compensation to the concerned PSU.
  • Present vacancies are identified to be filled by external candidates only through Direct Recruitment; applications of internal candidates will not be considered.
  • Name of candidate, Date of Birth and Father’s/Mother’s Name must match Matriculation/10th Standard certificate/mark sheet; where date of birth is not available, school leaving certificate indicating date of birth will be considered as per applicable state rules.
  • Applications not in conformity with advertisement requirements, incomplete applications, discrepancies in information, applications without required enclosures or those received after last date will not be considered and application fee will not be refunded.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to satisfactory medical reports from HAL Industrial Health Centre, verification of caste and verification of character & antecedents from concerned authorities.
  • Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of one year from date of joining and may be posted at HAL Koraput Division or anywhere in India based on company requirements; candidates will not be allowed to apply for transfer for initial three years of service.
  • If any information furnished in application is found to be false, incomplete or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, candidature/appointment will be revoked/terminated at any stage without reference.
  • All correspondence will be through email only to the valid email ID provided by candidate in the application form; email ID must remain valid for at least one year from date of interview.
  • Any further information/corrigendum/addendum will be uploaded only on HAL website (www.hal-india.co.in); candidates are required to visit HAL website regularly for updates.
  • HAL reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Any dispute/cause with regard to recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Koraput / Jeypore Court only.
  • Self-attested photocopies of specified documents (SSC/SSLC/10th certificate, mark sheets, degree certificates, experience documents, salary slips, NOC, category certificates, discharge certificate, J&K domicile certificate, disability certificate, registration certificate with State Medical Council, recent photograph, proof of application fees) must be attached with application as per list provided in the notification.

How to Apply

  • Candidate is required to download the “Application Form” from Careers link at HAL website www.hal-india.co.in.
  • The candidate shall fill in all relevant details in the application form, affix latest passport size photograph, sign the application form at the designated place and forward the same by Post / Courier.
  • The completed application must reach the Chief Manager (HR), R & P Section, HAL, Koraput Division, Sunabeda, Odisha, Pin-763002 on or before 31-01-2026.
  • Self-attested copies of all relevant testimonials/documents must be enclosed along with the application form to substantiate the details filled therein.
  • Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the posts notified prior to forwarding the application form.
  • All queries in connection with this notification may be forwarded to the Email ID: [email protected].
  • It is noted that the information posted in HAL website only is considered authentic; candidates should verify newspaper advertisements through HAL website.

    • 150 Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions

  • Stage 2 - Main Written Examination: 300 marks, 5 hours duration
    • Paper 1: Language Test (English & Odia) - 100 marks (2 hours) - Qualifying in nature
      • English (50 marks): Essay, Precis writing, Vocabulary, Reading comprehension, Grammar - 1 hour
      • Odia (50 marks): Essay, Precis writing, Vocabulary, Reading comprehension, Grammar - 1 hour

      • English to Odia Translation: 50 marks - 1 hour

    • Paper 3: General Awareness/Reasoning Test - 100 marks (2 hours)
      • General Awareness (50 marks): Current Affairs, Indian Economy, General Science, Books & Authors, Awards & Honours, Indian History & Culture, Indian Geography, Indian Polity - 1 hour
      • Reasoning (50 marks) - 1 hour
    • Qualifying Marks in aggregate: 45% for Unreserved (40% for SC/ST)

    • Skill Test: 30 marks - 30 minutes
    • Syllabus: Computer Fundamentals, Windows (MS-Windows), MS Office (Word, Excel & Power Point), Linux Fundamental, Open Office Application, Usage of Internet Operation, Communication Technology, Networking Concepts (LAN, Ethernet, Broad Band, Wireless), Digital Signature

Eligibility Criteria

  • Warden: Educational qualification – B.A. / B.Sc. from recognised university; experience – at least two years in hostel management.
  • Warden: Age – 30 to 60 years as on the date of advertisement; only male candidates can apply.
  • Warden: Preference will be given to local candidates from the block area; if not available, candidates from adjacent blocks of Mayurbhanj district may be considered.
  • Warden: Retired teachers, if willing and physically & mentally sound within the age limit of 62 years as on the date of engagement, may apply; must be in position to stay in the hostel 24×7.
  • Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: Educational qualification – must have passed HSC Examination from recognised board.
  • Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: Age – 21 to 30 years as on the date of advertisement; only male candidates can apply; preference to local and adjacent block candidates of Mayurbhanj district.
  • Head Cook: Age – 30 to 40 years as on the date of advertisement; only male candidates can apply; must be in position to stay in the hostel 24×7.
  • Head Cook: Must be well conversant to use LPG; must have perfect hygienic dresses while cooking and good cooking habits; preference and due weightage to individuals trained in cookery; ability to cook any dishes on time with due care towards hygiene and deliciousness.
  • Assistant Cook: Age – 21 to 32 years as on the date of advertisement; only male candidates can apply; must be in position to stay in the hostel 24×7; similar LPG usage, hygiene and cooking habit requirements with preference for trained in cookery.

Salary/Stipend

  • Warden: Rs 21,175/- per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer).
  • Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: Rs 7,500/- per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer).
  • Head Cook: Rs 9,000/- per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer).
  • Assistant Cook: Rs 6,750/- per month (including EPF share of Employee & Employer).

Age Limit 

  • Warden: 30 to 60 years as on the date of advertisement; retired teachers may apply within age limit of 62 years as on the date of engagement.
  • Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: 21 to 30 years as on the date of advertisement.
  • Head Cook: 30 to 40 years as on the date of advertisement.
  • Assistant Cook: 21 to 32 years as on the date of advertisement.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Date of Advertisement 06.01.2026
Last date of receiving application through Speed / Registered Post 22.01.2026 by 5 PM

Selection Process

  • Preference shall be given to local candidates.
  • If candidates are not available in that locality, then block will be taken as a unit.
  • If still candidates are not available, then candidates from nearby blocks may be selected.
  • No candidates outside of the district should be recruited against the posts stated above.
  • On expiry of one year period of engagement, fresh engagement shall be made with at least one working day gap based on satisfactory performance of the employee.

General Information/Instructions

  • Applications are invited from desiring candidates in the prescribed proforma for engagement of support staff for Boys’ Hostel at OAV Sanjaydhanposi, Kusumi, Mayurbhanj.
  • Applications must be sent only through Speed / Registered Post.
  • The authority will not be responsible for any postal delay.
  • The authority reserves the right to cancel the advertisement either partly or fully and any application or applications without assigning any reason thereof.
  • For more details, candidates may contact the Vidyalaya Office from 10 AM to 4 PM on all working days.

How to Apply

  • Application envelope must be superscribed with “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF WARDEN/ CHOWKIDAR-CUM-SWEEPER/HEAD COOK/ ASSISTANT COOK FOR BOYS HOSTEL” (strike out which is/are not applicable).
  • Filled in application with all documents must be sent to: PRINCIPAL, ODISHA ADARSHA VIDYALAYA, AT- SANJAYDHANPOSI, PO – BADAMPAHAR, VIA - BADAMPAHAR, DIST- MAYURBHANJ, PIN – 757047, ODISHA.
  • Last date of receiving application is 22.01.2026 by 5 PM through Speed / Registered Post.
  • Applications received after due date shall be summarily rejected.

Name of the Post Total
Medical Officer AYUSH Homeopathic (Co-located) 10
Medical Officer AYUSH-RBSK Homeopathic (Male) 7

Eligibility Criteria

  • Medical Officer AYUSH Homeopathic (All posts): The candidate must have passed Bachelor degree in Homeopathic Medicine & Surgery (BHMS) from a recognized University. He/She must have completed the Internship Training. He/She must have valid registration from the Odisha State Council / Board of Homeopathic Medicine. No provisional registration certificate is acceptable.
  • Clinical Psychologist-NMHP: Candidates must have Post Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or Applied Psychology along with Master of Philosophy in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology obtained after completion of a full-time course of two years which includes supervised clinical training from any University Grants Commission recognised and approved by the Rehabilitation Council of India. Candidate must have passed Odia up to M.E standard.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Medical Officer AYUSH Homeopathic (All posts): Rs. 29,524 + KBK incentive 4000 + PI (Max 25%) per month
  • Clinical Psychologist-NMHP: Rs.34,742 + KBK incentive Rs.1000 + PI (Max 25%) per month

Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Lower age limit for all posts: 21 years
  • Upper age limit for Medical Officer posts: Up to 38 years (Age relaxation applicable as per ORV)
  • Upper age limit for Clinical Psychologist: Up to 45 years

Important Dates

Event Date
Walk-in Interview - Medical Officer AYUSH Homeopathic (Co-located) 28 January 2026
Walk-in Interview - Clinical Psychologist-NMHP 29 January 2026
Walk-in Interview - Medical Officer AYUSH-RBSK Homeopathic (Male) 30 January 2026
Walk-in Interview - Medical Officer AYUSH-RBSK Homeopathic (Female) 31 January 2026
Registration Time for all dates 10.00 AM to 12 Noon
Venue Urban PHC, College Square, Bhawanipatna

Selection Process

  • Medical Officer AYUSH Homeopathic (All posts): Career Assessment (PG in Homeopathy: 10 marks; BHMS: 50 marks; +2: 20 marks; Matriculation: 20 marks). Final panel merit list based on marks secured; candidates securing 50% and more marks kept in panel for 1 year.
  • Clinical Psychologist-NMHP: Viva-Voice test: 50 Marks; Mark Assessment (based on marks of M.Phil in Clinical Psychology or Medical & Social Psychology): 50 Marks; Total: 100 Marks.

General Information / Instructions

  • The above positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the scheme. Canvassing in any form will render the candidate disqualified.
  • Candidates must apply in prescribed format available on website and submit self-attested copies of all required documents at the time of interview.
  • Original documents required for verification.
  • No personal correspondence/queries entertained.
  • Candidates already working in Health Department must submit NOC.
  • Must be able to read, write and speak Odia and meet specified criteria.
  • Number of vacancies/remunerations provisional and may vary.
  • Authority reserves right to cancel/reject applications without reason.

How to Apply

  • Download application form from www.kalahandi.odisha.gov.in
  • Fill the application form and bring it along with self-attested photocopies of all certificates, mark sheets, age proof, caste/residence certificate, ID proof, and two passport size photographs.
  • Attend walk-in interview on scheduled date with all original documents for verification.
  • Registration: 10.00 AM to 12 Noon at Venue: Urban PHC, College Square, Bhawanipatna
